        - PolicyName: InvokeDefaultRouteLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt DefaultRouteFunction.Arn

  # IAM role for the default route Lambda to start state machine executions.
  DefaultRouteFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # WebSocket API
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: WebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  # Default route: handles all messages that do not match another route.
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: "$default"
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Join
        - "/"
        - - integrations
          - !Ref DefaultRouteIntegration

  DefaultRouteIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DefaultRouteFunction.Arn
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn

  DefaultRoutePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultRouteFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*"

  # Stage
  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref stageName
      AutoDeploy: true

  # Lambda invoked by the default route: starts a state machine execution.
  DefaultRouteFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              state_machine_arn = os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"]
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              body = event.get("body", "{}")
              try:
                  payload = json.loads(body)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  payload = {}
              input_data = {
                  "connectionId": connection_id,
                  "message": payload,
              }
              sfn = boto3.client("stepfunctions")
              sfn.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=state_machine_arn,
                  input=json.dumps(input_data),
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"ok": True})}
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DefaultRouteFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref StateMachine

  # Lambda used by the state machine to send a response back to the client.
  SendMessageFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              region = os.environ["AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"]
              websocket_api_id = os.environ["WEBSOCKET_API_ID"]
              stage_name = os.environ["STAGE_NAME"]
              connection_id = event["connectionId"]
              message = event.get("message", {})
              client = boto3.client(
                  "apigatewaymanagementapi",
                  region_name=region,
                  endpoint_url=f"https://{websocket_api_id}.execute-api.{region}.amazonaws.com/{stage_name}",
              )
              response_body = json.dumps({"echo": message})
              client.post_to_connection(
                  ConnectionId=connection_id,
                  Data=response_body.encode("utf-8"),
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200}
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SendMessageFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Environment:
        Variables:
          WEBSOCKET_API_ID: !Ref WebSocketApi
          STAGE_NAME: !Ref stageName

  # Step Functions state machine: waits 5 seconds then sends a response.
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Process an incoming WebSocket message and reply after 5 seconds.",
            "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "SendResponse"
              },
              "SendResponse": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${LambdaArn}",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - LambdaArn: !GetAtt SendMessageFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cost management stack that monitors AWS costs with a configurable monthly
  budget, a KMS-encrypted SNS topic, and budget alerts delivered via SMS or
  email when actual costs exceed 80% and 99% of the configured limit.

Parameters:
  BudgetAmount:
    Type: Number
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000000
    Default: 100
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD (defaults to $100).
  BudgetName:
    Type: String
    Default: Monthly-Cost-Budget
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 60
    Description: Friendly name for the monthly cost budget.
  NotificationMethod:
    Type: String
    Default: SMS
    AllowedValues:
      - SMS
      - EMAIL
    Description: Delivery channel for budget alerts (SMS or EMAIL).
  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: "+61400000000"
    AllowedPattern: "^(\\+\\d{10,15}|[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+)$"
    Description: >-
      Destination for alerts. For SMS use an international phone number prefixed
      with the country code (default +61 / Australia), e.g. +61412345678. For
      email provide a valid address, e.g. team@example.com.

Conditions:
  IsSMS: !Equals
    - !Ref NotificationMethod
    - SMS
  IsEmail: !Equals
    - !Ref NotificationMethod
    - EMAIL

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the AWS billing SNS topic.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: billing-topic-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM user permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SNS service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: billing-topic
      DisplayName: "AWS Billing Alerts"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  SmsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsSMS
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingTopic
      Protocol: sms
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

  MonthlyBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: !Ref BudgetName
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref BudgetAmount
          Unit: USD
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetType: COST
        CostTypes:
          IncludeCredit: false
          IncludeDiscount: true
          IncludeOtherSubscription: true
          IncludeRecurring: true
          IncludeRefund: false
          IncludeSubscription: true
          IncludeSupport: true
          IncludeTax: true
          IncludeUpfront: true
          UseAmortized: false
          UseBlended: false
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingTopic
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingTopic

Outputs:
  BudgetName:
    Description: Name of the created monthly cost budget.
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBudget
  BillingTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS-encrypted billing SNS topic.
    Value: !Ref BillingTopic
  NotificationEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint configured to receive budget alerts.
    Value: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained authentication and authorization infrastructure for an ontology
  lookup service using Amazon Cognito. Creates a user pool with software token
  MFA, a resource server with a read scope, and a machine-to-machine client for
  client credentials grants. Publishes all relevant configuration values to AWS
  Systems Manager Parameter Store under an application-prefixed path.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    Description: Application name used as a prefix for Parameter Store paths and identifiers.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Amazon Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: "ON"
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Ref AppName
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-resource-server"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "${AppName}-m2m-client"
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${AppName}/read"
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "${AppName}-auth-domain"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Custom resource that reads the generated client secret from Cognito so it
  # can be stored in Parameter Store. DescribeUserPoolClient returns ClientSecret
  # only when GenerateSecret is true.
  ClientSecretLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ClientSecretLookupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  ClientSecretLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt ClientSecretLookupRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  LOGGER.info(json.dumps(event))
                  if event.get("RequestType") in ("Create", "Update"):
                      pool_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"]
                      client_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["ClientId"]
                      client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

                      response = client.describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id,
                      )
                      secret = response["UserPoolClient"].get("ClientSecret", "")
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event,
                          context,
                          cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {"ClientSecret": secret},
                          physicalResourceId=f"{pool_id}|{client_id}",
                      )
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as exc:
                  LOGGER.exception("Custom resource failed")
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(exc)})

  ClientSecretResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ClientSecretLookupFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Parameter Store entries
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/client-id"
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  ClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/client-secret"
      Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretResource.ClientSecret

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/user-pool-id"
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  OAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/oauth-scope"
      Value: !Sub "${AppName}/read"

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/discovery-url"
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/token-url"
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

  DomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/domain"
      Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The identifier of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The identifier of the machine-to-machine app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  OAuthScope:
    Description: The OAuth scope used for client credentials requests.
    Value: !Sub "${AppName}/read"
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery endpoint for the user pool.
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  TokenUrl:
    Description: Token endpoint for the client credentials grant.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
  ParameterStorePrefix:
    Description: Prefix under which parameter store values are published.
    Value: !Sub "/${AppName}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition'

Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: invokeContentModeration
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: ContentModeration

Resources:
  # IAM role for Lambda execution with Rekognition access
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  # Lambda function for content moderation
  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          VALID_EXTS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON payload'})

              image_url = body.get('url')
              if not image_url:
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Missing required field: url'})

              if not any(image_url.lower().endswith(e) for e in VALID_EXTS):
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, and png are allowed.'})

              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(
                      image_url,
                      headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
                  )
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                      image_data = resp.read()
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  code = e.code if e.code >= 400 else 400
                  return respond(code, {'error': f'Failed to fetch image: HTTP {e.code}'})
              except urllib.error.URLError:
                  return respond(404, {'error': 'Image not found at the provided URL'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': f'Error fetching image: {str(e)}'})

              if len(image_data) > MAX_SIZE:
                  return respond(400, {'error': 'Image exceeds maximum size of 5MB'})

              try:
                  rekog = boto3.client('rekognition')
                  rekog_resp = rekog.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_data},
                      MinConfidence=60
                  )
                  labels = rekog_resp.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                  return respond(200, {'moderationLabels': labels})
              except ClientError as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': f'Rekognition error: {str(e)}'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'error': f'Internal error: {str(e)}'})

          def respond(status, data):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps(data)
              }

  # API Gateway REST API named ContentModeration
  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      Description: API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # POST method on the root resource with AWS_PROXY integration
  ContentModerationPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaArn}/invocations'
          - {LambdaArn: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunction.Arn}

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke the Lambda function
  LambdaApiInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiId}/*/POST/'
        - {ApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi}

  # Deployment with a Production stage
  ContentModerationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ContentModerationPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      StageName: prod
      StageDescription:
        Description: Production stage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: URL of the Content Moderation API (POST endpoint)
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${ApiId}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/'
      - {ApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi}
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref ContentModerationFunction

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >
  Scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organization accounts tagged with key
  "organizations:account-closure" and value "REQUESTED". An EventBridge rule
  triggers an EXPRESS Step Functions state machine hourly. The state machine
  paginates through accounts tagged for closure, describes each account, and if
  it is ACTIVE closes it via the Organizations CloseAccount API, then tags the
  account with "ACKNOWLEDGED". Includes throttling and eventual-consistency
  error handling, and logs all execution data to a CloudWatch log group with
  365-day retention. IAM roles follow least-privilege.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group - 365 day retention for all state machine execution data
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/stepfunctions/CloseOrganizationAccountsWorkflow
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role assumed by the Step Functions state machine (least privilege)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosureAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: arn:aws:organizations::*:account/*/*
        - PolicyName: ResourceTaggingAccountDiscovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - resourcegroupstaggingapi:GetResources
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                    rtsvc:ResourceType: "organizations::account"
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${StepFunctionsLogGroup}:*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role assumed by EventBridge to start the state machine execution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStepFunctionsExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt CloseOrganizationAccountsWorkflow.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPRESS Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloseOrganizationAccountsWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: CloseOrganizationAccountsWorkflow
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsLogGroup.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Automated close of AWS Organization accounts tagged with organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED. Runs hourly. Paginates through tagged accounts, describes each, closes ACTIVE accounts, then tags ACKNOWLEDGED. Handles throttling and eventual-consistency errors.",
          "StartAt": "Initialize",
          "States": {
            "Initialize": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {
                "NextToken": "INITIAL"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.iterator",
              "Next": "ChoosePage"
            },
            "ChoosePage": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.iterator.NextToken",
                  "StringEquals": "INITIAL",
                  "Next": "GetTaggedAccountsFirstPage"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.iterator.NextToken",
                  "IsPresent": true,
                  "Next": "GetTaggedAccountsNextPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "Succeed"
            },
            "GetTaggedAccountsFirstPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources",
              "Parameters": {
                "ResourceTypeFilters": [
                  "organizations::account"
                ],
                "TagFilters": [
                  {
                    "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                    "Values": [
                      "REQUESTED"
                    ]
                  }
                ]
              },
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Throttled"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 4,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 6,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ],
              "ResultSelector": {
                "ResourceTagMappingList.$": "$.ResourceTagMappingList",
                "PaginationToken.$": "$.PaginationToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.page",
              "Next": "ProcessTaggedAccounts"
            },
            "GetTaggedAccountsNextPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:resourcegroupstaggingapi:getResources",
              "Parameters": {
                "ResourceTypeFilters": [
                  "organizations::account"
                ],
                "TagFilters": [
                  {
                    "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                    "Values": [
                      "REQUESTED"
                    ]
                  }
                ],
                "PaginationToken.$": "$.iterator.NextToken"
              },
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Throttled"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 4,
                  "MaxAttempts": 6,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 6,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0
                }
              ],
              "ResultSelector": {
                "ResourceTagMappingList.$": "$.ResourceTagMappingList",
                "PaginationToken.$": "$.PaginationToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.page",
              "Next": "ProcessTaggedAccounts"
            },
            "ProcessTaggedAccounts": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "MaxConcurrency": 5,
              "ItemsPath": "$.page.ResourceTagMappingList",
              "ItemProcessor": {
                "ProcessorConfig": {
                  "Mode": "INLINE"
                },
                "StartAt": "ExtractAccountId",
                "States": {
                  "ExtractAccountId": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "States.ArrayGetItem(States.StringSplit($.ResourceARN, '/'), 2)",
                      "ResourceARN.$": "$.ResourceARN"
                    },
                    "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.AccountId"
                    },
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException",
                          "organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 3,
                        "MaxAttempts": 6,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "organizations.AccountNotFoundException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 10,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0
                      }
                    ],
                    "ResultSelector": {
                      "Status.$": "$.Account.Status"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.account",

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  StudyBuddy Cognito authentication infrastructure. Creates a Cognito user pool that
  verifies user emails, uses email as the username, collects mutable required email,
  given name and family name attributes, triggers custom Lambda functions for
  post-authentication, post-confirmation and pre-sign-up processing, provisions a
  frontend app client supporting the authorization code and implicit OAuth flows,
  configures a Cognito Hosted UI using a Cognito-provided domain prefix, and adds a
  Google identity provider backed by credentials stored in AWS Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Base URL of the StudyBuddy frontend used to build the app client callback and
      logout URLs (for example https://app.studybuddy.example).
    Default: "https://app.studybuddy.example"
    AllowedPattern: "^https://.*$"
    ConstraintDescription: FrontendDomain must be an HTTPS URL.
  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    Description: Google OAuth client ID used by the Google identity provider.
    Default: "studybuddy-google-client-id-placeholder"
  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client secret used by the Google identity provider.
    Default: "studybuddy-google-client-secret-placeholder"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda functions triggered by the user pool
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StudyBuddyLambdaCognitoPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: "*"

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: studybuddy-post-authentication
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: studybuddy-post-confirmation
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: studybuddy-pre-sign-up
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return event

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User pool
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # App client for the frontend
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ClientName: StudyBuddyFrontendClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "${FrontendDomain}/callback"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "${FrontendDomain}/logout"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain (Cognito-provided prefix domain, no custom DNS/cert)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google credentials stored in Secrets Manager
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: studybuddy-google-oauth-credentials
      Description: Google OAuth client ID and client secret for the StudyBuddy Google identity provider.
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"ClientId":"${ClientId}","ClientSecret":"${ClientSecret}"}'
        - ClientId: !Ref GoogleClientId
          ClientSecret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google identity provider
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: givenname
        family_name: familyname
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: "profile email openid"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The StudyBuddy Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The StudyBuddy frontend app client ID.
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPoolClient
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Description: The Cognito-provided Hosted UI domain prefix.
    Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}"
  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: The full Cognito Hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding Google OAuth credentials.
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template creating two VPCs (Users and Fog layers) for an
  edge-computing architecture. Each VPC gets one subnet in the first available
  AZ, a route table, a Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3, and an Interface VPC
  Endpoint for KMS. The Fog VPC additionally gets Interface VPC Endpoints for
  Secrets Manager, EventBridge, STS, and Lambda.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPCs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersVPC
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  FogVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogVPC
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets  (first AZ – resolved via Fn::Select / Fn::GetAZs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersSubnet

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogSubnet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersRouteTable

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogRouteTable

  # Associate subnets to route tables
  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway VPC Endpoints for S3 (one per VPC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  FogS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Groups for Interface VPC Endpoints
  #
  # Each interface endpoint requires a security group. We use a single SG per
  # VPC that allows inbound HTTPS from the VPC CIDR and outbound HTTPS to the
  # VPC CIDR so services can be reached privately.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints in Users VPC
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.50.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: UsersEndpointSG

  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints in Fog VPC
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.60.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: FogEndpointSG

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoint for KMS (both VPCs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersKmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Security Hub Automation Rules for suppressing reviewed, non-actionable
  findings across the organization. Each rule updates the workflow status
  to SUPPRESSED and attaches an explanatory note. Security Hub is assumed
  to already be enabled in the target account and organization.

Parameters:
  ExcludedUser1:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the first human IAM user whose IAM-related findings should NOT be suppressed
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]+$'
  ExcludedUser2:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the second human IAM user whose IAM-related findings should NOT be suppressed
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]+$'

  CISSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: 12-digit AWS account ID of the sub-account to scope CIS benchmark finding suppression
    Default: '000000000000'
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    MaxLength: '12'
    MinLength: '12'
  PublicBucketNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-separated list of S3 bucket names that are intentionally public
    Default: 'public-bucket-1'
  EBSAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: 12-digit AWS account ID for which to suppress EBS default-encryption findings
    Default: '000000000000'
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    MaxLength: '12'
    MinLength: '12'
  AutomationAccount1:
    Type: String
    Description: First 12-digit AWS account ID that runs automation infrequently
    Default: '000000000000'
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    MaxLength: '12'
    MinLength: '12'
  AutomationAccount2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second 12-digit AWS account ID that runs automation infrequently
    Default: '000000000001'
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
    MaxLength: '12'
    MinLength: '12'
  GuardDutyBedrockFindingType:
    Type: String
    Description: Specific GuardDuty finding type for expected cross-account Bedrock API activity
    Default: 'UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/CrossAccountBedrockApiActivity'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9:/._-]+$'

Resources:
  # Security Hub must be enabled for automation rules to work.
  SecurityHub:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Properties: {}
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 1 – IAM-related findings organization-wide (excluding named users)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IAMSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 1
      RuleName: 'SuppressIAMFindings'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Suppresses IAM-related findings across the organization as accepted
        non-actionable findings. Findings referencing the named human users
        ${ExcludedUser1} and ${ExcludedUser2} are excluded from this rule and
        must be reviewed separately.
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/IAM.'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !Sub 'IAM finding reviewed and accepted as expected behavior. Findings for users ${ExcludedUser1} and ${ExcludedUser2} are excluded from suppression and must be reviewed separately.'
              UpdatedBy: 'IAMSuppressionRule-Auto'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 2 – CIS benchmark findings scoped to a specific sub-account
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISSubAccountSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 2
      RuleName: 'SuppressCISSubAccountFindings'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Suppresses CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark findings scoped to the
        designated sub-account ${CISSubAccountId}. Findings in this account
        have been reviewed and accepted as non-actionable.
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/'
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CISSubAccountId
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !Sub 'CIS benchmark finding in account ${CISSubAccountId} - reviewed and accepted as non-actionable.'
              UpdatedBy: 'CISSubAccountRule-Auto'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 3 – Broader CIS & FSBP findings organization-wide
  #   (SG admin ports, S3 public/HTTP access, AWS Config coverage)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BroaderSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 3
      RuleName: 'SuppressNonActionableBaselineFindings'
      Description: >-
        Organization-wide suppression of a set of CIS and AWS Foundational
        Security Best Practices findings that have been reviewed and accepted
        as expected or non-actionable, including: security groups permitting
        administrative ports (SSH/RDP) needed for bastion hosts and testing,
        S3 bucket public-access and HTTP-access settings for approved
        operations, and AWS Config regional coverage variance.
      Criteria:
        Type:
          # ––– FSBP: Security Group admin ports –––
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/EC2.1'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/EC2.2'
          # ––– FSBP: S3 bucket public-access & HTTP-access –––
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.1'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.2'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.3'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.4'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.5'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.6'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.7'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3.8'
          # ––– FSBP: AWS Config regional coverage –––
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Config.1'
          # ––– CIS: S3-related controls –––
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/2.1'
          # ––– CIS: Security-group-related controls –––
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/4.1'
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/4.2'
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/4.3'
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/4.4'
          # ––– CIS: AWS Config –––
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/2.5'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed - reviewed as non-actionable: administrative-port security groups needed for bastion hosts/testing, S3 bucket public-access and HTTP-access settings for approved operations, and AWS Config regional coverage variance.'
              UpdatedBy: 'BroaderSuppressionRule-Auto'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 4 – Public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public
  #          S3 buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicBucketSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 4
      RuleName: 'SuppressPublicS3BucketFindings'
      Description: 'Suppresses S3 public-access findings for a known list of S3 buckets that are intentionally public.'
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/S3'
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark/2.1'
        ResourceType:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: 'AwsS3Bucket'
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'arn:aws:s3:::'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !Join
                - ''
                - - 'Suppressed - S3 bucket is intentionally public as part of a known approved use case. Buckets covered: '
                  - !Join [', ', !Ref PublicBucketNames]
              UpdatedBy: 'PublicBucketSuppressionRule-Auto'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 5 – EBS default-encryption finding for one specific account
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EBSSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 5
      RuleName: 'SuppressEBSDefaultEncryptionFinding'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Suppresses the EBS default-encryption finding for account
        ${EBSAccountId}. The finding has been reviewed and accepted.
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: 'Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/EC2.9'
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref EBSAccountId
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: !Sub 'EBS default-encryption finding in account ${EBSAccountId} - reviewed and accepted.'
              UpdatedBy: 'EBSSuppressionRule-Auto'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RULE 6 – Unused-credential & access-key-rotation findings for two
  #          specific accounts that run automation infrequently
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnusedCredentialSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 6
      RuleName: 'SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for
        accounts ${AutomationAccount1} and ${AutomationAccount2}, which run
        automation infrequently and therefore legitimately have stale or
        rarely-rotated credentials.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023
  ARM AMI, pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility. Images are built
  daily, scanned for vulnerabilities, distributed to the current region with
  launch permissions shared to an AWS Organization and two dev/prod accounts,
  and automatically deleted after 6 months via a lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID (o-xxxx) to share AMI launch permissions with.
    Default: o-a1b2c3d4e5
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]+$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dev environment AWS account ID to share AMI launch permissions with.
    Default: '111122223333'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Prod environment AWS account ID to share AMI launch permissions with.
    Default: '444455556666'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: AMI Sharing Configuration
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
          - DevAccountId
          - ProdAccountId

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield account - full VPC is created here)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-build-subnet

  NatSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-nat-subnet

  NatRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-nat-rt

  NatSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref NatRouteTable

  NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref NatRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref NatSubnet

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-rt

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-sg

  LogsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for EC2 Image Builder S3 logs encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: imagebuilder-logs-key

  LogsEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/imagebuilder-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsEncryptionKey

  S3LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LogsEncryptionKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles and instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2InstanceInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt S3LogsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${S3LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2 Image Builder component - Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElasticBeanstalkCompatibilityComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: elastic-beanstalk-compatibility-al2023-arm
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 ARM instances for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkCompatibilityAL2023ARM
        description: Pre-configures Amazon Linux 2023 ARM instances for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateAndInstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y unzip jq curl wget git which lsof net-tools
              - name: ConfigureTimezoneAndLocales
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - timedatectl set-timezone UTC
                    - localectl set-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8
              - name: EnableCloudInitServices
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl enable cloud-init
                    - systemctl enable cloud-init-local
                    - systemctl enable cloud-config
              - name: PrepareElasticBeanstalkDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /var/app/current
                    - mkdir -p /var/log/eb-engine.log
                    - chmod 755 /var/app/current
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: VerifyPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - command -v curl && command -v unzip && command -v jq
                    - grep -q '^env LANG=en_US.UTF-8' /etc/locale.conf || localectl status
                    - echo "Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration validation passed"

  # Image Recipe
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkCompatibilityComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-distribution
      Description: Distributes the CIS hardened AL2023 ARM AMI to the current region with sharing
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI for Elastic Beanstalk
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-infrastructure
      Description: Build infrastructure for the CIS hardened AL2023 ARM pipeline
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.large
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref S3LogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs/
      Tags:
        Pipeline: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipeline (daily schedule + vulnerability scanning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-pipeline
      Description: Daily CI/CD pipeline for the CIS hardened AL2023 ARM AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 2 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Pipeline: CIS-Hardened-AL2023-ARM

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle Policy (delete images after 6 months)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-delete-after-6-months
      Description: Deletes images older than 6 months
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            RetainAtLeast: 1
            Unit: MONTHS
            Value: 6
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: cis-hardened-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
            SemanticVersion: 1.0.0
      Status: ENABLED

Description: Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage for the API.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito app client.

Resources:
  MathsMCPFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMCPFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': 'Hello from Maths MCP server',
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  }
              }

  MathsMCPFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMCPApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-api"
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MathsMCPResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMCPApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi

  MathsMCPCognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: MathsMCPAuth
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMCPUserPool.Arn

  MathsMCPPOSTMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: POST
      ResourceId: !Ref MathsMCPResource
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMCPCognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  MathsMCPPOSTMethodPermissions:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMCPApi}/*/POST/mcp"

  MathsMCPOPTIONSMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      ResourceId: !Ref MathsMCPResource
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: false

  MathsMCPRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMCPApi.RootResourceId
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  MathsMCPRootMethodPermissions:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMCPApi}/*/GET/"

  MathsMCPDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MathsMCPPOSTMethod
      - MathsMCPOPTIONSMethod
      - MathsMCPRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMCPApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

  MathsMCPUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true

  MathsMCPUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayUrl:
    Description: The base URL of the Maths MCP API.
    Value: !Sub "https://${MathsMCPApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}"
  UserPoolId:
    Description: The Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: The Cognito app client ID.
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPoolClient
