AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Three-tier VPC network foundation with 3 AZs, public/private-app/private-db
  subnets, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway with EIP, and dedicated route tables.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IP for the NAT Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateway (placed in the first public subnet)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet CIDR allocation – 9 sequential /24 blocks from 10.0.0.0/16
  #   Index 0: 10.0.0.0/24  – AZ1 Public
  #   Index 1: 10.0.1.0/24  – AZ1 Private App
  #   Index 2: 10.0.2.0/24  – AZ1 Private DB
  #   Index 3: 10.0.3.0/24  – AZ2 Public
  #   Index 4: 10.0.4.0/24  – AZ2 Private App
  #   Index 5: 10.0.5.0/24  – AZ2 Private DB
  #   Index 6: 10.0.6.0/24  – AZ3 Public
  #   Index 7: 10.0.7.0/24  – AZ3 Private App
  #   Index 8: 10.0.8.0/24  – AZ3 Private DB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets  (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [6, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Application Subnets (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-app-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-app

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-app-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-app

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [7, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-app-az3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-app

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Database Subnets (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-db-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-db

  PrivateDbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-db-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-db

  PrivateDbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [8, !Cidr ["10.0.0.0/16", 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-db-az3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-db

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-app-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-app

  PrivateDbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-db-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private-db

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routes – Public → Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routes – Private App → NAT Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateAppRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routes – Private DB → NAT Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDbRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet-to-Route-Table Associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets → PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private App subnets → PrivateAppRouteTable
  PrivateAppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  # Private DB subnets → PrivateDbRouteTable
  PrivateDbSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

Outputs:

  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the three public subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]

  PrivateAppSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the three private application subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateAppSubnet1, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3]]

  PrivateDbSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the three private database subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateDbSubnet1, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3]]

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment that
  extracts usage metadata, dataset properties, Q search index and action metrics,
  folder asset relationships, and user access information from QuickSight and
  streams them into a structured S3 data lake for downstream Athena query and
  analytics purposes. The template provisions a private admin S3 bucket
  (admin-suite-<accountId>), a self-contained script bucket containing Glue ETL
  scripts, five Glue processing pipelines scheduled in a staggered daily run
  starting at 2 AM UTC, and five CloudWatch metric streams that deliver
  QuickSight metrics through dedicated Firehose delivery streams into a
  cloudwatch/ prefix of the admin bucket. All resources share one consolidated
  IAM role.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket used to store the Glue ETL scripts. This bucket is
      created by the template and the scripts are uploaded into it.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment tag applied to all resources.

Resources:
  ##########################################################################
  # S3 Buckets
  ##########################################################################
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the admin suite S3 buckets
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: admin-suite-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEncryptionServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ScriptBucketName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Consolidated IAM Role & Policy
  ##########################################################################
  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: admin-suite-consolidated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - quicksight.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteConsolidatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminSuiteS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: AdminSuiteGlue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteQuickSight
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteIAM
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteCloudWatch
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AdminSuiteKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ReEncryptFrom
                  - kms:ReEncryptTo
                Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: admin-suite-consolidated-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Self-contained Glue ETL Script Upload (Lambda-backed custom resource)
  ##########################################################################
  ScriptUploaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: admin-suite-script-uploader
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  bucket = props.get('BucketName')
                  for script in props.get('Scripts', []):
                      s3.put_object(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          Key=script['Key'],
                          Body=script['Content']
                      )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      'Message': 'Uploaded {} scripts'.format(len(props.get('Scripts', [])))
                  })
              except Exception as exc:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {
                      'Error': str(exc)
                  })
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: admin-suite-script-uploader
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScriptUploadCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploaderFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucket
      Scripts:
        - Key: scripts/asset_access_management.py
          Content: |
            import sys
            import json
            import boto3
            import logging
            from datetime import datetime

            from pyspark.context import SparkContext
            from awsglue.context import GlueContext
            from awsglue.job import Job
            from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

            LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
            LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

            args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET'])
            LOGGER.info('Running Asset Access pipeline')

            sc = SparkContext()
            glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
            job = Job(glueContext)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

            qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
            sts = boto3.client('sts')
            account = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
            prefix = 'asset-access/{}/'.format(datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y/%m/%d'))

            records = []
            params = {'AwsAccountId': account, 'MaxResults': 100, 'NextToken': ''}
            while True:
                resp = qs.list_data_sets(**params)
                records.extend(resp.get('DataSetSummaries', []))
                params['NextToken'] = resp.get('NextToken', '')
                if not params['NextToken']:
                    break

            rdd = sc.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in records])
            rdd.saveAsTextFile('s3://{}/{}/'.format(args['S3_BUCKET'], prefix))
            job.commit()
            LOGGER.info('Asset Access pipeline complete: {} records'.format(len(records)))

        - Key: scripts/dataset_metadata.py
          Content: |
            import sys
            import json
            import boto3
            import logging
            from datetime import datetime

            from pyspark.context import SparkContext
            from awsglue.context import GlueContext
            from awsglue.job import Job
            from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

            LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
            LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

            args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET'])
            LOGGER.info('Running Dataset Metadata pipeline')

            sc = SparkContext()
            glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
            job = Job(glueContext)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

            qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
            sts = boto3.client('sts')
            account = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
            prefix = 'dataset-metadata/{}/'.format(datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y/%m/%d'))

            records = []
            params = {'AwsAccountId': account, 'MaxResults': 100, 'NextToken': ''}
            while True:
                resp = qs.list_data_sets(**params)
                records.extend(resp.get('DataSetSummaries', []))
                params['NextToken'] = resp.get('NextToken', '')
                if not params['NextToken']:
                    break

            # Enrich each dataset summary with its full properties.
            for ds in records:
                detail = qs.describe_data_set(AwsAccountId=account, DataSetId=ds['DataSetId'])
                ds['properties'] = detail.get('DataSet', {})

            rdd = sc.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in records])
            rdd.saveAsTextFile('s3://{}/{}/'.format(args['S3_BUCKET'], prefix))
            job.commit()
            LOGGER.info('Dataset Metadata pipeline complete: {} records'.format(len(records)))

        - Key: scripts/folder_assets.py
          Content: |
            import sys
            import json
            import boto3
            import logging
            from datetime import datetime

            from pyspark.context import SparkContext
            from awsglue.context import GlueContext
            from awsglue.job import Job
            from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

            LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
            LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

            args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET'])
            LOGGER.info('Running Folder Assets pipeline')

            sc = SparkContext()
            glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
            job = Job(glueContext)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

            qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
            sts = boto3.client('sts')
            account = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
            prefix = 'folder-assets/{}/'.format(datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y/%m/%d'))

            records = []
            params = {'AwsAccountId': account, 'MaxResults': 100, 'NextToken': ''}
            while True:
                resp = qs.list_folders(**params)
                records.extend(resp.get('FolderSummaryList', []))
                params['NextToken'] = resp.get('NextToken', '')
                if not params['NextToken']:
                    break

            relationships = []
            for folder in records:
                folder_id = folder['FolderId']
                assets = []
                tokens = {'AwsAccountId': account, 'FolderId': folder_id, 'MaxResults': 100, 'NextToken': ''}
                while True:
                    item = qs.list_folder_members(**tokens)
                    assets.extend(item.get('FolderMemberList', []))
                    tokens['NextToken'] = item.get('NextToken', '')
                    if not tokens['NextToken']:
                        break
                relationships.append({
                    'folder': folder,
                    'assets': assets
                })

            rdd = sc.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in relationships])
            rdd.saveAsTextFile('s3://{}/{}/'.format(args['S3_BUCKET'], prefix))
            job.commit()
            LOGGER.info('Folder Assets pipeline complete: {} folders'.format(len(relationships)))

        - Key: scripts/q_metadata.py
          Content: |
            import sys
            import json
            import boto3
            import logging
            from datetime import datetime

            from pyspark.context import SparkContext
            from awsglue.context import GlueContext
            from awsglue.job import Job
            from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

            LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
            LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

            args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET'])
            LOGGER.info('Running Q Metadata pipeline')

            sc = SparkContext()
            glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
            job = Job(glueContext)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

            qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
            sts = boto3.client('sts')
            account = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
            prefix = 'q-metadata/{}/'.format(datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y/%m/%d'))

            records = []
            try:
                resp = qs.describe_account_settings(AwsAccountId=account)
                records.append({'account_settings': resp.get('AccountSettings', {})})
            except Exception as exc:
                LOGGER.warning(str(exc))
            try:
                resp = qs.describe_account_subscription_status(AwsAccountId=account)
                records.append({'account_subscription': resp.get('AccountSubscriptionStatus', '')})
            except Exception as exc:
                LOGGER.warning(str(exc))

            rdd = sc.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in records])
            rdd.saveAsTextFile('s3://{}/{}/'.format(args['S3_BUCKET'], prefix))
            job.commit()
            LOGGER.info('Q Metadata pipeline complete: {} records'.format(len(records)))

        - Key: scripts/datasource_properties.py
          Content: |
            import sys
            import json
            import boto3
            import logging
            from datetime import datetime

            from pyspark.context import SparkContext
            from awsglue.context import GlueContext
            from awsglue.job import Job
            from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

            LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
            LOGGER.setLevel(logging.INFO)

            args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME', 'S3_BUCKET'])
            LOGGER.info('Running Datasource Properties pipeline')

            sc = SparkContext()
            glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
            job = Job(glueContext)
            job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

            qs = boto3.client('quicksight')
            sts = boto3.client('sts')
            account = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
            prefix = 'datasource-properties/{}/'.format(datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y/%m/%d'))

            records = []
            params = {'AwsAccountId': account, 'MaxResults': 100, 'NextToken': ''}
            while True:
                resp = qs.list_data_sources(**params)
                records.extend(resp.get('DataSources', []))
                params['NextToken'] = resp.get('NextToken', '')
                if not params['NextToken']:
                    break

            # Enrich each datasource summary with full properties.
            for ds in records:
                detail = qs.describe_data_source(AwsAccountId=account, DataSourceId=ds['DataSourceId'])
                ds['properties'] = detail.get('DataSource', {})

            rdd = sc.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in records])
            rdd.saveAsTextFile('s3://{}/{}/'.format(args['S3_BUCKET'], prefix))
            job.commit()
            LOGGER.info('Datasource Properties pipeline complete: {} records'.format(len(records)))

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: admin-suite-script-upload-sync
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Glue ETL Jobs
  ##########################################################################
  AssetAccessManagementJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptUploadCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-asset-access-management
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}/scripts/asset_access_management.py"
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-disable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-auto-scaling': 'true'
        '--class': GlueApp
        '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--EXTRA_BUCKET': !Ref ScriptBucket
      Tags:
        Pipeline: asset-access
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  DatasetMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptUploadCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-dataset-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-disable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-auto-scaling': 'true'
        '--class': GlueApp
        '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--EXTRA_BUCKET': !Ref ScriptBucket
      Tags:
        Pipeline: dataset-metadata
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptUploadCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-folder-assets
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}/scripts/folder_assets.py"
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-disable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-auto-scaling': 'true'
        '--class': GlueApp
        '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--EXTRA_BUCKET': !Ref ScriptBucket
      Tags:
        Pipeline: folder-assets
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptUploadCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-q-metadata
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}/scripts/q_metadata.py"
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-disable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-auto-scaling': 'true'
        '--class': GlueApp
        '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--EXTRA_BUCKET': !Ref ScriptBucket
      Tags:
        Pipeline: q-metadata
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  DatasourcePropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn:
      - ScriptUploadCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-datasource-properties
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}/scripts/datasource_properties.py"
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-disable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-auto-scaling': 'true'
        '--class': GlueApp
        '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--EXTRA_BUCKET': !Ref ScriptBucket
      Tags:
        Pipeline: datasource-properties
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # Glue Triggers - staggered daily schedule starting at 2 AM UTC
  ##########################################################################
  AssetAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-trigger-asset-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetAccessManagementJob
          Arguments:
            '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  DatasetMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-trigger-dataset-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(5 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasetMetadataJob
          Arguments:
            '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  FolderAssetsTrigger:

      Name: admin-suite-trigger-folder-assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(10 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob
          Arguments:
            '--S3_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  QMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-trigger-q-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED

      Tags:

    Properties:

      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300

        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

  VPCId:
    Description: ID of the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map private DNS service discovery, auto scaling, VPC, NAT gateway, and CloudWatch logging."

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the environment (e.g. dev, prod). Used in Cloud Map namespace."
    Default: "dev"
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the ECS service and Cloud Map service."
    Default: "my-service"
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Description: "Container image URL/name to run."
    Default: "nginx:latest"
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Port the container exposes."
    Default: 80
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Description: "CPU units for the Fargate task."
    Default: "256"
    AllowedPattern: "^(256|512|1024|2048|4096)$"
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Description: "Memory (MiB) for the Fargate task."
    Default: "512"
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Desired number of running tasks."
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional ARN of a custom IAM role for the containers to assume. If empty, a default task role is created."
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, ""]]
  UseDefaultTaskRole: !Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, ""]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Cluster and Security
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group allowing containers within the VPC to communicate."
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-container-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TaskExecutionCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${CloudWatchLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Condition: UseDefaultTaskRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DefaultTaskAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 14

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cloud Map Service Discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}.internal"
      Description: !Sub "Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment."
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Task Definition and Service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task"
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          Port: !Ref ContainerPort

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: ECSService
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${ECSCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceAutoscaleRole

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleDown"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalingTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-ScaleUp"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalingTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleDownAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scales ${ServiceName} down when average CPU utilization <= 20%."
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold

  ScaleUpAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Scales ${ServiceName} up in stages when average CPU utilization >= 70%."
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

Outputs:
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: "Name of the ECS cluster."
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: "Name of the ECS service."
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  CloudMapNamespaceName:
    Description: "Private Cloud Map DNS namespace."
    Value: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
  ServiceDiscoveryDnsName:
    Description: "DNS name for service discovery."
    Value: !Sub "${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal"
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Description: "Log group used by the container."
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroup
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID created by this stack."
    Value: !Ref VPC

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS network backbone designed for hybrid interconnect
  demonstrations with an OCI primary region. Includes a VPC, internet gateway,
  private subnet, transit gateway, security group, VPC flow logs with KMS
  encryption, and conditional VPN resources for OCI connectivity.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Internal CIDR allowed for HTTPS inbound to the security group
  OCICIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.16.0.0/12
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR for HTTPS outbound and TGW routing
  CreateVPN:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a VPN connection to OCI
  OCIBgpAsn:
    Type: String
    Default: '64512'
    Description: BGP ASN for the OCI customer gateway
  CGWPublicIP:
    Type: String
    Default: '203.0.113.1'
    Description: >
      Public IP address of the OCI customer gateway (default is a placeholder)

Conditions:
  CreateVPNResources:
    !Equals [!Ref CreateVPN, 'true']

Resources:
  # ==========================================================================
  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs (customer-managed, with rotation enabled)
  # ==========================================================================
  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC flow log encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs and CloudWatch Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-log-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  # ==========================================================================
  # VPC
  # ==========================================================================
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridInterconnectVPC

  # ==========================================================================
  # Internet Gateway
  # ==========================================================================
  IGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridInterconnectIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref IGW

  # ==========================================================================
  # Private Subnet (first availability zone)
  # ==========================================================================
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet

  # ==========================================================================
  # Route Table with Default Route via IGW
  # ==========================================================================
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref IGW

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet

  # ==========================================================================
  # Transit Gateway
  # ==========================================================================
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridTGW

  # Transit Gateway VPC Attachment
  TGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VpcAttachment

  # ==========================================================================
  # Security Group
  # ==========================================================================
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for hybrid interconnect with OCI
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridSG

  # HTTPS inbound from configurable internal CIDR
  SGIngressHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR

  # HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone CIDR
  SGEgressHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref OCICIDR

  # ==========================================================================
  # VPC Flow Logs (CloudWatch Logs with 30-day retention, KMS encrypted)
  # ==========================================================================
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - kms:Encrypt*
                  - kms:Decrypt*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs/hybrid-interconnect
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKey

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPCFlowLog

  # ==========================================================================
  # Conditional VPN Resources for OCI Connectivity
  # ==========================================================================
  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: !Ref OCIBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref CGWPublicIP
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCICustomerGateway

  # VPN Connection to OCI with static routes only
  VPNConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCIVPN

  # VPC Route for OCI Traffic via Transit Gateway (conditional)
  OCIVPCRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNResources
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCICIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained infrastructure for a QuickSight admin console data preparation
  pipeline. Provisions an encrypted S3 bucket (name includes the AWS account
  ID), an IAM role for the pipeline, five Python AWS Glue jobs (three Python
  shell and two Spark ETL), one scheduled Glue trigger per job (every 3 hours),
  Glue Data Catalog resources for CloudTrail logs, and stack outputs for
  downstream consumption.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Encryption key used for the S3 bucket and Glue job data
  ##############################################################################
  DataPrepKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Encryption key for the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAwsServicesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataPrepKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-data-prep'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataPrepKey

  ##############################################################################
  # S3 bucket (bucket name incorporates the AWS account ID)
  ##############################################################################
  DataPrepBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataPrepKey.Arn
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7

  DataPrepBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataPrepBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataPrepBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DataPrepBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role used by the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline
  ##############################################################################
  DataPrepRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-data-prep-role'
      Description: Role assumed by Glue and CloudFormation for the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSGlueConsoleFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess'

  DataPrepRoleQuickSightPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: QuickSightFullAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref DataPrepRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'quicksight:*'
            Resource: '*'

  DataPrepRoleAssumeRolesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AssumeServiceRoles
      Roles:
        - !Ref DataPrepRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/glue/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cloudformation/*'

  DataPrepRoleKmsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: KmsAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref DataPrepRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
            Resource: !GetAtt DataPrepKey.Arn

  ##############################################################################
  # Glue security configuration (encrypts job data at rest)
  ##############################################################################
  GlueSecurityConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::Glue::SecurityConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-glue-security-config'
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        S3Encryptions:
          - S3EncryptionMode: SSE-KMS
            KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataPrepKey.Arn
        CloudWatchEncryption:
          CloudWatchEncryptionMode: SSE-KMS
          KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataPrepKey.Arn
        JobBookmarksEncryption:
          JobBookmarksEncryptionMode: CSE-KMS
          KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataPrepKey.Arn

  ##############################################################################
  # Glue Data Catalog resources for CloudTrail logs
  ##############################################################################
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}_quicksight_admin_console'
        Description: Data Catalog database for the QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline

  CloudTrailLogTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: cloudtrail_logs
        Description: CloudTrail log records used to derive QuickSight object access
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: cloudtrail
          EXTERNAL: 'TRUE'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/cloudtrail/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.openx.data.jsonserde.JsonSerDe
          Columns:
            - Name: eventversion
              Type: string
            - Name: useridentity
              Type: struct<type:string,principalid:string,arn:string,accountid:string,accesskeyid:string,username:string>
            - Name: eventtime
              Type: string
            - Name: eventsource
              Type: string
            - Name: eventname
              Type: string
            - Name: awsregion
              Type: string
            - Name: sourceipaddress
              Type: string
            - Name: useragent
              Type: string
            - Name: requestid
              Type: string
            - Name: eventid
              Type: string
            - Name: eventtype
              Type: string

  # NOTE: the Glue job scripts are loaded from the following predefined location
  # inside the data preparation bucket:
  #   s3://<DataPrepBucket>/scripts/<job_name>.py

  ##############################################################################
  # Glue jobs - three Python shell jobs (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  ##############################################################################
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-group-membership'
      Description: Exports QuickSight group membership data
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/group_membership.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/group-membership/'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-assets'
      Description: Exports QuickSight folder asset data
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-assets/'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-lookup'
      Description: Builds the QuickSight folder lookup table
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_lookup.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-lookup/'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration

  ##############################################################################
  # Glue jobs - two Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X workers)
  ##############################################################################
  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-object-access'
      Description: Processes CloudTrail logs to derive QuickSight object access
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/object_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-glue-datacatalog': 'true'
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/object-access/'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-path'
      Description: Resolves QuickSight folder paths
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/scripts/folder_path.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-glue-datacatalog': 'true'
        '--output_path': !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-path/'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      SecurityConfiguration: !Ref GlueSecurityConfiguration

  ##############################################################################
  # Scheduled triggers - one per job, running every 3 hours
  ##############################################################################
  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-group-membership-trigger'
      Description: Runs the QuickSight group membership job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-object-access-trigger'
      Description: Runs the QuickSight object access job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-assets-trigger'
      Description: Runs the QuickSight folder assets job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-lookup-trigger'
      Description: Runs the QuickSight folder lookup job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-folder-path-trigger'
      Description: Runs the QuickSight folder path job every 3 hours
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 0/3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

##############################################################################
# Outputs for downstream use
##############################################################################
Outputs:

  DataPrepBucketName:
    Description: Name of the QuickSight admin console data preparation bucket
    Value: !Ref DataPrepBucket

  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight group membership data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/group-membership/'

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight object access data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/object-access/'

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder asset data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-assets/'

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for the QuickSight folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-lookup/'

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for QuickSight folder path data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/folder-path/'

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Glue Data Catalog table name for CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogTable

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location of the CloudTrail logs consumed by the pipeline
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket}/cloudtrail/'
