final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Complete EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds, tests, scans, distributes and
  deprecates custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMIs. The solution includes a
  custom component that downloads and executes a Chef recipe from an S3 bucket,
  an image recipe that uses the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI as the
  parent image, an infrastructure configuration that terminates instances on
  failure, a distribution configuration that shares the AMI with the current
  account in a target region, a daily scheduled image pipeline with image
  scanning and tests enabled, a lifecycle policy that deprecates AMIs based on
  age and tag selection, and a custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent
  and collects image metadata before the AMI is created.

Parameters:
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe-component
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Name of the Image Builder component that runs the Chef recipe.

  ComponentVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
    Description: Semantic version of the Chef recipe component.

  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-image-recipe
    Description: Name of the Image Builder image recipe.

  InfrastructureConfigurationName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-infrastructure-configuration
    Description: Name of the Image Builder infrastructure configuration.

  DistributionConfigurationName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-distribution-configuration
    Description: Name of the Image Builder distribution configuration.

  ImagePipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-image-pipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder image pipeline.

  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-lifecycle-policy
    Description: Name of the Image Builder lifecycle policy.

  BuildWorkflowName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-ami-build-workflow
    Description: Name of the custom Image Builder build workflow.

  ParentImage:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: >-
      Systems Manager parameter path of the parent image for the recipe.
      Defaults to the AWS public ECS-optimized parameter that always resolves to
      the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16000
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume in GiB.

  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io1
      - io2
    Description: Type of the root EBS volume.

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type used to build the AMI.

  ChefRecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe.tar.gz
    Description: S3 object key of the Chef recipe package inside the recipe bucket.

  LifecycleTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: managed
    Description: >-
      Value of the tag (key "Lifecycle") used by the lifecycle policy to select
      and deprecate AMIs.

  DeprecationAge:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Age, in days, after which matching AMIs are deprecated.

  BuildSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"
    Description: Schedule expression for the daily image pipeline run.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Region to which the resulting AMI is distributed.

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the Chef recipe bucket
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the Chef recipe S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: chef-recipe-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 bucket that stores the Chef recipe consumed by the build component
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ChefRecipeKmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chef-recipes"

  ChefRecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ChefRecipeBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role and instance profile used by the Image Builder build instances
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role"
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderInstances
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChefRecipeBucketReadOnlyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListRecipeBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ChefRecipeBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadRecipeObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: DecryptRecipeObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ChefRecipeKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role used by the lifecycle policy to deprecate AMIs
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-execution-role"
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder to execute the lifecycle policy.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicyPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImageUsageReportEntries
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetLifecycleExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageImageDeprecation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:EnableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:DisableImageDeprecation
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*::image/*"
              - Sid: QueryTaggedResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-execution-role"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom component: download and execute a Chef recipe from S3
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Version: !Ref ComponentVersion
      Description: >-
        Downloads a Chef recipe package from an S3 bucket and executes it during
        the image build.
      Platform: Linux
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeComponent
        description: Downloads and executes a Chef recipe from an S3 bucket.
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /opt/chef-recipe
                    - aws s3 cp s3://${ChefRecipeBucket}/${ChefRecipeKey} /opt/chef-recipe/recipe.tar.gz
                    - tar -xzf /opt/chef-recipe/recipe.tar.gz -C /opt/chef-recipe
                onFailure: Abort
              - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - cd /opt/chef-recipe && chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept
                onFailure: Abort
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chef-recipe-component"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom build workflow: update SSM agent and collect metadata before
  # the AMI is created
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderBuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref BuildWorkflowName
      Description: >-
        Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and collects image
        metadata before creating the AMI.
      Type: BUILD
      Version: !Ref ComponentVersion
      Data: |
        name: CustomBuildWorkflow
        description: Updates the SSM agent and collects image metadata before creating the AMI.
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        steps:
          - name: LaunchInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"
          - name: UpdateSsmAgent
            action: RunCommand
            inputs:
              documentName: "AWS-RunShellScript"
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchInstance.instanceId"
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                  - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                  - systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: CollectImageMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchInstance.instanceId"
          - name: CreateImage
            action: CreateImage
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchInstance.instanceId"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-build-workflow"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipe: latest AL2 ECS-optimized AMI with a sized root volume
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Version: !Ref ComponentVersion
      Description: >-
        Recipe that builds a custom AMI from the latest Amazon Linux 2
        ECS-optimized AMI using the Chef recipe component.
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImage
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-recipe"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure configuration: terminate instances on failure
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfrastructureConfigurationName
      Description: Infrastructure configuration that terminates build instances on failure.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure-configuration"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration: share the AMI with the current account in a
  # target region
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistributionConfigurationName
      Description: Shares the resulting AMI with the current account in a target region.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI built by EC2 Image Builder.
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ami"
              Lifecycle: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
            TargetAccountIds:
              - !Ref AWS::AccountId
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-distribution-configuration"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image pipeline: daily schedule, image scanning and tests enabled
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImagePipelineName
      Description: >-
        Scheduled pipeline that builds, tests and scans the custom Amazon Linux
        2 ECS-optimized AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageBuilderImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref BuildSchedule
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Workflows:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderBuildWorkflow
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-pipeline"

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle policy: deprecate AMIs based on age and tag selection
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: Deprecates custom AMIs based on age and tag selection.
      Status: ENABLED
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Lifecycle: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref DeprecationAge
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: 1
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-policy"

Outputs:
  ChefRecipeBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores the Chef recipe package.
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket

  ChefRecipeComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom Chef recipe Image Builder component.
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderImageRecipe

  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder image pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderImagePipeline

  BuildWorkflowArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom Image Builder build workflow.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderBuildWorkflow

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy

  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile used by Image Builder build instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Content-level PII classification scanner for files exposed through an S3
  Access Point. The scanner Lambda uses Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities to
  identify sensitive data, stores per-file classification reports in a DynamoDB
  table, and optionally publishes a summary notification to SNS. The Lambda runs
  outside a VPC by default (works for internet-origin access points); when the
  access point is VPC-scoped the caller supplies the VPC, subnet, security group
  and route table IDs and the function is deployed inside that VPC with optional
  S3 / DynamoDB / Comprehend / SNS VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  AccessPointName:
    Type: String
    Default: pii-scan-ap
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,48}[a-z0-9]$"
    Description: Name of the S3 Access Point that exposes the files to scan.

  ScanPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional key prefix within the access point to limit scanning.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      VPC ID to deploy the scanner Lambda into when the access point is
      VPC-scoped. Leave empty to run the function outside any VPC.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Comma-separated subnet IDs (private subnets with NAT or VPC endpoints)
      used when the access point is VPC-scoped.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Security group ID attached to the Lambda and interface endpoints.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Comma-separated route table IDs for the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: >
      When a VPC ID is supplied, create the S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend and SNS VPC
      endpoints. Set to false if the target VPC already has any of these four
      endpoints to avoid duplicate endpoint conflicts.

  EnableNotifications:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable SNS notifications with a scan summary.

  LanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues:
      - en
      - es
      - fr
      - de
      - it
      - pt
      - ar
      - hi
      - ja
      - ko
      - zh
      - zh-TW
    Description: Default Amazon Comprehend language code for DetectPiiEntities.

  MaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Default maximum number of files to scan per invocation.

  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Memory (MB) allocated to the scanner Lambda function.

  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Timeout (seconds) for the scanner Lambda function.

  ReportTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: pii-classification-reports
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores classification reports.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention for the scanner function.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, "true"]

Resources:
  ContentBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireObjects
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  ContentBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContentBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ContentBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ContentBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  AccessPoint:
    Type: AWS::S3::AccessPoint
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ContentBucket
      Name: !Ref AccessPointName
      NetworkOrigin: !If [HasVpc, VPC, Internet]
      VpcConfiguration: !If
        - HasVpc
        - VpcId: !Ref VpcId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for PII scanner data at rest
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Describe*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSnsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref ReportTableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reportId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: fileKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reportId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: fileKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-scan-notifications"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-scanner"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner-role"
      Description: Execution role for the PII classification scanner Lambda
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pii-scanner-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-scanner:*"
              - Sid: ReadAccessPointOrigin
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
              - Sid: ReadAccessPointObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
                  - !Sub "${AccessPoint.Arn}/object/*"
                  - !GetAtt ContentBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ContentBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: DetectPiiEntities
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: UseKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ScanNotificationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: pii-scanner-sns-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ScannerRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: PublishNotifications
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [",", !Ref RouteTableIds]

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds: !Split [",", !Ref SecurityGroupId]

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds: !Split [",", !Ref SecurityGroupId]

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ScannerLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-scanner"
      Description: Scans S3 Access Point content for PII with Amazon Comprehend
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref ReportTable
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !GetAtt AccessPoint.Arn
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME: !Ref AccessPointName
          SCAN_PREFIX: !Ref ScanPrefix
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref NotificationTopic
          ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS: !Ref EnableNotifications
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref LanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFiles
          VPC_ENABLED: !If [HasVpc, "true", "false"]
          CHUNK_BYTES: "90000"
          CHUNK_OVERLAP: "256"
          SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES: "1000000"
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Split [",", !Ref SubnetIds]
          SecurityGroupIds: !Split [",", !Ref SecurityGroupId]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          import uuid
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3
          from botocore.config import Config
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          REPORT_TABLE = os.environ["REPORT_TABLE"]
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_ARN"]
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME = os.environ.get("ACCESS_POINT_NAME", "")
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get("SNS_TOPIC_ARN", "")
          ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS = os.environ.get("ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS", "true").lower() == "true"
          DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE_CODE", "en")
          DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_FILES", "500"))
          DEFAULT_PREFIX = os.environ.get("SCAN_PREFIX", "")
          CHUNK_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("CHUNK_BYTES", "90000"))
          CHUNK_OVERLAP = int(os.environ.get("CHUNK_OVERLAP", "256"))
          SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES", "1000000"))
          VPC_ENABLED = os.environ.get("VPC_ENABLED", "false").lower() == "true"

          BOTO_CONFIG = Config(retries={"max_attempts": 5, "mode": "standard"})
          S3 = boto3.client("s3", config=BOTO_CONFIG)
          S3CONTROL = boto3.client("s3control", config=BOTO_CONFIG)
          COMPREHEND = boto3.client("comprehend", config=BOTO_CONFIG)
          SNS = boto3.client("sns", config=BOTO_CONFIG)
          DYNAMODB = boto3.resource("dynamodb", config=BOTO_CONFIG)
          TABLE = DYNAMODB.Table(REPORT_TABLE)


          def _account_id(context):
              try:
                  return context.invoked_function_arn.split(":")[4]
              except Exception:
                  return boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]


          def check_network_origin(context):
              try:
                  response = S3CONTROL.get_access_point(
                      AccountId=_account_id(context), Name=ACCESS_POINT_NAME
                  )
                  origin = response.get("NetworkOrigin", "Internet")
              except ClientError as exc:
                  LOGGER.warning("Could not read access point network origin: %s", exc)
                  return "Unknown"
              LOGGER.info("Access point %s network origin is %s", ACCESS_POINT_NAME, origin)
              if origin == "VPC" and not VPC_ENABLED:
                  LOGGER.warning(
                      "Access point is VPC-scoped but the function is outside a VPC. "
                      "Deploy with VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds."
                  )
              return origin


          def list_object_samples(prefix, max_files):
              samples = []
              token = None
              while True:
                  kwargs = {"Bucket": ACCESS_POINT_ARN, "MaxKeys": 1000}
                  if prefix:
                      kwargs["Prefix"] = prefix
                  if token:
                      kwargs["ContinuationToken"] = token
                  response = S3.list_objects_v2(**kwargs)
                  for obj in response.get("Contents", []):
                      samples.append({"key": obj["Key"], "size": obj["Size"]})
                      if len(samples) >= max_files:
                          return samples
                  if not response.get("IsTruncated"):
                      break
                  token = response.get("NextContinuationToken")
              return samples


          def read_sample(key, size):
              if size <= SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES:
                  return S3.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key)["Body"].read()
              half = max(1, SAMPLE_MAX_BYTES // 2)
              head = S3.get_object(
                  Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key, Range="bytes=0-%d" % (half - 1)
              )["Body"].read()
              start = max(0, size - half)
              tail = S3.get_object(
                  Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key, Range="bytes=%d-%d" % (start, size - 1)
              )["Body"].read()
              return head + b"\n...(sampled)...\n" + tail


          def chunk_bytes(data):
              step = max(1, CHUNK_BYTES - CHUNK_OVERLAP)
              offset = 0
              total = len(data)
              while offset < total:
                  yield data[offset:offset + CHUNK_BYTES]
                  if offset + CHUNK_BYTES >= total:
                      break
                  offset += step


          def detect_pii(text, language_code):
              entities = {}
              try:
                  response = COMPREHEND.detect_pii_entities(
                      Text=text, LanguageCode=language_code
                  )
              except ClientError as exc:
                  LOGGER.warning("DetectPiiEntities failed: %s", exc)
                  return entities, 0
              for entity in response.get("Entities", []):
                  etype = entity.get("Type", "UNKNOWN")
                  entities[etype] = entities.get(etype, 0) + 1
              return entities, len(response.get("Entities", []))


          def scan_file(record, language_code):
              key = record["key"]
              size = record["size"]
              result = {
                  "fileKey": key,
                  "size": size,
                  "entityTypes": {},
                  "entityCount": 0,
                  "chunks": 0,
                  "status": "SCANNED",
              }
              try:
                  raw = read_sample(key, size)
              except ClientError as exc:
                  LOGGER.warning("Unable to read %s: %s", key, exc)
                  result["status"] = "READ_ERROR"
                  return result
              for piece in chunk_bytes(raw):
                  text = piece.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                  if not text.strip():
                      continue
                  types, count = detect_pii(text, language_code)
                  result["chunks"] += 1
                  result["entityCount"] += count
                  for etype, value in types.items():
                      result["entityTypes"][etype] = (
                          result["entityTypes"].get(etype, 0) + value
                      )
              result["status"] = "PII_FOUND" if result["entityCount"] else "NO_PII"
              return result


          def handler(event, context):
              event = event or {}
              scan_id = event.get("scan_id") or str(uuid.uuid4())
              prefix = event.get("prefix", DEFAULT_PREFIX)
              max_files = int(event.get("max_files", DEFAULT_MAX_FILES))
              language_code = event.get("language_code", DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE)

              network_origin = check_network_origin(context)
              started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              records = list_object_samples(prefix, max_files)
              summary = {
                  "reportId": scan_id,
                  "fileKey": "__SUMMARY__",
                  "scanType": "summary",
                  "accessPoint": ACCESS_POINT_NAME,
                  "prefix": prefix,
                  "networkOrigin": network_origin,
                  "languageCode": language_code,
                  "maxFiles": max_files,
                  "filesScanned": 0,
                  "filesWithPii": 0,
                  "totalEntities": 0,
                  "startedAt": started_at,
                  "status": "COMPLETED",
              }

              for record in records:
                  file_result = scan_file(record, language_code)
                  summary["filesScanned"] += 1
                  summary["totalEntities"] += file_result["entityCount"]
                  if file_result["status"] == "PII_FOUND":
                      summary["filesWithPii"] += 1
                  TABLE.put_item(
                      Item={
                          "reportId": scan_id,
                          "fileKey": record["key"],
                          "scanType": "file",
                          "size": file_result["size"],
                          "entityTypes": file_result["entityTypes"],
                          "entityCount": file_result["entityCount"],
                          "chunks": file_result["chunks"],
                          "status": file_result["status"],
                          "languageCode": language_code,
                          "networkOrigin": network_origin,
                          "scannedAt": started_at,
                      }
                  )

              summary["completedAt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              TABLE.put_item(Item=summary)

              if ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS and SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  try:
                      SNS.publish(
                          TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN,
                          Subject="PII scan %s complete" % scan_id,
                          Message=json.dumps(summary, default=str),
                      )
                  except ClientError as exc:
                      LOGGER.warning("SNS publish failed: %s", exc)

              LOGGER.info("Scan %s complete: %s", scan_id, json.dumps(summary, default=str))
              return summary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "PiBot Cognito Authentication – Main Web App & IoT Provisioning Setups"

###############################################################################
# MAIN WEB APP – Cognito + Identity Pool + IAM Roles
###############################################################################
Resources:

  # ── User Pool ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MainWebUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-user-pool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # ── User Pool Client ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MainWebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainWebUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # ── Identity Pool (unauthenticated access allowed) ───────────────────────
  MainWebIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt MainWebUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref MainWebUserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  # ── IAM Roles (Authenticated & Unauthenticated) ──────────────────────────

  # Authenticated role – broad IoT, Kinesis Video, Rekognition, Cognito, Analytics
  MainWebAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-auth-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: main-web-auth-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              # IoT operations
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:ListThings
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: "*"
              # Kinesis Video streams
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:UpdateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:DeleteStream
                Resource: "*"
              # Rekognition label detection
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectCustomLabels
                  - rekognition:ListCollections
                  - rekognition:SearchFacesByImage
                  - rekognition:IndexFaces
                  - rekognition:CompareFaces
                Resource: "*"
              # Cognito user pool actions
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:GetUser
                  - cognito-idp:GetIdToken
                  - cognito-idp:GetAccessToken
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPool
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:UpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: "*"
              # Mobile Analytics
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - mobileanalytics:GetReports
                  - mobileanalytics:GetFinancialReports
                Resource: "*"

  # Unauthenticated role – same broad set of actions for guest/exploratory use
  MainWebUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-unauth-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainWebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: main-web-unauth-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:DescribeEndpoint
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:GetUser
                  - cognito-idp:GetIdToken
                  - cognito-idp:GetAccessToken
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPool
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # ── Attach Roles to Identity Pool ────────────────────────────────────────
  MainWebIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainWebIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainWebUnauthRole.Arn

###############################################################################
# PROVISIONING SETUP – Cognito + Identity Pool + IAM Roles
# (IoT trusted user provisioning)
###############################################################################

  # ── User Pool ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-user-pool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # ── User Pool Client ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # ── Identity Pool (unauthenticated access allowed) ───────────────────────
  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  # ── IAM Roles ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Authenticated role – IoT trusted user provisioning actions
  ProvisioningAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-auth-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: provisioning-auth-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:CreateProvisioningClaim
                  - iot:CreateProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:CreateProvisioningTemplateVersion
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplateVersion
                  - iot:ListProvisioningTemplates
                  - iot:ListProvisioningTemplateVersions
                  - iot:DeleteProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:DeleteProvisioningTemplateVersion
                  - iot:UpdateProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:RegisterCertificateWithoutCA
                  - iot:CreateCertificateFromCsr
                Resource: "*"

  # Unauthenticated role – limited read-only provisioning access
  ProvisioningUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-unauth-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: provisioning-unauth-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:ListProvisioningTemplates
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplateVersion
                Resource: "*"

  # ── Attach Roles to Identity Pool ────────────────────────────────────────
  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningUnauthRole.Arn

###############################################################################
# OUTPUTS
###############################################################################
Outputs:

  # Main Web App outputs
  MainWebUserPoolId:
    Description: "Main web app Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref MainWebUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-user-pool-id"

  MainWebUserPoolClientId:
    Description: "Main web app Cognito User Pool Client ID"
    Value: !Ref MainWebUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-client-id"

  MainWebIdentityPoolId:
    Description: "Main web app Cognito Identity Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref MainWebIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-main-web-identity-pool-id"

  # Provisioning outputs
  ProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: "Provisioning Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-user-pool-id"

  ProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: "Provisioning Cognito User Pool Client ID"
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-client-id"

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: "Provisioning Cognito Identity Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-provisioning-identity-pool-id"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Public Route 53 hosted zone for radiotopia.fm with the production DNS record
  set (SPF/DMARC/MX, apex and www hosting records, CloudFront-backed alias
  records, ACM validation records, and third-party mail/marketing verification
  and DKIM records) together with the dedicated CloudFront distributions and
  origins those alias records target.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route 53 hosted zone
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for radiotopia.fm

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex TXT: SPF policy + domain ownership verification tokens + third-party
  # mail/marketing verification strings (all apex TXT values live in the single
  # record set Route 53 permits per name/type).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: radiotopia.fm
      Type: TXT
      TTL: "300"
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:cmail1.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"'
        - '"google-site-verification=G0vXaZ7RadiotopiaGoogleOwnershipToken01"'
        - '"apple-domain-verification=AppleRadiotopiaDomainOwnershipToken02"'
        - '"zendesk-verification=zendeskRadiotopiaVerificationToken03"'
        - '"mailchimp-domain-verification=mailchimpRadiotopiaVerificationToken04"'
        - '"squarespace-domain-verification=squarespaceRadiotopiaVerificationToken05"'
        - '"campaignmonitor-verification=campaignmonitorRadiotopiaVerificationToken06"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMARC TXT record (reject policy)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: _dmarc.radiotopia.fm
      Type: TXT
      TTL: "300"
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm; ruf=mailto:dmarc@radiotopia.fm; fo=1"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MX record set for the hosted (Google Workspace) mail provider
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration – Protein Variant Effect Prediction'

##########################################
# Parameters
##########################################
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional gateway name. Auto-generated from ProjectName if left blank.
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function for protein variant effect prediction.
    Default: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:000000000000:function:placeholder-lambda
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws[a-z-]*:lambda:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:function:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$
  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: String
    Description: Cognito JWT issuer/discovery URL for the custom JWT authorizer.
    Default: https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/placeholder-user-pool
  CognitoClientId:
    Type: String
    Description: Cognito client ID for the custom JWT authorizer.
    Default: placeholder-client-id
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_+-]+$

##########################################
# Conditions
##########################################
Conditions:
  UseGeneratedGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

##########################################
# Resources
##########################################
Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for Bedrock AgentCore – grants invoke Lambda permission
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter – stores the gateway IAM role ARN
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/agentcore-gateway/role-arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
      Description: IAM role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore Gateway – HTTP API (API Gateway V2)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - UseGeneratedGatewayName
        - !Sub ${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway
        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins:
          - '*'
        AllowMethods:
          - POST
          - GET
        AllowHeaders:
          - content-type
          - authorization
        MaxAge: 86400

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom JWT Authorizer – references Cognito via SSM-resolved values
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  JwtAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - $request.header.Authorization
      JwtConfiguration:
        Issuer: !Ref CognitoDiscoveryUrl
        Audience:
          - !Ref CognitoClientId
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-cognito-jwt-authorizer

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway Target – Integration connecting the gateway to the Lambda
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub
        - arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaArn}/invocations
        - LambdaArn: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 30000

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route – catch-all proxy route protected by JWT
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      RouteKey: ANY /{proxy+}
      AuthorizerId: !Ref JwtAuthorizer
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      Target: !Sub integrations/${GatewayIntegration}

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stage – v1 deployment with access logging
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      StageName: v1
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt AccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: $context.requestId

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Log Group for gateway access logs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vendedlogs/apis/${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda permission – allows API Gateway to invoke the Lambda
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${GatewayId}/*/*/{proxy+}
        - GatewayId: !Ref AgentCoreGateway

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter – MCP inline tool schema (invoke_endpoint, get_results)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpToolSchemaParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub /${ProjectName}/agentcore-gateway/mcp-tool-schema
      Type: String
      Value: >
        {
          "tools": [
            {
              "name": "invoke_endpoint",
              "description": "Submit a protein sequence for variant effect prediction",
              "inputSchema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "sequence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Protein amino acid sequence to analyze"
                  },
                  "variants": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": { "type": "string" },
                    "description": "List of amino acid variants to evaluate, e.g. A123V"
                  }
                },
                "required": ["sequence", "variants"]
              }
            },
            {
              "name": "get_results",
              "description": "Retrieve the results of a completed prediction job",
              "inputSchema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "job_id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Unique job identifier returned by invoke_endpoint"
                  }
                },
                "required": ["job_id"]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      Description: MCP inline tool schema defining invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

##########################################
# Outputs
##########################################
Outputs:
  GatewayApiEndpoint:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub https://${AgentCoreGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/v1/
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for Bedrock AgentCore
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the gateway role ARN
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreRoleArnParameter
  McpToolSchemaParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name storing the MCP tool schema
    Value: !Ref McpToolSchemaParameter
  GatewayApiId:
    Description: AgentCore Gateway API ID
    Value: !Ref AgentCoreGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Private VPC infrastructure with three private subnets (two for an Application
  Load Balancer in different AZs, one for Lambda functions), optional internet
  egress via a NAT Gateway, DNS support, and a customer-managed KMS key (retained
  on delete) for encrypting the artifact storage bucket.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
  AlbSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
  AlbSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet that hosts the NAT Gateway.
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$
  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Enable internet egress via a NAT Gateway for the private subnets.

Conditions:
  CreateNat: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support enabled.
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # Private subnet for the first ALB AZ.
  AlbSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-a'

  # Private subnet for the second ALB AZ (ALB requires subnets in different AZs).
  AlbSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-b'

  # Private subnet dedicated to Lambda functions.
  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-subnet'

  # Private route table for the private subnets.
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Stack containing a Step Functions state machine with a two-step pass workflow,
  two API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) integrated to start state machine
  executions, each with its own IAM role and stage deployment.

Resources:

  # ── Step Functions State Machine ──────────────────────────────────────────

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: TwoStepPassWorkflow
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub: |
          {
            "Comment": "A simple two-step pass workflow",
            "StartAt": "FirstPass",
            "States": {
              "FirstPass": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "Next": "SecondPass"
              },
              "SecondPass": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*

  # ── IAM Role for GET API (allows API Gateway to start executions) ────────

  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  # ── IAM Role for POST API (allows API Gateway to start executions) ───────

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  # ── GET API Gateway ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: GetApi
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts the state machine

  GetApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      HttpMethod: GET
      ResourceId: !Ref GetApiResource
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        Uri:
          Fn::Sub: arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub: |
              {
                "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}",
                "input": "{}"
              }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: Prod
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment

  # ── POST API Gateway ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostApi
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts the state machine

  PostApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      HttpMethod: POST
      ResourceId: !Ref PostApiResource
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        Uri:
          Fn::Sub: arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub: |
              {
                "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}",
                "input": "{}"
              }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: Dev
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment

  # ── Outputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET API (Prod stage)
    Value: !Sub https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/Prod/execute

  PostApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST API (Dev stage)
    Value: !Sub https://${PostApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/Dev/execute

  GetApiRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the GET API
    Value: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn

  PostApiRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the POST API
    Value: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
