AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  SQS audit queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ for non-dev environments,
  CloudWatch alarms, and SNS notification alerts.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - non-dev
    Default: non-dev
    Description: Environment type. DLQ is created only for non-dev.

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    Description: Email address to receive SNS alarm notifications.

Mappings:
  QueueConfigMap:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 86400           # 1 day
      VisibilityTimeout: 30                   # 30 seconds
    non-dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600          # 4 days
      VisibilityTimeout: 120                  # 2 minutes

Conditions:
  CreateDLQ: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentType, non-dev]

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key with automatic yearly rotation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditQueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS audit queue encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SNS Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false

  AuditQueueKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/audit-sqs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dead Letter Queue (conditional)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub audit-dlq-${AWS::StackName}
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600         # 14 days – retain failed messages longer
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  DeadLetterQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref DeadLetterQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSQSFromAuditQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Ref AuditQueue

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main Audit Queue
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub audit-events-${AWS::StackName}
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap
        - QueueConfigMap
        - !Ref EnvironmentType
        - MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap
        - QueueConfigMap
        - !Ref EnvironmentType
        - VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateDLQ
          - {"deadLetterTargetArn": !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn, "maxReceiveCount": 5}
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS Topic for Alarm Notifications
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub audit-alarms-${AWS::StackName}
      DisplayName: Audit Queue Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey

  AlarmNotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Alarms
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  OldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Cognito infrastructure for researchapp/AgentCore application – creates a user pool
  with MFA (software token), email-as-username, admin/customer groups, two app clients,
  a custom resource server with read scope, a Lambda helper function, and SSM Parameter
  Store entries for all relevant OAuth/OIDC endpoints and identifiers.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User Pool Groups
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource Server (custom OAuth scopes)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore
      Name: researchapp-agentcore-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp AgentCore resources

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web App Client (authorization code flow)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - phone
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Machine-to-Machine Client (client credentials flow)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp-agentcore/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Hosted UI Domain
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "raac-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Execution Role
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-group-management
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${CognitoUserPool}"

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Function – Add new users to the Customer group
  # (Not wired as an active trigger; intended to be invoked manually or via SDK)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-add-to-customer-group"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref CognitoUserPool
          GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
              group_name = os.environ['GROUP_NAME']
              username = event.get('username')

              if not username:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'username is required'})
                  }

              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      GroupName=group_name,
                      Username=username
                  )
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': f'User {username} added to {group_name} group',
                          'username': username,
                          'group': group_name
                      })
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Parameter Store – all relevant configuration under /app/researchapp/agentcore/
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/UserPoolId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  WebAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/WebAppClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  MachineAppClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineAppClientId
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

  MachineAppClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineAppClientSecret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret

  OAuthScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/OAuthScopes
      Type: String
      Value: "phone,email,openid,profile,researchapp-agentcore/read"

  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/DiscoveryUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  TokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/TokenUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${CognitoDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

  AuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/AuthorizeUrl
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${CognitoDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/CognitoDomain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${CognitoDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CryptoTickerAPI - Self-contained GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker
  data using AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and the CoinGecko HTTP API.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # 1. DynamoDB Table – stores historical price records
  # ============================================================================
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  # ============================================================================
  # 2. IAM Role – assumed by AppSync to access DynamoDB
  # ============================================================================
  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  # ============================================================================
  # 3. AppSync GraphQL API
  # ============================================================================
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # ============================================================================
  # 4. GraphQL Schema
  # ============================================================================
  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceInUSD: Float!
          timestamp: AWSTimestamp!
          priceHistory(nextToken: String, limit: Int): TickerConnection
        }

        type TickerConnection {
          items: [TickerInfo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  # ============================================================================
  # 5. Data Sources
  # ============================================================================
  CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ============================================================================
  # 6. AppSync Functions (used by the pipeline resolver on Query.ticker)
  # ============================================================================
  GetPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - Schema
      - CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: GetPriceFromCoinGecko
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoHTTPDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": $util.toJson($ctx.args.symbol),
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($coinId = $ctx.args.symbol)
        #set($data = $ctx.result.data)
        #set($price = $data.get($coinId).usd)
        #if(!$price)
          $util.error("Price not found for symbol: $coinId")
        #end
        {
          "ticker": "$coinId",
          "priceInUSD": $price,
          "timestamp": $util.time.nowEpochSeconds()
        }

  StorePriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - Schema
      - DynamoDBDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceRecord
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($item = $ctx.prev.result)
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": { "S": "TICKER#$item.ticker" },
            "sk": { "S": "TIMESTAMP#$item.timestamp" }
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": { "S": "$item.ticker" },
            "priceInUSD": { "N": "$item.priceInUSD" },
            "timestamp": { "N": "$item.timestamp" },
            "type": { "S": "PriceRecord" }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($item = $ctx.prev.result)
        {
          "ticker": "$item.ticker",
          "priceInUSD": $item.priceInUSD,
          "timestamp": $item.timestamp
        }

  # ============================================================================
  # 7. Resolvers
  # ============================================================================
  TickerQueryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - GetPriceFunction
      - StorePriceFunction
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref GetPriceFunction
          - !Ref StorePriceFunction
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - Schema
      - DynamoDBDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": { "S": "TICKER#$ctx.source.ticker" }
            }
          },
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken),
          "scanIndexForward": false
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
          #set($record = {})
          $util.qr($record.put("ticker", $item.ticker.S))
          $util.qr($record.put("priceInUSD", $util.parseNumber($item.priceInUSD.N)))
          $util.qr($record.put("timestamp", $util.parseNumber($item.timestamp.N)))
          $util.qr($items.add($record))
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })

  # ============================================================================
  # 8. Default API Key – created after the schema is defined
  # ============================================================================
  DefaultApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints.
  Optionally provisions IAM roles for live-to-VOD and VOD source bucket access.
  Supports user-supplied ArchiveBucket (sets endpoint origination to DENY) and
  VodSourceBucket for VOD workflows.

Parameters:
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      (Optional) S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. When provided,
      origin endpoints have origination set to DENY to support live-to-VOD workflows.
      When empty, origination is ALLOW.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      (Optional) S3 bucket name for VOD source content. When both ArchiveBucket and
      VodSourceBucket are provided, additional VOD IAM permissions are configured.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output type for streaming endpoints (informational tag).
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Base manifest name for the origin endpoints.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS origin endpoint.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints.
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveChannel
    Description: Prefix prepended to resource logical names and IDs.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value (e.g., dev, staging, prod).
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: Project
    Description: Custom tag key applied to all tagged resources.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveStreaming
    Description: Custom tag value applied to all tagged resources.

Conditions:
  # Determine if the ArchiveBucket parameter was provided
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  # Determine if the VodSourceBucket parameter was provided
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  # VOD workflows require both ArchiveBucket and VodSourceBucket
  EnableVodWorkflows: !And
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
  # When HasArchiveBucket is true, also create the IAM execution role
  CreateMediaPackageRole: !Condition HasArchiveBucket

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # MediaPackage Live Channel
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix} live streaming channel'
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-Channel'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - Key: OutputType
          Value: !Ref OutputType

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # HLS Origin Endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageOriginEndpointHls:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-HlsEndpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      ManifestName: !Sub '${ManifestName}-hls'
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - Key: OutputType
          Value: !Ref OutputType

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # DASH Origin Endpoint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageOriginEndpointDash:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-DashEndpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      ManifestName: !Sub '${ManifestName}-dash'
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
        - Key: OutputType
          Value: !Ref OutputType

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for MediaPackage S3 Access
  # Created only when ArchiveBucket is provided (live-to-VOD scenario)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaPackageS3AccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-MediaPackageS3Role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Permissions for the ArchiveBucket (live-to-VOD archive)
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
              # Permissions for VodSourceBucket (VOD source content)
              - !If
                - EnableVodWorkflows
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage channel ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  HlsOriginEndpointId:
    Description: HLS origin endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageOriginEndpointHls
  DashOriginEndpointId:
    Description: DASH origin endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageOriginEndpointDash
  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Description: HLS origin endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageOriginEndpointHls.Url
  DashEndpointUrl:
    Description: DASH origin endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageOriginEndpointDash.Url
  MediaPackageS3RoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for MediaPackage S3 access
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageRole
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageS3AccessRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  DynamoDB table with configurable partition key (default String 'id'),
  optional sort key (default Number), PROVISIONED billing (switchable to
  PAY_PER_REQUEST), point-in-time recovery enabled by default, optional
  KMS-backed server-side encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms
  (throttling + error rates) delivering to an SNS topic.

Parameters:

  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Default: MyApplicationTable

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition/hash key attribute.
    Default: id
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the partition key (S, N, or B).
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]

  SortKeyEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable a sort/range key (true / false).
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the sort/range key attribute (used when SortKeyEnabled is true).
    Default: sortKey
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Data type of the sort key (S, N, or B).
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: Billing mode for the table (PROVISIONED or PAY_PER_REQUEST).
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Read capacity units when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: Write capacity units when BillingMode is PROVISIONED.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery (true / false).
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  KmsKeyEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Enable server-side encryption with a customer-managed KMS key
      (true / false).  When true you must provide KmsKeyArn.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for SSE.  Required when
      KmsKeyEnabled is true.
    Default: ''

  AlarmsEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Enable CloudWatch alarms (ThrottledRequests, SystemErrors,
      UserErrors) and an SNS topic for notifications (true / false).
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Email address to subscribe to the SNS alarm topic.  Optional;
      if left empty the topic is created without subscriptions.
    Default: ''

Conditions:

  HasSortKey: !Equals [!Ref SortKeyEnabled, 'true']
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  UseKmsEncryption: !Equals [!Ref KmsKeyEnabled, 'true']
  UseAlarms: !Equals [!Ref AlarmsEnabled, 'true']
  UsePitr: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        -
          - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        -
          - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        -
          - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        -
          - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - UsePitr
        -
          PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        -
          ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseKmsEncryption
        -
          SSEEnabled: true
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKeyArn
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for SNS topic encryption (only when AlarmsEnabled is true)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopicKey:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for SNS alarm topic of DynamoDB table ${TableName}'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${TableName}-AlarmTopicKey'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS topic for alarm notifications (only when AlarmsEnabled is true)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${TableName}-AlarmTopic'
      TopicName: !Sub '${TableName}-AlarmTopic'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Subscription: !If
        - HasAlarmEmail
        -
          - Protocol: email
            Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch alarms (only when AlarmsEnabled is true)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Throttled requests on DynamoDB table ${TableName} exceed zero'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      InsufficientDataActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'System errors on DynamoDB table ${TableName} exceed zero'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      InsufficientDataActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'User errors on DynamoDB table ${TableName} exceed zero'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      InsufficientDataActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]

Outputs:

  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS alarm topic (only present when AlarmsEnabled is true).
    Value: !If [UseAlarms, !Ref AlarmTopic, !Ref AWS::NoValue]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86 & arm64)

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    Description: Version string for components and recipes (x.x.x format)
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root volume size in GB for the AMI
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 500
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-aaaaaaaaaa
    Description: AWS Organizations ID for sharing AMIs with the entire organization
    AllowedPattern: ^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
  ParentImageX86:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon-linux-2023-x86-*
    Description: Parent image for x86 recipe (AMI ID, name pattern, or ARN)
  ParentImageArm64:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon-linux-2023-arm64-*
    Description: Parent image for arm64 recipe (AMI ID, name pattern, or ARN)
  InstanceTypeX86:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for x86 image builds
  InstanceTypeArm64:
    Type: String
    Default: t4g.medium
    Description: EC2 instance type for arm64 image builds

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (required by InfrastructureConfiguration in greenfield accounts)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-igw

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  ImageBuilderSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-subnet

  ImageBuilderRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rtb

  ImageBuilderRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  ImageBuilderSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-instance-role

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderServiceRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-service-role

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Components
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-software-install
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        name: SoftwareInstall
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - curl -L "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-software-component

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-test
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        name: TestSoftware
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-test-component

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-recipe-x86
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageX86
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-recipe-x86

  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-recipe-arm64
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-recipe-arm64

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure Configuration (shared across both pipelines)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-infra
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for Image Builder pipelines
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceTypeX86
        - !Ref InstanceTypeArm64
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderSubnet
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-infra
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-infra

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution Configuration (single, with public & org sharing)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-distribution
      Description: Distributes AMIs publicly and shares with the AWS Organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:image_version }}-{{ imagebuilder:architecture }}
            Description: !Sub Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI built by ${AWS::StackName}
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-distribution

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Pipelines
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImagePipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86

  ImagePipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineX86
  PipelineArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipelineArm64
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  SoftwareInstallComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the software installation component
    Value: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
  TestComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the test component
    Value: !Ref TestComponent
  ImageRecipeX86Arn:
    Description: ARN of the x86 image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
  ImageRecipeArm64Arn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AgentOps E-Commerce Analytics Demo - Cognito User Pool with seeded test users"

Parameters: {}

Resources:
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your verification code for AgentOps E-Commerce"
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Please use this code {####} to verify your email address for AgentOps E-Commerce."

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # App Client
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # User Groups
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda Execution Role for Seeder
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: agentops-user-seeder-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SeederLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/agentops-user-seeder:*"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Seeder Lambda Function
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          import urllib.request
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          COGNITO = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          USERS = [
              ('alice@demo.local',   'team-alpha', 'member'),
              ('bob@demo.local',     'team-alpha', 'member'),
              ('charlie@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'team_admin'),
              ('dave@demo.local',    'team-beta',  'member'),
              ('eve@demo.local',     'team-beta',  'team_admin'),
              ('admin@demo.local',   'admin',      'admin'),
          ]

          PASSWORD = 'Demo1234!'

          def send_response(event, context, status, data, physical_id=None):
              body = {
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': 'See CloudWatch logs: ' + context.log_group_name,
                  'PhysicalResourceId': physical_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data,
              }
              payload = json.dumps(body).encode()
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event['ResponseURL'],
                  data=payload,
                  headers={
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Content-Length': str(len(payload)),
                  },
                  method='PUT',
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                  logger.info('CFN response status: %s', resp.status)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Event: %s', json.dumps(event))
              try:
                  user_pool_id = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']

                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      for email, group, role in USERS:
                          try:
                              COGNITO.admin_create_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  TemporaryPassword=PASSWORD,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'email',           'Value': email},
                                      {'Name': 'email_verified',  'Value': 'true'},
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role',     'Value': role},
                                  ],
                                  MessageAction='SUPPRESS',
                              )
                              logger.info('Created user %s in %s', email, group)
                          except ClientError as e:
                              if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'UsernameExistsException':
                                  logger.info('User %s already exists – updating attributes', email)
                                  COGNITO.admin_update_user_attributes(
                                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                      Username=email,
                                      UserAttributes=[
                                          {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                                      ],
                                  )
                              else:
                                  raise

                          COGNITO.admin_set_user_password(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              Password=PASSWORD,
                              Permanent=True,
                          )
                          logger.info('Set permanent password for %s', email)

                          COGNITO.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group,
                          )
                          logger.info('Added %s to group %s', email, group)

                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS',
                                    {'Message': 'Users seeded successfully'})

                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS',
                                    {'Message': 'Delete is a no-op'})

              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception('Seeding failed')
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)})

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Custom Resource that triggers the seeder
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  UserSeeder:
    Type: Custom::UserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda Log Group (retain logs after stack deletion)
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SeederFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${SeederFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: 7

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Outputs
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "The ID of the Cognito User Pool"
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "The ARN of the Cognito User Pool"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: "The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  Region:
    Description: "The AWS region the stack is deployed in"
    Value: !Ref "AWS::Region"

  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: "The ARN of the user seeder Lambda function"
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a dashboard for AWS Client VPN
  usage reporting, covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth authentication
  methods.

Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Folder path to organize the CloudWatch Logs Insights queries
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Log Group containing AWS Client VPN logs

Resources:
  QueryTotalUsagePerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${FolderPath}/total-usage-per-endpoint
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /connection/
        | parse @message /"vpn-endpoint-id"\s*:\s*"(?<endpointId>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count() as totalConnections by endpointId
        | sort totalConnections desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  QueryUsageByAuthType:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${FolderPath}/usage-by-authentication-type
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /authentication/
        | parse @message /"authentication-method"\s*:\s*"(?<authMethod>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count() as connectionAttempts by authMethod
        | sort connectionAttempts desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  QueryDistinctUsers:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${FolderPath}/distinct-users-per-authentication
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /connection-success/
        | parse @message /"username"\s*:\s*"(?<username>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"authentication-method"\s*:\s*"(?<authMethod>[^"]+)"/
        | stats count() as connections by username, authMethod
        | sort connections desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  QueryConnectionDurations:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${FolderPath}/connection-durations
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @message like /connection-end/
        | parse @message /"connection-duration-seconds"\s*:\s*(?<duration>\d+)/
        | stats avg(duration) as avgDurationSeconds, max(duration) as maxDurationSeconds, min(duration) as minDurationSeconds, count() as totalConnections
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: AWS-Client-VPN-Usage-Reporting
      DashboardBody:
        !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "log",
                "x": 0,
                "y": 0,
                "width": 12,
                "height": 12,
                "properties": {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AnyCompany Hotel - Cognito User Pool for Guest and Staff Authentication System"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: "Deployment environment name used for resource naming and domain"

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
        EmailMessage: "Your AnyCompany Hotel account is ready. Please confirm your email by clicking the link: {##Click Here##}"
        EmailSubject: "AnyCompany Hotel - Confirm Your Email"
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      MfaConfiguration: OFF
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # User Pool Domain (used for OAuth2 token endpoint)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public SPA Client – SRP auth, no client secret
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  SPAUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ReadAttributes:
        - address
        - birthdate
        - email
        - email_verified
        - family_name
        - gender
        - given_name
        - locale
        - middle_name
        - name
        - nickname
        - phone_number
        - phone_number_verified
        - picture
        - preferred_username
        - profile
        - sub
        - updated_at
        - website
        - zoneinfo
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - family_name
        - given_name
        - name
        - phone_number
        - preferred_username
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code

        - http://localhost:3000

        - locale

        - name

        - phone_number_verified

        - preferred_username
        - profile
        - sub
        - updated_at
        - website
        - zoneinfo
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region

        - email
        - family_name
        - given_name
        - name
        - phone_number
        - preferred_username
        - custom:guest_id
        - custom:property_id
        - custom:region
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito Groups for staff role-based access
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

    Properties:

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

    Properties:

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Description: "Housekeeping staff with task management"

    Properties:

      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read

        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: "Write access to hotel data"
        - ScopeName: admin

        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito User Pool for Hospitality Insights application - prod environment"

Parameters:
  CustomDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "Custom domain prefix for the hosted UI (e.g., 'auth' or 'login')"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid domain prefix (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens)"

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the SSO federated identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)"

  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "SSO login / issuer URL for the federated identity provider (leave empty to disable SSO)"

Conditions:
  HasSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginURL, ""]]

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # Lambda Execution Role
  # ============================================================
  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateCognitoAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"

  # ============================================================
  # Post-Authentication Lambda Function (Python 3.12)
  # Updates custom:last_login attribute on each sign-in
  # ============================================================
  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """
              Post-authentication trigger that updates the custom:last_login
              attribute for the authenticated user.
              """
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              username = event.get('userName')

              if user_pool_id and username:
                  client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                  now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

                  try:
                      client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {
                                  'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                                  'Value': now
                              }
                          ]
                      )
                      print(f"Updated custom:last_login for user '{username}' to {now}")
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error updating last_login for user '{username}': {str(e)}")
              else:
                  print("Missing userPoolId or userName in event")

              return event
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: PassThrough

  # ============================================================
  # Permission for Cognito to invoke the Lambda
  # ============================================================
  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  # ============================================================
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ============================================================
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
          - Name: verified_phone_number
            Priority: 2
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: custom:last_login
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: preferred_username
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
      DeletionProtection: ACTIVE
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # User Pool Client (24-hour session timeout)
  # ============================================================
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - HasSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      AccessTokenValidity: 24

  # ============================================================
  # Custom Domain for Hosted UI
  # ============================================================
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CustomDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ============================================================
  # User Groups
  # ============================================================
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ============================================================
  # Optional SSO Federated Identity Provider (OIDC)
  # Created only when both SSOProviderName and SSOLoginURL are
  # provided (non-empty).
  # ============================================================
  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: HasSSO
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        preferred_username: preferred_username
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Sub "${SSOProviderName}-client"
        client_secret: placeholder-secret
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SSOLoginURL
        authorize_url: !Sub "${SSOLoginURL}/authorize"
        token_url: !Sub "${SSOLoginURL}/token"
        attributes_url: !Sub "${SSOLoginURL}/userinfo"
        jwks_uri: !Sub "${SSOLoginURL}/.well-known/jwks.json"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool Client ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool Provider URL (issuer)"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
  UserPoolDomainName:
    Description: "Custom domain for the hosted UI"
    Value: !Sub "${CustomDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  PostAuthLambdaArn:
    Description: "Post-authentication Lambda Function ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
