  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: IsCreateIGW
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: IsCreateIGW
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsCreatePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-subnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsCreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-route-table

  RouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasIGWAndRouteTable
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasSubnetAndRouteTable
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: IsCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group allowing HTTP and HTTPS from the configured source IP range
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-sg

  SecurityGroupHTTPIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: IsCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange

  SecurityGroupHTTPSIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: IsCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained Student Services agent infrastructure for an educational
  platform on AWS Bedrock AgentCore. Provisions per-domain Cognito user pools
  for OAuth2 client-credentials authentication and least-privilege IAM
  execution roles that all share a common base execution policy.

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # Shared base IAM managed policy (attached to every execution role)
  #############################################################################
  StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: student-services-base-execution-policy
      Description: >-
        Base least-privilege policy shared by every Student Services Bedrock
        AgentCore execution role. Grants Bedrock model invocation, CloudWatch
        logging and metrics under the bedrock-agentcore namespace, X-Ray
        tracing and Systems Manager parameter access.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLoggingBedrockAgentCore
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsBedrockAgentCore
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  #############################################################################
  # StudentServicesAgent orchestrator - execution role only (IAM inbound auth)
  #############################################################################
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: student-services-agent-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the StudentServicesAgent orchestrator. Inbound
        authentication is IAM based, so no Cognito user pool is provisioned.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy

  #############################################################################
  # StudentServicesGateway - Cognito only (no execution role)
  #############################################################################
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: student-services-gateway-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  StudentServicesGatewayDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'student-services-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: Student Services Gateway
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the Student Services Gateway

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: student-services-gateway-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - student-services-gateway/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  #############################################################################
  # CourseRegistration domain - base policy + full DynamoDB access + Cognito
  #############################################################################
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-registration-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the CourseRegistration AgentCore service. Includes
        the base policy plus full DynamoDB access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-registration-dynamodb-full-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource: '*'

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-registration-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  CourseRegistrationDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: Course Registration
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to Course Registration

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-registration-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-registration/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  #############################################################################
  # CourseCatalog domain - base policy + bedrock:Retrieve + Cognito
  #############################################################################
  CourseCatalogExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-catalog-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the CourseCatalog AgentCore service. Includes the
        base policy plus bedrock:Retrieve on any knowledge base.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-catalog-knowledge-base-retrieve
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockKnowledgeBaseRetrieve
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:knowledge-base/*'

  CourseCatalogUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-catalog-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  CourseCatalogDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-catalog-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool

  CourseCatalogResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-catalog
      Name: Course Catalog
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to Course Catalog

  CourseCatalogUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseCatalogResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-catalog-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseCatalogUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-catalog/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  #############################################################################
  # CourseReview domain - base policy + DynamoDB read-only + Cognito
  #############################################################################
  CourseReviewExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: course-review-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the CourseReview AgentCore service. Includes the
        base policy plus DynamoDB read-only access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: course-review-dynamodb-read-only
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTimeToLive
                  - dynamodb:DescribeLimits
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*'

  CourseReviewUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: course-review-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  CourseReviewDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-review-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool

  CourseReviewResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: course-review
      Name: Course Review
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to Course Review

  CourseReviewUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseReviewResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: course-review-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseReviewUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - course-review/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  #############################################################################
  # LoanApplication domain - base policy + sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint + Cognito
  #############################################################################
  LoanApplicationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: loan-application-execution-role
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the LoanApplication AgentCore service. Includes the
        base policy plus sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint on any endpoint.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref StudentServicesBaseExecutionPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: loan-application-sagemaker-invoke-endpoint
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerInvokeEndpoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*'

  LoanApplicationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: loan-application-user-pool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  LoanApplicationDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'loan-application-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool

  LoanApplicationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: loan-application
      Name: Loan Application
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to Loan Application

  LoanApplicationUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: LoanApplicationResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: loan-application-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref LoanApplicationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - loan-application/read
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

#############################################################################

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 – Logging & Monitoring Controls: CloudTrail delivery to CloudWatch Logs with metric filters, alarms, SNS notifications, KMS encryption, and companion Logs Insights queries."

Metadata:
  CISControls:
    - "3.1 – Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions"
    - "3.2 – Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled"
    - "3.3 – Ensure CloudTrail is integrated with CloudWatch Logs"
    - "3.4 – Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket"
    - "3.5 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for unauthorized API calls"
    - "3.6 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA"
    - "3.7 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for usage of root account"
    - "3.8 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for IAM policy changes"
    - "3.9 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for CloudTrail configuration changes"
    - "3.10 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for failed console logins"
    - "3.11 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for disabling/scheduled deletion of KMS keys"
    - "3.12 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for S3 bucket policy changes"
    - "3.13 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for AWS Config configuration changes"
    - "3.14 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for security group changes"
    - "3.15 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for network ACL changes"
    - "3.16 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for network gateway changes"
    - "3.17 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for route table changes"
    - "3.18 – Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for VPC changes"

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Bucket for CloudTrail – required by CloudTrail resource
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISCloudTrailS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "cis-cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CISCloudTrailKMSKey
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 90

  CISCloudTrailS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CISCloudTrailS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${CISCloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailGetBucketAcl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CISCloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for SNS topic encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS CMK used to encrypt the CIS alarm SNS topic"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

  CISLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-logs-sns-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CISLogsKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for CloudTrail log encryption and S3 SSE-KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISCloudTrailKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS CMK used to encrypt CloudTrail logs and S3 bucket objects"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/CIS-CloudTrail"
          - Sid: AllowS3ToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cis-cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

  CISCloudTrailKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-cloudtrail-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CISCloudTrailKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS Topic – receives alarm notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISAlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: CIS-Alarm-Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CISLogsKMSKey
      DisplayName: "CIS Alarm Notifications"

  CISAlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for CloudTrail to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CIS-CloudTrail-CloudWatchLogs-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  CloudTrailRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: CIS-CloudTrail-CloudWatchLogs-Policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref CloudTrailRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub "${CISCloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs Log Group – receives CloudTrail management events
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISCloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: CIS-CloudTrail-Logs
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !Ref CISLogsKMSKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudTrail Trail – management events, multi-region, to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CISCloudTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    Properties:
      TrailName: CIS-CloudTrail
      IsLogging: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      S3BucketName: !Ref CISCloudTrailS3Bucket
      S3KeyPrefix: ""
      KMSKeyId: !GetAtt CISCloudTrailKMSKey.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !Sub "${CISCloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailRole.Arn
      EventSelectors:
        - ReadWriteType: All
          IncludeManagementEvents: true
          DataResources: []

  # ===========================================================================
  # METRIC FILTERS, ALARMS, AND QUERY DEFINITIONS
  # ===========================================================================

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 – Unauthorized API Call Attempts
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterUnauthorizedAPICalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: CIS-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied") || ($.errorCode = "UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "Unauthorized") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS/Metrics
          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: "1"

  AlarmUnauthorizedAPICalls:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      AlarmName: CIS-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when unauthorized API call attempts are detected (CIS 3.5)"
      Namespace: CIS/Metrics
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QueryDefinitionUnauthorizedAPICalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.5-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter (errorCode = "AccessDenied") or (errorCode = "UnauthorizedOperation") or (errorCode = "Unauthorized")
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 – Console Sign-In Without MFA
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterConsoleSigninWithoutMFA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: CIS-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.userIdentity.type != "Root") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS/Metrics
          MetricName: ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
          MetricValue: "1"

  AlarmConsoleSigninWithoutMFA:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      AlarmName: CIS-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when console sign-in without MFA is detected (CIS 3.6)"
      Namespace: CIS/Metrics
      MetricName: ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QueryDefinitionConsoleSigninWithoutMFA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.6-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and userIdentity.type != "Root"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 – Use of the Root Account
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterRootAccountUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: CIS-RootAccountUsage
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS/Metrics
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage
          MetricValue: "1"

  AlarmRootAccountUsage:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      AlarmName: CIS-RootAccountUsage
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when root account usage is detected (CIS 3.7)"
      Namespace: CIS/Metrics
      MetricName: RootAccountUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QueryDefinitionRootAccountUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.7-RootAccountUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 – IAM Policy Changes (pattern shortened to comply with 1024-char limit)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterIAMPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: CIS-IAMPolicyChanges
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "SetDefaultPolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "UpdateAssumeRolePolicy")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS/Metrics
          MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: "1"

  AlarmIAMPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      AlarmName: CIS-IAMPolicyChanges
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when IAM policy changes are detected (CIS 3.8)"
      Namespace: CIS/Metrics
      MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QueryDefinitionIAMPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.8-IAMPolicyChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com" and (eventName = "AddRoleToInstanceProfile" or eventName = "AddUserToGroup" or eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy" or eventName = "AttachRolePolicy" or eventName = "AttachUserPolicy" or eventName = "CreatePolicy" or eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion" or eventName = "DeletePolicy" or eventName = "DeleteRole" or eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy" or eventName = "DeleteUser" or eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy" or eventName = "DetachRolePolicy" or eventName = "DetachUserPolicy" or eventName = "PutRolePolicy" or eventName = "SetDefaultPolicyVersion" or eventName = "UpdateAssumeRolePolicy" or eventName = "UpdateRole" or eventName = "UpdateUser" or eventName = "CreateRole" or eventName = "CreateUser")
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 – CloudTrail Configuration Changes
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterCloudTrailConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: CIS-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") || ($.eventName = "PutEventSelectors")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS/Metrics
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: "1"

  AlarmCloudTrailConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref CISAlarmNotificationTopic
      AlarmName: CIS-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CloudTrail configuration changes are detected (CIS 3.9)"
      Namespace: CIS/Metrics
      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  QueryDefinitionCloudTrailConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.9-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISCloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com" and (eventName = "CreateTrail" or eventName = "UpdateTrail" or eventName = "DeleteTrail" or eventName = "StartLogging" or eventName = "StopLogging" or eventName = "PutEventSelectors")
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and supporting resources used across multiple EKS
  deployments. This template enables GuardDuty, creates a collection of shared
  IAM roles (Lambda execution/discovery, caller identity, EKS node group
  describer, CloudFormation execution, registry logging delivery, CodeBuild/EKS
  integration, CloudFormation extension hooks and bastion instance role), and
  activates the AWSQS Kubernetes CloudFormation registry resource types.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: eks
    Description: Optional environment alias used as the naming prefix for all shared roles.

  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional environment hash appended to the environment alias naming prefix.

  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared-artifacts
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that the bastion role is allowed to read objects from.
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid, lowercase S3 bucket name.

  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an IAM permissions boundary policy. When left empty no
      permissions boundary is attached to the shared roles; set this value in
      environments that require a permissions boundary.

Conditions:
  UsePermissionsBoundary: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      - ""

Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log groups written to by the CloudFormation registry type activations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 30

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EKSClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared IAM roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - UsePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-execution-role"
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - UsePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-identity-role"
      Description: Lambda role for getting the caller identity and accessing CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityCloudFormationCloudTrailAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  EKSNodeGroupDescriberRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - UsePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describer-role"
      Description: Role for describing EKS node groups.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeEKSNodeGroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: "*"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - UsePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role"
      Description: CloudFormation execution role with broad permissions to manage EKS and supporting services.
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageEKSSupportingServices
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: "*"

  RegistryLoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      PermissionsBoundary: !If
        - UsePermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref PermissionsBoundary
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}${EnvironmentHash}-registry-logging-delivery-role"
      Description: Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegistryLoggingDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster"
              - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Comprehensive Amazon SQS test infrastructure containing standard and FIFO
  queues, associated dead letter queues, a customer managed KMS key used to
  encrypt every queue, and a set of CloudWatch alarms covering the queues.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key used to encrypt every queue in this template
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueueKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the SQS test queues
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard queue with a dead letter queue (maxReceiveCount 5) and its DLQ
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-queue-with-dlq-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  StandardQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-queue-with-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIFO queue without a dead letter queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-queue-no-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIFO queue with a dead letter queue and its DLQ
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoQueueWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-queue-with-dlq-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-queue-with-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Separate standalone FIFO dead letter queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: separate-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt QueueKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: standard queue NumberOfMessagesSent (Sum) threshold 1, breaching on
  # missing data.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueMessagesSentSumAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-sent-sum
      AlarmDescription: Number of messages sent (sum) on the standard queue with a threshold of 1
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: FIFO-with-DLQ queue NumberOfMessagesSent (Average) using an anomaly
  # detection band.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-queue-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection band on the average number of messages sent to the FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (average)
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (expected band)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum sent message size on the standard queue, threshold 183500.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueMaxSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-max-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue with a threshold of 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue, threshold
  # 183500.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqMaxSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-max-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ, alerting when > 0.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Sum of visible messages on the standard DLQ alerting when greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: sum of visible messages on the FIFO DLQ, alerting when > 0.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Sum of visible messages on the FIFO DLQ alerting when greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue, threshold
  # 15, treating missing data.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue with a threshold of 15
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue,
  # threshold 15, treating missing data.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 15
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum messages not visible on the standard queue, threshold
  # 108000.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of messages not visible on the standard queue with a threshold of 108000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum messages not visible on the separate FIFO queue, threshold
  # 18000.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of messages not visible on the separate FIFO queue with a threshold of 18000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm: maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ, threshold 90.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ with a threshold of 90
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK and treats missing data as not
  # breaching.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: synthetic-always-ok
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: e1
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: 'm1 * 0'
          Label: SyntheticAlwaysOk
