final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Private ROSA Networking Infrastructure with Egress VPC and Transit Gateway"

Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "1"
      - "3"
    Default: "3"
    Description: "Number of Availability Zones for ROSA private subnets (1 or 3)"
  RosaVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the ROSA VPC"
  RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 1"
  RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 2 (only used when NumberOfAZs = 3)"
  RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for ROSA private subnet in Availability Zone 3 (only used when NumberOfAZs = 3)"
  EgressVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the Egress VPC"
  EgressPublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the Egress public subnet"
  EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the Egress private subnet"
  EnableELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Whether to create the AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing service-linked role"
  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs (delivered to CloudWatch Logs with KMS encryption)"

Conditions:
  IsMultiAZ: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, "3"]
  CreateELBRole: !Equals [!Ref EnableELBServiceLinkedRole, "true"]
  CreateFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpcFlowLogs, "true"]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA VPC & Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-VPC"

  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-Subnet-1"

  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-Subnet-2"

  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-Subnet-3"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA Private Subnet Route Tables & Routes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-RT-1"

  RosaPrivateSubnet1DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - RosaTGWAttachment
      - TransitGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1

  RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-RT-2"

  RosaPrivateSubnet2DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    DependsOn:
      - RosaTGWAttachment
      - TransitGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2

  RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Private-RT-3"

  RosaPrivateSubnet3DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    DependsOn:
      - RosaTGWAttachment
      - TransitGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress VPC & Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-VPC"

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-Public-Subnet"

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-Private-Subnet"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway & NAT Gateway (Egress VPC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-Public-RT"

  EgressPublicSubnetDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-NAT-EIP"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-NAT-Gateway"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress Private Subnet Route Table & Routes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-Private-RT"

  EgressPrivateSubnetNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # Route for return traffic from Egress to ROSA via Transit Gateway
  EgressPrivateSubnetTGWRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - EgressTGWAttachment
      - TransitGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Egress-TGW"

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-Egress-TGW-RT"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway Attachments
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaTGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - IsMultiAZ
          - [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3]
          - [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-TGW-Attachment"

  EgressTGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-TGW-Attachment"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway Route Table Associations & Propagations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaTGWRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTGWAttachment

  EgressTGWRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTGWAttachment

  RosaTGWRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTGWAttachment

  EgressTGWRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTGWAttachment

  # Static route in TGW route table: send all internet-bound traffic to Egress
  TransitGatewayDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTGWAttachment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ELB Service-Linked Role (Optional)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateELBRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: "Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs Infrastructure (Optional)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "EnableRootAccess"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - "kms:Create*"
              - "kms:Describe*"
              - "kms:Enable*"
              - "kms:List*"
              - "kms:Put*"
              - "kms:Update*"
              - "kms:Revoke*"
              - "kms:Disable*"
              - "kms:Get*"
              - "kms:Delete*"
              - "kms:TagResource"
              - "kms:UntagResource"
              - "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:CancelKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowCloudWatchLogsService"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowFlowLogsRole"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "FlowLogs-KMS-Key"

  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/flow-logs-key-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "VPC-FlowLogs-Delivery-Role"

  FlowLogsRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      PolicyName: "VPC-FlowLogs-Delivery-Policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
              - "logs:CreateLogStream"
              - "logs:PutLogEvents"
              - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
              - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref FlowLogsRole

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "VPC-FlowLogs-${AWS::StackName}"

  RosaVPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "ROSA-VPC-FlowLog"

  EgressVPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "Egress-VPC-FlowLog"

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: "ROSA VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref RosaVPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RosaVpcId"

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: "Egress VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EgressVpcId"

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: "ROSA Private Subnet 1 ID"
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet1Id"

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: "ROSA Private Subnet 2 ID"
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet2Id"

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: "ROSA Private Subnet 3 ID"
    Condition: IsMultiAZ
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnet3Id"

  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: "Egress Public Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EgressPublicSubnetId"

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: "Egress Private Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EgressPrivateSubnetId"

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId"

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway Route Table ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Export:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PCI DSS remediation prerequisite resources and nine AWS Systems Manager
  Automation documents. The template creates a CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log
  group with 1827-day retention, a KMS customer managed key with rotation and a
  root account key policy, an IAM role for the SSM automations, an IAM role for
  CloudTrail to write to CloudWatch Logs, and nine remediation automation
  documents. Every resource is exported so that custom AWS Config conformance
  packs can reference them.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Prerequisite resources
  ###########################################################################

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  RemediationKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS CMK used to encrypt CloudTrail logs for ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: pci-dss-remediation-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullKMSAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  RemediationKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-remediation'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RemediationKmsKey

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SSMAutomationRole'
      Description: Role assumed by the PCI DSS remediation automation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSSMAutomationAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole'
      Description: Role that allows CloudTrail to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLogStreamAndPutLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: CreateAndManageLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:DeleteRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                  - logs:ListTagsLogGroup
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:ListTagsForResource
                  - logs:PutMetricFilter
                  - logs:PutSubscriptionFilter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroup}:*'

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 1 - encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and
  # integrate it with CloudWatch Logs.
  ###########################################################################

  EncryptCloudTrailTrailWithKMSKeyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-EncryptCloudTrailTrailWithKMSKey'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a customer managed KMS key and
          integrate the trail with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail to encrypt.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EncryptTrailWithKMSKeyAndEnableLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 2 - enable key rotation for a KMS key.
  ###########################################################################

  EnableKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-EnableKeyRotation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enable automatic annual rotation for a customer managed KMS key.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN or key ID of the KMS key for which to enable rotation.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: KeyId
                Selector: $.KeyId
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 3 - integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs.
  ###########################################################################

  EnableCloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-EnableCloudTrailCloudWatchLogs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrate a CloudTrail trail with a CloudWatch Logs log group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 4 - update the account IAM password policy.
  ###########################################################################

  UpdateIAMPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Update the account IAM password policy to require a minimum length of
          14 characters, uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols, allow users
          to change their password, enforce a hard expiry with a maximum
          password age of 90 days, and prevent reuse of the last 24 passwords.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 5 - enable CloudTrail log file validation, multi-region
  # logging and CloudWatch Logs integration.
  ###########################################################################

  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enable log file validation for a CloudTrail trail, make the trail
          multi-region, and integrate the trail with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail uses to write to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidationAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailArn
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 6 - revoke all inbound and outbound rules from a
  # security group.
  ###########################################################################

  RevokeSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-RevokeUnusedSecurityGroupRules'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revoke all inbound and outbound rules from a security group, leaving
          the group with no allow rules.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ID of the security group whose rules are revoked.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: revoke_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def revoke_rules(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                        GroupIds=[group_id]
                    )['SecurityGroups']
                    if not groups:
                        raise ValueError('Security group %s not found' % group_id)
                    group = groups[0]
                    ingress = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=ingress
                        )
                    if egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=egress
                        )
                    return {'GroupId': group_id}
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 7 - delete a security group.
  ###########################################################################

  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-DeleteSecurityGroup'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Delete a security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: GroupId
                Selector: $.GroupId
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 8 - release an unused Elastic IP address.
  ###########################################################################

  ReleaseUnusedElasticIPAddressDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-ReleaseUnusedElasticIPAddress'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Release an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseElasticIPAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Return
                Selector: $.return
                Type: String
            isEnd: true

  ###########################################################################
  # Automation document 9 - remove AWS credential environment variables from
  # a CodeBuild project.
  ###########################################################################

  RemoveCodeBuildEnvironmentVariablesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AWSConfigRemediation-RemoveCodeBuildEnvironmentVariables'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Remove any CodeBuild project environment variables named
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: (Required) IAM role that Automation assumes when performing the remediation.
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CodeBuild project to update.
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: remove_credentials
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def remove_credentials(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    projects = codebuild.batch_get_projects(
                        names=[project_name]
                    )['projects']
                    if not projects:
                        raise ValueError('CodeBuild project %s not found' % project_name)
                    project = projects[0]
                    environment = project.get('environment', {})
                    variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    blocked = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    environment['environmentVariables'] = [
                        var for var in variables if var.get('name') not in blocked
                    ]
                    codebuild.update_project(
                        name=project_name, environment=environment
                    )
                    return {'ProjectName': project_name}
            isEnd: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CoWork Telemetry Monitoring Dashboard – creates a log group, metric filters
  for both local‑agent and Claude‑Code‑Desktop schemas, and a comprehensive
  CloudWatch dashboard.

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWorkTelemetryDashboard
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedValues:
      - af-south-1
      - ap-east-1
      - ap-northeast-1
      - ap-northeast-2
      - ap-northeast-3
      - ap-south-1
      - ap-south-2
      - ap-southeast-1
      - ap-southeast-2
      - ap-southeast-3
      - ap-southeast-4
      - ca-central-1
      - eu-central-1
      - eu-central-2
      - eu-north-1
      - eu-south-1
      - eu-south-2
      - eu-west-1
      - eu-west-2
      - eu-west-3
      - il-central-1
      - me-central-1
      - me-south-1
      - sa-east-1
      - us-east-1
      - us-east-2
      - us-west-1
      - us-west-2
    Description: AWS region where metrics and the dashboard are published.

  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /cowork/telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CoWork events.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: Retention period (days) for the CoWork log group.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   CloudWatch Logs log group – receives CoWork telemetry events
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: CoWorkTelemetry
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   Metric filters for Schema A (Local Agent mode) – one per metric.
  #   All share the pattern: events that contain inputTokens (unique to the
  #   local‑agent schema).  DefaultValue=0 ensures no data gaps.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterSchemaAInputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.inputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  MetricFilterSchemaAOutputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.outputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  MetricFilterSchemaACacheReadTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cacheReadInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  MetricFilterSchemaACacheCreationTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cacheCreationInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  MetricFilterSchemaAEstimatedCost:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: "$.estimatedCost"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  MetricFilterSchemaASessionTurnCount:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: SessionTurnCount
          MetricValue: "$.turnNumber"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.userId"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.model"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   Metric filters for Schema B (Claude Code for Desktop) – one per metric.
  #   Pattern matches events that contain promptTokens (unique to the desktop
  #   schema).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MetricFilterSchemaBInputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.promptTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.promptTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.modelId"

  MetricFilterSchemaBOutputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.promptTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: "$.completionTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.modelId"

  MetricFilterSchemaBCacheReadTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.promptTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cacheReadInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.modelId"

  MetricFilterSchemaBCacheCreationTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.promptTokens IS NOT NULL }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: "$.cacheCreationInputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: "$.user"
            - Key: Model
              Value: "$.modelId"

  MetricFilterSchemaBEstimatedCost:

    Properties:

      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry

          Dimensions:
            - Key: User

            - Key: Model

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CDK Bootstrap Stack - Creates a self-contained bootstrap environment for deploying AWS CDK applications"

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,10}"
    ConstraintDescription: "Qualifier must be 1-10 alphanumeric, underscore, or hyphen characters"
    Default: "cdk"
    Description: "Short string to uniquely identify stack components in the same AWS account and region"

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1"
    Description: "Version of the bootstrap stack tracked in SSM Parameter Store"

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Comma-separated list of trusted AWS account IDs that can assume the deployment action role. Do not include spaces between entries."

  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: "List of IAM managed policy ARNs to attach to all bootstrap roles"

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Custom name for the file assets S3 bucket. If empty, a default name cdk-{Qualifier}-assets-{Account}-{Region} is generated."

  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "ARN of an existing KMS key for S3 bucket encryption. If empty, a new KMS key is created with alias alias/cdk-{Qualifier}-assets-key."

Conditions:
  HasCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, ""]]
  UseExistingKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]]
  CreateNewKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TrustedAccounts, ""]]
  HasManagedPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref ManagedPolicyArns], ""]]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS KEY for S3 bucket encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FileAssetsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap S3 bucket (qualifier: ${Qualifier})"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "EnableIAMUserPermissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "EnableS3ServiceAccess"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:ReEncryptFrom"
              - "kms:ReEncryptTo"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:s3:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-*"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  FileAssetsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 BUCKET for file assets (CloudFormation templates, Lambda code, etc.)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - UseExistingKmsKey
                - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                - !GetAtt FileAssetsKmsKey.Arn
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref S3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DenyHTTP"
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt S3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": "false"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECR REPOSITORY for container assets (Docker images)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM ROLES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Deployment Action Role – the hub role that orchestrates deployments.
  # Trusted by the accounts listed in TrustedAccounts (plus the current account).
  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Sub "${TrustedAccounts},${AWS::AccountId}"]
                - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasManagedPolicies
        - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cdk-bootstrap-deployment-action-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowPassRoleToBootstrapRoles"
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "iam:PassRole"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-lookup-role-*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-*"
              - Sid: "AllowCloudFormationActions"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "cloudformation:CreateChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet"
                  - "cloudformation:CreateStack"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteStack"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResources"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplate"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStacks"
                  - "cloudformation:GetStackPolicy"
                  - "cloudformation:SetStackPolicy"
                  - "cloudformation:UpdateStack"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResource"
                  - "cloudformation:ContinueUpdateRollback"
                  - "cloudformation:CreateStackInstances"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackSetOperation"
                  - "cloudformation:ListStackInstances"
                  - "cloudformation:UpdateStackSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteStackSet"
                  - "cloudformation:CreateStackSet"
                  - "cloudformation:DeleteStackInstances"
                  - "cloudformation:DescribeStackResourceDrifts"
                  - "cloudformation:DetectStackDrift"
                  - "cloudformation:DetectStackResourceDrift"
                  - "cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: "AllowS3ReadWriteOnAssetsBucket"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject*"
                  - "s3:PutObject*"
                  - "s3:DeleteObject*"
                  - "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
                  - "s3:ListBucket*"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "s3:GetBucketPolicy"
                  - "s3:PutBucketPolicy"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt S3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: "AllowECRReadWrite"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                  - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: "AllowKMSDecryptForAssetBucket"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsKmsKey.Arn
              - Sid: "AllowDescribeActions"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones"
                  - "ec2:DescribeRegions"
                  - "iam:GetRole"
                  - "iam:ListRoles"
                  - "iam:PassRole"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: "AllowSSMGetParameters"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ssm:GetParameter"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/*"
              - Sid: "AllowSTSActionsOnBootstrapRoles"
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # File Publishing Role – publishes assets to the S3 bucket
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasManagedPolicies
        - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cdk-bootstrap-file-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowS3ReadWriteOnAssetsBucket"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject*"
                  - "s3:PutObject*"
                  - "s3:DeleteObject*"
                  - "s3:AbortMultipartUpload"
                  - "s3:ListBucket*"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt S3Bucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${S3Bucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: "AllowKMSEncryptDecrypt"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                Resource: !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # Image Publishing Role – pushes container images to ECR
  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasManagedPolicies
        - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cdk-bootstrap-image-publishing-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowECRAccess"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken"
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                  - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
                  - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
                  - "ecr:ListImages"
                  - "ecr:DescribeRepositories"
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: "AllowECRRepositorySpecificAccess"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"
                  - "ecr:BatchGetImage"
                  - "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability"
                  - "ecr:PutImage"
                  - "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:UploadLayerPart"
                  - "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
                  - "ecr:ListImages"
                  - "ecr:DescribeRepositories"
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # Lookup Role – used by CDK to look up context information
  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasManagedPolicies
        - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cdk-bootstrap-lookup-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowResourceLookup"
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones"
                  - "ec2:DescribeRegions"
                  - "ec2:DescribeVpcs"
                  - "ec2:DescribeSubnets"
                  - "ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups"
                  - "ec2:DescribeRouteTables"
                  - "ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces"
                  - "ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes"
                  - "iam:GetRole"
                  - "iam:ListRoles"
                  - "iam:GetPolicy"
                  - "iam:ListPolicies"
                  - "ssm:GetParameter"
                  - "ssm:GetParameters"
                  - "ssm:DescribeParameters"
                  - "kms:ListAliases"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                  - "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration"
                  - "lambda:ListFunctions"
                  - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers"
                  - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups"
                  - "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners"
                  - "route53:ListHostedZones"
                  - "route53:ListResourceRecordSets"
                  - "s3:ListAllMyBuckets"
                  - "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # CloudFormation Execution Role – used by CloudFormation to create/update/delete stacks
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasManagedPolicies
        - !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "cdk-bootstrap-cfn-exec-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: "AllowFullCloudFormationExecution"
                Effect: Allow
                Action: "*"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "aws-cdk:bootstrap-qualifier"
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM PARAMETER to track the bootstrap version
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application and environment that support
  blue/green deployments. The template can either create a new Elastic
  Beanstalk application and blue environment or reference existing ones, and
  can optionally create a temporary green environment that is used to route
  traffic during a deployment and then removed after traffic is routed back to
  the blue environment. A sample application is deployed from a default S3
  bucket whose name has the current AWS Region appended.

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Description: >-
      Set to true to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application and blue
      environment. Set to false to reference existing ones.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

  ApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application to create.
    Type: String
    Default: MySampleApplication
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of the new (blue) Elastic Beanstalk environment to create.
    Type: String
    Default: MySampleApplication-env
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 40

  ExistingApplicationName:
    Description: >-
      Name of an existing Elastic Beanstalk application to use for the blue
      deployment when CreateNewApplication is false.
    Type: String
    Default: MyExistingSampleApplication
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100

  ExistingEnvironmentName:
    Description: >-
      Name of an existing Elastic Beanstalk environment to use for the blue
      deployment when CreateNewApplication is false.
    Type: String
    Default: MyExistingSampleApplication-env
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 40

  SolutionStackName:
    Description: >-
      Name of a supported Elastic Beanstalk solution stack used to launch the
      environment.
    Type: String
    Default: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v4.13.9 running Python 3.12

  SampleApplicationBucket:
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket that contains the sample application bundle. When
      left at the default value, the current AWS Region is appended to the
      bucket name.
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63

  SampleApplicationKey:
    Description: S3 object key of the sample application bundle.
    Type: String
    Default: python-sample.zip
    MinLength: 1

  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Description: >-
      Set to true to create a temporary green environment used to route
      traffic during a blue/green deployment. Set to false to remove the green
      environment after traffic has been routed back to the blue environment.
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of the temporary green Elastic Beanstalk environment.
    Type: String
    Default: MySampleApplication-green
    MinLength: 4
    MaxLength: 40

Conditions:
  IsNewApplication: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, 'true']
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref SampleApplicationBucket, elasticbeanstalk-samples]
  IsGreenEnvironmentRequested: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, 'true']

Resources:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking: Elastic Beanstalk needs a VPC with subnets in at least two
  # Availability Zones, so a minimal self-contained VPC is provisioned.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-a'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-b'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles used by the Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth

  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic Beanstalk application, version, and environments.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Application:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: IsNewApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application used for blue/green deployments.

  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApplication, !Ref Application, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      Description: Sample application version deployed to the environment.
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If [UseDefaultBucket, !Sub '${SampleApplicationBucket}-${AWS::Region}', !Ref SampleApplicationBucket]
        S3Key: !Ref SampleApplicationKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: IsNewApplication
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation
      - PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref Application
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBScheme
          Value: public
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: t3.micro

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: IsGreenEnvironmentRequested
    DependsOn:
      - PublicRoute
      - PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation
      - PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApplication, !Ref Application, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBSubnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnetA, !Ref PublicSubnetB]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: ELBScheme
          Value: public
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: LoadBalanced
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: InstanceType
          Value: t3.micro

Outputs:
  ElasticBeanstalkApplicationName:
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application.
    Value: !If [IsNewApplication, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
    Value: !If [IsNewApplication, !Ref EnvironmentName, !Ref ExistingEnvironmentName]

  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
    Condition: IsNewApplication
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL

  TemporaryGreenEnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of the temporary green Elastic Beanstalk environment.
    Condition: IsGreenEnvironmentRequested
    Value: !Ref GreenEnvironment

  TemporaryGreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL of the temporary green Elastic Beanstalk environment.
    Condition: IsGreenEnvironmentRequested
    Value: !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL

  SampleApplicationBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket that contains the sample application bundle.
    Value: !If [UseDefaultBucket, !Sub '${SampleApplicationBucket}-${AWS::Region}', !Ref SampleApplicationBucket]
