final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for the MLWorkshop. Creates an
  admin-team portfolio and an end-user portfolio, the workshop products (VPC with
  private subnets and endpoints, IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets, AWS Data
  Exchange, infrastructure, application, SageMaker notebook instance, and a
  third-party ML model), dedicated launch roles and launch-role constraints, the
  lead-end-user and developer-end-user IAM roles with scoped read access to the
  /MLWorkshop SSM path and tag-scoped S3 objects, and portfolio principals.
Metadata:
  Notes: >-
    The nested workshop CloudFormation templates are NOT defined in this template.
    They are hosted in the public AWS Service Catalog reference-architecture S3
    bucket and referenced through the RootS3Url parameter. This top-level stack
    only orchestrates Service Catalog portfolios, products, constraints, portfolio
    principals, and the IAM roles used for launching and accessing them.
  Owner: MLWorkshopAdmin
Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: >-
      Base location (public S3 HTTPS URL) of the nested CloudFormation templates
      that back the Service Catalog products. The top-level stack references these
      templates by URL and does not create them.
    AllowedPattern: '^https://[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an https:// URL to the folder containing the nested templates.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to namespace portfolio, product, IAM role and SSM parameter names
      so that multiple workshop tenants can coexist in the same account.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-21 lowercase alphanumeric or hyphen characters, starting with alphanumeric.
Resources:

  ############################################################
  # Service Catalog Portfolios
  ############################################################
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-admin'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} MLWorkshop Admin Portfolio'
      Description: Portfolio for the MLWorkshop admin team, exposing the full set of workshop products.

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-enduser'
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} MLWorkshop End User Portfolio'
      Description: Portfolio for MLWorkshop end users, exposing the notebook, application and ML model products.

  ############################################################
  # CloudFormation Products (nested templates referenced by RootS3Url)
  ############################################################
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-VPC-private-subnets-and-endpoints'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Provisions a VPC with private subnets and the VPC endpoints used by the workshop.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  IamProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-IAM-roles-with-KMS-keys-and-S3-buckets'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Provides the workshop IAM roles, KMS keys and S3 buckets the lab depends on.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: IAM roles, KMS keys and S3 buckets for the workshop.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-Data-Exchange-Product'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Provisions the AWS Data Exchange third-party data set used by the workshop.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: AWS Data Exchange third-party data set provisioning.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-Infrastructure-Product'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Base shared workshop infrastructure (networking, storage, shared services).
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Base workshop infrastructure.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-Application-Product'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Workshop application stack that consumes the shared infrastructure.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Workshop application stack.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-SageMaker-Notebook-Instance'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Provisions the MLWorkshop SageMaker notebook instance.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: MLWorkshop SageMaker notebook instance.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  ThirdPartyMlModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-Third-Party-ML-Model'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop'
      Description: Provisions the third-party ML model onto SageMaker / Lambda as appropriate.
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Third-party ML model deployment.
          DisableTemplateValidation: true
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/portfolio.yaml'

  ############################################################
  # Portfolio <-> Product associations (no product left unassociated)
  ############################################################
  AdminVpcAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct

  AdminIamAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamProduct

  AdminDataExchangeAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  AdminInfrastructureAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  AdminApplicationAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  AdminSageMakerAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  AdminMlModelAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct

  EndUserApplicationAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  EndUserSageMakerAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  EndUserMlModelAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct

  EndUserDataExchangeAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  ############################################################
  # Launch roles (assumed by servicecatalog.amazonaws.com)
  ############################################################
  AdminLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-admin-launch-role'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role used to provision MLWorkshop admin portfolio products.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-admin-launch-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ComputeNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IamAndKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                  - kms:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SsmAndSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3BucketAndObjectAdministration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketNotification
                  - s3:PutBucketNotification
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MlAndServerless
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchangeAndMarketplace
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:*
                  - aws-marketplace:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleForProvisionedServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvironmentPrefix}-*'

  EndUserLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-enduser-launch-role'
      Description: Service Catalog launch role used to provision MLWorkshop end-user portfolio products.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-enduser-launch-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ComputeNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IamAndKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                  - kms:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SsmAndSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3BucketAndObjectAdministration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:PutBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketNotification
                  - s3:PutBucketNotification
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MlAndServerless
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchangeAndMarketplace
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:*
                  - aws-marketplace:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleForProvisionedServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvironmentPrefix}-*'

  ############################################################
  # Launch role constraints (one per product, wired to its portfolio launch role)
  ############################################################
  AdminVpcLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminIamLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminDataExchangeLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminInfrastructureLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminApplicationLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminSageMakerLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  AdminMlModelLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn

  EndUserApplicationLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn

  EndUserSageMakerLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn

  EndUserMlModelLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMlModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn

  EndUserDataExchangeLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn

  ############################################################
  # Lead end user (admin lead) IAM role
  ############################################################
  LeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-LeadEndUser'
      Description: Lead end user role with read/describe access to Service Catalog, CloudFormation, the /MLWorkshop SSM path and provisioning-tagged S3 objects.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-lead-enduser-servicecatalog'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ServiceCatalogReadDescribeList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:ListAcceptedPortfolioShares
                  - servicecatalog:ListPortfolios
                  - servicecatalog:ListPortfoliosForProduct
                  - servicecatalog:ListProducts
                  - servicecatalog:ListProductsAsAdmin
                  - servicecatalog:ListProvisioningArtifacts
                  - servicecatalog:ListPrincipalsForPortfolio
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProduct
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProductAsAdmin
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProductView
                  - servicecatalog:DescribePortfolio
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningArtifact
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningParameters
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeRecord
                  - servicecatalog:ListRecordHistory
                  - servicecatalog:ListLaunchPaths
                  - servicecatalog:SearchProducts
                  - servicecatalog:ScanProvisionedProducts
                  - servicecatalog:ListServiceActions
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeServiceAction
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-lead-enduser-data-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SsmMLWorkshopParameterRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: S3ReadProvisioningTaggedObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/ServiceCatalogProvisioning: 'MLWorkshop'
              - Sid: S3ListWorkshopBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-*'

  ############################################################
  # Standard / developer end user IAM role (stricter read-only subset)
  ############################################################
  DeveloperEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DeveloperEndUser'
      Description: Developer end user role with read-only Service Catalog, CloudFormation, /MLWorkshop SSM and provisioning-tagged S3 access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-developer-enduser-servicecatalog'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ServiceCatalogReadDescribeList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:ListAcceptedPortfolioShares
                  - servicecatalog:ListPortfolios
                  - servicecatalog:ListProducts
                  - servicecatalog:ListProvisioningArtifacts
                  - servicecatalog:ListRecordHistory
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProduct
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProductView
                  - servicecatalog:DescribePortfolio
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningArtifact
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisioningParameters
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeRecord
                  - servicecatalog:ListLaunchPaths
                  - servicecatalog:SearchProducts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-developer-enduser-data-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SsmMLWorkshopParameterRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: S3ReadProvisioningTaggedObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/ServiceCatalogProvisioning: 'MLWorkshop'
              - Sid: S3ListWorkshopBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${EnvironmentPrefix}-mlworkshop-*'

  ############################################################
  # Portfolio principal associations
  ############################################################
  AdminPortfolioLeadPrincipal:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt LeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

  EndUserPortfolioLeadPrincipal:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt LeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

  EndUserPortfolioDeveloperPrincipal:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt DeveloperEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM

Outputs:
  LeadEndUserSwitchRoleUrl:
    Description: Switch-role URL for the MLWorkshop lead end user.
    Value: !Sub 'https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${LeadEndUserRole}&displayName=MLWorkshop-LeadEndUser'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-LeadEndUser-SwitchRoleUrl'

  DeveloperEndUserSwitchRoleUrl:
    Description: Switch-role URL for the MLWorkshop developer end user.
    Value: !Sub 'https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${DeveloperEndUserRole}&displayName=MLWorkshop-DeveloperEndUser'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-MLWorkshop-DeveloperEndUser-SwitchRoleUrl'

  AdminPortfolioId:
    Description: ID of the MLWorkshop admin portfolio.
    Value: !Ref AdminPortfolio
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Dual-stack VPC with public and private subnets, optional NAT Gateway, network ACLs, placement group, and DHCP options set. Environment selectable via parameter."

Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Description: "Select the environment type (changes VPC CIDR and domain name)"
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging

  DeployNATGateway:
    Description: "Deploy a NAT Gateway (with Elastic IP) for private subnet IPv4 internet access"
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "Yes"
      - "No"
    Default: "No"

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VPCCIDR: "10.100.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: "10.100.1.0/24"
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: "10.100.2.0/24"
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: "10.100.3.0/24"
      PrivateSubnetAppCIDR: "10.100.4.0/24"
      PrivateSubnetDataCIDR: "10.100.5.0/24"
      DomainName: "staging.example.internal"
    production:
      VPCCIDR: "10.0.0.0/16"
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: "10.0.1.0/24"
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: "10.0.2.0/24"
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: "10.0.3.0/24"
      PrivateSubnetAppCIDR: "10.0.4.0/24"
      PrivateSubnetDataCIDR: "10.0.5.0/24"
      DomainName: "production.example.internal"

Conditions:
  DeployNAT: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, "Yes"]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VPCCIDR]
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  # Associate an auto-assigned IPv6 CIDR block with the VPC
  VPCIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # DHCP Options Set
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-dhcp-options"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  DHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnet 1 - First AZ (load balancer / presentation tier)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet1CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlocks: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Public Subnet 2 - First AZ (load balancer / presentation tier)
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet2CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlocks: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Public Subnet 3 - Second AZ (compute / EC2)
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet3CIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlocks: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # Private Subnet - Application tier (First AZ)
  PrivateSubnetApp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnetAppCIDR]
      Ipv6CidrBlocks: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-subnet-app"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Tier

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Serverless Movies API - DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for the API Gateway

Resources:
  # ── DynamoDB Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Movies
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S

  # ── IAM Role (shared by all Lambda functions) ──────────────────────────────
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # ── CloudWatch Log Groups (1-day retention) ────────────────────────────────
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/create-movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  GetMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/get-movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/update-movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/delete-movie
      RetentionInDays: 1

  # ── Lambda Functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: create-movie
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get("body", "{}"))
              title = body.get("title")
              if not title:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing title"})}
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return {"statusCode": 201, "body": json.dumps(body)}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable

  GetMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: GetMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: get-movie
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              title = event.get("pathParameters", {}).get("title")
              if not title:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing title"})}
              result = table.get_item(Key={"title": title})
              item = result.get("Item")
              if not item:
                  return {"statusCode": 404, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Not found"})}
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(item)}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: update-movie
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get("body", "{}"))
              title = body.get("title")
              if not title:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing title"})}
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(body)}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: delete-movie
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get("body", "{}"))
              title = body.get("title") or (event.get("pathParameters", {}).get("title") if event.get("pathParameters") else None)
              if not title:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "Missing title"})}
              table.delete_item(Key={"title": title})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"deleted": title})}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable

  # ── API Gateway REST API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: Movies API
      Description: Serverless Movies CRUD API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # ── API Resources ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MovieByTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: "{title}"

  # ── Methods on /Movies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MoviesPutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  MoviesDeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # ── Methods on /Movies/{title} ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  MovieByTitleGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieByTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SageMaker Studio MLOps Engineer user profile with scoped IAM execution role

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. If empty, a self-contained
      public-internet-access domain is created.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated security group IDs for the existing domain (only used
      when DomainId is supplied).
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma-separated subnet IDs for the existing domain (only used when
      DomainId is supplied).
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and related networking – created only when no existing domain is given
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SageMakerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sm-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio domain (created only when DomainId is not provided)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-domain'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the MLOps engineer persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassUserExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: ModelMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: ModelsAndModelPackageGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackageGroup
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: ExperimentsTrialsLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: TrainingTransformHyperparameterTuning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: SageMakerEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: StudioApplicationsOwned
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:Owner: !Ref UserProfileName

              - Sid: StudioSpacesOwned
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:Owner: !Ref UserProfileName

              - Sid: S3DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*
                  - arn:aws:s3:::*/*

              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*

              - Sid: ECR
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'

              - Sid: DescribeUserProfile
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                Resource: '*'

      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: MLOpsEngineer

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker Studio user profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - CreateDomain
        - !Ref StudioDomain
        - !Ref DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref UserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the created SageMaker Studio user profile
    Value: !Sub
      - arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${DomainIdValue}/${UserProfileNameValue}
      - DomainIdValue: !If
          - CreateDomain
          - !Ref StudioDomain
          - !Ref DomainId
        UserProfileNameValue: !Ref UserProfileName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance
  benchmarks. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
  benchmark result events and a comprehensive set of per-language CloudWatch
  Logs metric filters (Java, .NET, Python, Go, Rust) that extract memory,
  throughput, and concurrency metrics into language-specific CloudWatch
  namespaces.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/benchmarks/database-encryption-sdk
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
      benchmark result events.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain benchmark result log events.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
  MetricNamespacePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: Benchmarks/DatabaseEncryptionSDK
    Description: >-
      Prefix used to build the language-specific CloudWatch metric namespaces
      (for example Benchmarks/DatabaseEncryptionSDK/Java).
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
  ThroughputDataSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1048576
    Description: >-
      Data size (in bytes) of the throughput benchmark whose p50, p95, and p99
      latency metrics are extracted.

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Java metric filters
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" && $.language = "java" }'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: !Sub "${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Java"
          MetricValue: "$.memory_efficiency_ratio"
          Unit: "None"
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: "$.language"

  JavaPeakMemoryUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" && $.language = "java" }'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryUsage
          MetricNamespace: !Sub "${MetricNamespacePrefix}/Java"
          MetricValue: "$.peak_memory_usage"
          Unit: Bytes
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: "$.language"

  JavaThroughputP50LatencyFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterPattern: !Sub '{ $.test_type = "throughput" && $.language = "java" && $.data_size = ${ThroughputDataSize} }'

      MetricTransformations:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API "TodoAPIwithJs" with DynamoDB and JavaScript pipeline resolvers'

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table with GSI on owner attribute
  # ============================================================
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # AppSync GraphQL API — API Key authentication
  # ============================================================
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId

  # ============================================================
  # GraphQL Schema
  # ============================================================
  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String!
          description: String
          owner: String!
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          title: String!
          description: String
          owner: String!
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          description: String
          owner: String
        }

        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos: [Todo]
          todosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  # ============================================================
  # IAM Role for AppSync DynamoDB data source
  # ============================================================
  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Data Source
  # ============================================================
  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # Pipeline Functions — JavaScript (APPSYNC_JS)
  # Each implements a single data operation
  # ============================================================

  # ----- GET (Read single item) -----
  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: GetTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id } = ctx.arguments;
          return dynamodb.get({ key: { id } });
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ----- LIST (Scan all items) -----
  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: ListTodosFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return dynamodb.scan({});
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  # ----- QUERY BY OWNER (GSI lookup) -----
  TodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: TodosByOwnerFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { owner } = ctx.arguments;
          return dynamodb.query({
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': owner })
            },
            index: 'owner-index',
            limit: 100
          });
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  # ----- CREATE (PutItem) -----
  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO();
          const item = {
            id,
            title: input.title,
            description: input.description,
            owner: input.owner,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return dynamodb.put({ key: { id }, item });
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ----- UPDATE (UpdateItem) -----
  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const key = { id: input.id };
          const updates = { updatedAt: util.time.nowISO() };
          if (input.title != null) updates.title = input.title;
          if (input.description != null) updates.description = input.description;
          if (input.owner != null) updates.owner = input.owner;

          return dynamodb.update({
            key,
            update: updates,
            condition: { expression: 'attribute_exists(id)' }
          });
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ----- DELETE (DeleteItem) -----
  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDataSource.Name
      Name: DeleteTodoFunction
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        import { dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils/dynamodb';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const { input } = ctx.arguments;
          const key = { id: input.id };
          return dynamodb.remove({ key });
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ============================================================
  # Pipeline Resolvers
  # Each resolver uses a single-function pipeline
  # ============================================================

  # ----- Query: getTodo -----
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  # ----- Query: listTodos -----
  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ListTodosFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  # ----- Query: todosByOwner -----
  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt TodosByOwnerFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  # ----- Mutation: createTodo -----
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt CreateTodoFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }
