final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM roles for the Data Master project covering the full data pipeline from
  ingestion through analytics.

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole policies.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS Kinesis Writer Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dms-kinesis-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS VPC Role – AssumeRole restricted to TargetAccountId
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-vpc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${TargetAccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dms-vpc-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Pipes → Firehose Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventsFirehoseRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-events-firehose
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: events-firehose-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda Processing & Routing Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lambda-processor
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-basic-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: lambda-processing-routing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:SubscribeToShard
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:InvokeAsync
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Crawler Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-crawler
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: glue-crawler-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeletePartition
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue ETL Job Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueEtlRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-glue-etl
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: glue-etl-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lake Formation Data Lake Access Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LakeFormationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lake-formation
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lakeformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lake-formation-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                  - lakeformation:GrantPermissions
                  - lakeformation:RevokePermissions
                  - lakeformation:ListPermissions
                  - lakeformation:GetDataLakeSettings
                  - lakeformation:PutDataLakeSettings
                  - lakeformation:GetResourceLFTags
                  - lakeformation:AddLFTagsToResource
                  - lakeformation:RemoveLFTagsFromResource
                  - lakeformation:ListLFTags
                  - lakeformation:GetLFTag
                  - lakeformation:CreateLFTag
                  - lakeformation:UpdateLFTag
                  - lakeformation:DeleteLFTag
                  - lakeformation:SearchDatabasesByLFTags
                  - lakeformation:SearchTablesByLFTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:DeleteTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:BatchDeletePartition
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions Orchestration Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-step-functions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: step-functions-execution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RunTask
                  - ecs:StopTask
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS Fargate Task Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsFargateRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-ecs-fargate
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fargate-task-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:PutRecord

              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow

                  - sqs:SendMessage

        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EMR Serverless Job Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EmrServerlessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-emr-serverless
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: emr-serverless-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject

                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEMRServerless'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Managed Grafana Monitoring Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  GrafanaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-grafana
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: grafana.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: grafana-monitoring-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-firehose-access
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudWatch composite alarms monitoring cross-region failover application health (API Gateway, Lambda, RDS)"

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayApiId:
    Type: String
    Description: "The ID of the existing Remittance API Gateway REST API"
  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: String
    Description: "The stage name of the API Gateway API (e.g. prod, dev)"
    Default: prod
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function"
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function"
  RdsInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: "Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance (dbcluster1-instance1)"

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # API Gateway Underlying Metric Alarms (3)
  # ============================================================================
  ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: api-gateway-4xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway 4XX errors average > 0 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiId
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiId
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: api-gateway-5xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway 5XX errors average > 1 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiId
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiId
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: api-gateway-latency
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when API Gateway latency average >= 10000 ms over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiId
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayApiId
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ============================================================================
  # API Gateway Composite Alarm
  # ============================================================================
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm aggregating API Gateway 4XX, 5XX, and latency alarms"
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${A}") OR ALARM("${B}") OR ALARM("${C}")'
        - A: !Ref ApiGateway4xxErrorAlarm
          B: !Ref ApiGateway5xxErrorAlarm
          C: !Ref ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm

  # ============================================================================
  # Lambda Underlying Metric Alarms (6: errors/invocations/duration per function)
  # ============================================================================

  # -- GetRemittances Errors --
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: get-remittances-errors
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # -- CreateRemittance Errors --
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: create-remittance-errors
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # -- GetRemittances Invocations --
  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: get-remittances-invocations
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # -- CreateRemittance Invocations --
  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: create-remittance-invocations
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # -- GetRemittances Duration --
  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: get-remittances-duration
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when GetRemittances average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # -- CreateRemittance Duration --
  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: create-remittance-duration
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when CreateRemittance average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # ============================================================================
  # Lambda Composite Alarm
  # (rule references only errors and duration alarms, NOT invocations)
  # ============================================================================
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm aggregating Lambda errors and duration alarms (both functions)"
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${E1}") OR ALARM("${E2}") OR ALARM("${D1}") OR ALARM("${D2}")'
        - E1: !Ref GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm
          E2: !Ref CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm
          D1: !Ref GetRemittancesDurationAlarm
          D2: !Ref CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm

  # ============================================================================
  # RDS Underlying Metric Alarms (9 alarms, TreatMissingData unset)
  # ============================================================================

  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-cpu-utilization
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS CPU Utilization average >= 70% over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-database-connections
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Database Connections average >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Deadlocks average >= 10 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-network-transmit-throughput
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Network Transmit Throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-network-receive-throughput
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Network Receive Throughput average >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-queries
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Queries average >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-disk-queue-depth
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Disk Queue Depth average >= 50 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-read-latency
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Read Latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: rds-write-latency
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when RDS Write Latency average >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RdsInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # ============================================================================
  # RDS Composite Alarm
  # ============================================================================
  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm aggregating all RDS metric alarms"
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${A1}") OR ALARM("${A2}") OR ALARM("${A3}") OR ALARM("${A4}") OR ALARM("${A5}") OR ALARM("${A6}") OR ALARM("${A7}") OR ALARM("${A8}") OR ALARM("${A9}")'
        - A1: !Ref RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm
          A2: !Ref RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Comprehensive monitoring and data extraction pipeline for an internal QuickSight
  admin console. Provisions seven Glue jobs, scheduled Glue triggers, a private S3
  output/script bucket, five CloudWatch metric streams feeding five DirectPut Kinesis
  Firehose delivery streams, all managed by a single IAM role.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 bucket for scripts and all job / Firehose output
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt admin-suite S3 data.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: admin-suite-bucket-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Firehose to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteBucketKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single IAM role shared by Glue, Firehose, Metric Streams and CloudFormation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: admin-suite-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteQuickSightPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:SearchDashboards
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSets
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListTopicRefreshSchedules
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopic
                  - quicksight:ListTopics
                  - quicksight:ListTopicReviewedAnswers
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicPermissions
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteGluePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:BatchGetJobs
                  - glue:CreateDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless CRUD API for Kitten service using API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB'

Resources:
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # DynamoDB Table – PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand)
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # IAM Role for Lambda
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Lambda Function – single function routing all CRUD operations
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  KittenFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: Kitten
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import uuid
          import boto3
          from decimal import Decimal

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ.get('TABLE_NAME', 'Kitten')
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)


          class DecimalEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
              def default(self, obj):
                  if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
                      return float(obj)
                  return super().default(obj)


          def build_response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,GET,PUT,DELETE',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(body, cls=DecimalEncoder),
              }


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  http_method = event.get('httpMethod', '')
                  resource = event.get('resource', '')

                  # OPTIONS is handled by API Gateway MOCK, but guard anyway
                  if http_method == 'OPTIONS':
                      return build_response(200, {})

                  if resource == '/kitten':
                      if http_method == 'POST':
                          return create_kitten(event)
                      if http_method == 'GET':
                          return list_kittens()

                  if resource == '/kitten/{id}':
                      path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return build_response(400, {'error': 'Missing kitten id in path'})
                      if http_method == 'GET':
                          return get_kitten(kitten_id)
                      if http_method == 'PUT':
                          return update_kitten(kitten_id, event)
                      if http_method == 'DELETE':
                          return delete_kitten(kitten_id)

                  return build_response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported route or method'})

              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': f'Internal server error: {str(e)}'})


          def create_kitten(event):
              """POST /kitten – auto-generate KittenId, expect name & color in body."""
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return build_response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})

              name = body.get('name')
              color = body.get('color')

              if not name or not color:
                  return build_response(400, {'error': 'Both "name" and "color" fields are required'})

              kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
              item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return build_response(201, item)


          def list_kittens():
              """GET /kitten – scan all items."""
              try:
                  response = table.scan()
                  items = response.get('Items', [])
                  return build_response(200, items)
              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': f'Failed to list kittens: {str(e)}'})


          def get_kitten(kitten_id):
              """GET /kitten/{id} – retrieve a single kitten."""
              try:
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return build_response(404, {'error': f'Kitten with id "{kitten_id}" not found'})
                  return build_response(200, item)
              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': f'Failed to get kitten: {str(e)}'})


          def update_kitten(kitten_id, event):
              """PUT /kitten/{id} – replace the kitten entirely with name & color."""
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return build_response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})

              name = body.get('name')
              color = body.get('color')

              if not name or not color:
                  return build_response(400, {'error': 'Both "name" and "color" fields are required'})

              # Verify the item exists before overwriting.
              check = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
              if 'Item' not in check:
                  return build_response(404, {'error': f'Kitten with id "{kitten_id}" not found'})

              item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return build_response(200, item)


          def delete_kitten(kitten_id):
              """DELETE /kitten/{id} – remove the kitten."""
              try:
                  check = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                  if 'Item' not in check:
                      return build_response(404, {'error': f'Kitten with id "{kitten_id}" not found'})

                  table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                  return build_response(200, {'message': f'Kitten with id "{kitten_id}" deleted successfully'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return build_response(500, {'error': f'Failed to delete kitten: {str(e)}'})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions State Machine with alias, version, and multiple event-driven triggers including API Gateway, EventBridge rules, and EventBridge Scheduler

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for the state machine execution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions Standard State Machine with a single Pass state
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "StartAt": "ReturnResult",
          "States": {
            "ReturnResult": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": 1,
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Version of the state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alias pointing to the version with 100% weight
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: prod
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: StepFunctionsApi
      Description: REST API that triggers the Step Functions state machine alias
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayExecuteResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execute

  ApiGatewayGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayExecuteResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}",
              "input": "{}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            SelectionPattern: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: prod
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayGetMethod

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for API Gateway to start executions on the alias
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Rule – terminated state changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeTerminatedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Matches terminated Step Functions execution status changes
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - TERMINATED
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeTerminatedRole.Arn

  EventBridgeTerminatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Rule – scheduled every minute (initially disabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Scheduled rule that runs every minute (disabled by default)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeScheduledRole.Arn

  EventBridgeScheduledRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Rule – tag events from the AWS Tag service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeTagRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Responds to tag events from the AWS Tag service
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeTagRole.Arn

  EventBridgeTagRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge Scheduler – runs every minute with flexible time windows OFF
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeSchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: EventBridge Scheduler schedule that runs every minute
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeSchedulerRole.Arn

  EventBridgeSchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions alias (prod)
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias

    Description: URL of the API Gateway endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/execute
  EventBridgeSchedulerArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Scheduler schedule
    Value: !Ref EventBridgeSchedulerSchedule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC networking foundation with managed NAT gateways, VPC flow logs, and VPC endpoints for S3 and ECR'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: Retention period in days for CloudWatch Logs flow log group

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: REJECT
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture for VPC Flow Logs

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets (one per AZ)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets (one per AZ)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.128.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.144.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per public subnet / AZ)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-2'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table (routes through IGW)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:

      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  VPCFlowLog:

    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup

      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Creates a VPC infrastructure to support a Microsoft AD / Kerberos environment on EKS,
  including public/private subnets, NAT gateways, routing, VPC flow logs, a KMS key,
  and private VPC endpoints for SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages, and Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: KerberosEMRonEKS
    Description: Prefix used for resource naming.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # --------------------------------------------------------------- Subnets
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "0"
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Public-Subnet-A"

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.64/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "1"
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Public-Subnet-B"

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.128/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "0"
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Private-Subnet-A"

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.192/26
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - "1"
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Private-Subnet-B"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- EIPs & NATs
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-1"

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-2"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW-1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW-2"

  # ----------------------------------------------------------- Route Tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Public-RT"

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Private-RT-A"

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Private-RT-B"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  # -------------------------------------------------------------- KMS Key
  FlowLogKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key used to encrypt VPC flow logs"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to encrypt"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLog-KMS-Key"

  FlowLogKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKMSKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------ Flow Logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogs-Role"

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogFormat: "${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC-FlowLog"

  # ------------------------------------------------------- Shared Security Group
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for VPC interface endpoints"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPCEndpoint-SG"

  # --------------------------------------------------------- VPC Endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the created VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetA:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
  PublicSubnetB:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetB
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
  PrivateSubnetB:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
  NatGateway1:
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
  NatGateway2:
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
