AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with test user profile and dedicated IAM execution role'

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain
    Default: my-sagemaker-domain
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the test user profile to create in the domain
    Default: test-user
  DefaultS3BucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the default S3 bucket used by the domain
    Default: arn:aws:s3:::sagemaker-bucket
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: VPC ID for the domain (leave default to auto-create)
    Default: __USE_INTERNAL__
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Description: Comma-separated subnet IDs (leave default to auto-create)
    Default: __USE_INTERNAL__
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Description: Comma-separated security group IDs (leave default to auto-create)
    Default: __USE_INTERNAL__

Conditions:
  UseInternalNetwork: !Equals [!Ref VpcId, '__USE_INTERNAL__']

Resources:
  DomainVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: UseInternalNetwork
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'

  DomainSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: UseInternalNetwork
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DomainVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-1'

  DomainSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: UseInternalNetwork
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DomainVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet-2'

  DomainSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: UseInternalNetwork
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Domain Studio apps
      VpcId: !Ref DomainVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-sg'

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      RoleName: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerJobAndResourceManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerTrainingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrainingJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerTransformJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerAutoMLJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerExperimentAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:BatchDescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:BatchGetMetrics
                  - sagemaker:BatchGetRecord
                  - sagemaker:BatchPutMetrics
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerModelManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerStudioAppsSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerDomainAndUserProfile
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:ListDomains
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ReadWriteAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Ref DefaultS3BucketArn
                  - !Sub '${DefaultS3BucketArn}/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsForStudio
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRPullForSageMaker
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToSageMaker
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${DomainName}-execution-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - sagemaker.amazonaws.com

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      VpcId: !If [UseInternalNetwork, !Ref DomainVpc, !Ref VpcId]
      SubnetIds:
        !If
        - UseInternalNetwork
        - - !Ref DomainSubnet1
          - !Ref DomainSubnet2
        - !Split [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          !If
          - UseInternalNetwork
          - - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup
          - !Split [',', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]

  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: The ID of the created SageMaker Domain
    Value: !Ref SageMakerDomain
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: The name of the IAM execution role assigned to the domain user
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the IAM execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${SageMakerDomain}'
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID used by the domain
    Value: !If [UseInternalNetwork, !Ref DomainVpc, !Ref VpcId]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  CloudFormation template that creates 19 saved CloudWatch Logs Insights
  queries for analyzing usage, performance, and cost metrics generated by
  a Claude Code application. Queries are organized into logical groups
  covering real-time monitoring, user and session analytics, cost and
  attribution reporting, and additional debugging and analysis.

Parameters:
  MetricsLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: >-
      The CloudWatch Logs log group name where Claude Code metrics are
      published. All saved queries will be pre-configured to target this
      log group.

Resources:
  # ============================================================================
  # GROUP 1: REAL-TIME MONITORING
  # These queries provide live insight into current system usage, token and
  # request rates per user, TPM/RPM averages, and rate-limit risk.
  # ============================================================================

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 1: Token and request rate per user
  # Shows per-minute request count and total token consumption grouped by user
  # for the last 15 minutes, sorted chronologically.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryTokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-realtime-token-request-rate-per-user
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(15m)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats count() as requestCount, sum(totalTokens) as totalTokenUsage by userId, bin(1m)
        | sort by userId asc, bin(1m) asc
        | limit 10000
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 2: Current TPM / RPM averages
  # Computes average tokens-per-minute and requests-per-minute across all
  # users over the last 5 minutes, providing a quick health snapshot.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCurrentTPMAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-realtime-current-tpm-rpm-averages
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() / 5.0 as avgRPM,
            sum(totalTokens) / 5.0 as avgTPM,
            count() as totalRequests,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens
        | limit 1
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 3: Rate-limit risk assessment
  # Identifies users whose recent request or token rate is approaching typical
  # rate-limit thresholds, sorted by risk (highest request count first).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-realtime-rate-limit-risk
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"tpm":(?<tpm>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"rpm":(?<rpm>\d+)/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            max(tpm) as maxTPM,
            max(rpm) as maxRPM
          by userId
        | sort by requestCount desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ============================================================================
  # GROUP 2: USER AND SESSION ANALYTICS
  # These queries give teams visibility into per-session usage, hourly activity
  # patterns, and errors or throttling events.
  # ============================================================================

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 4: Session-level usage breakdown
  # Aggregates token consumption, request count, and cost per session for the
  # last 24 hours, sorted by most expensive session first.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-sessions-session-level-usage
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(24h)
        | parse @message /"sessionId":"(?<sessionId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            min(@timestamp) as sessionStart,
            max(@timestamp) as sessionEnd
          by sessionId, userId
        | sort by totalCost desc
        | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 5: Hourly activity timeline
  # Shows total requests and tokens per hour over the last 7 days, useful for
  # identifying peak usage periods and daily patterns.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-sessions-hourly-activity-timeline
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens
          by bin(1h)
        | sort by bin(1h) asc
        | limit 200
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 6: Error and throttling detection
  # Captures all non-success events (errors, throttles, timeouts) in the last
  # 24 hours, broken down by status code / error type and user.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryErrorThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-sessions-error-throttling-detection
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(24h)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"sessionId":"(?<sessionId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"errorCode":"(?<errorCode>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status != "success"
        | stats count() as errorCount by status, errorCode, userId
        | sort by errorCount desc
        | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ============================================================================
  # GROUP 3: COST AND ATTRIBUTION REPORTING
  # These queries break down costs and usage by user, model, and organization
  # for finance and capacity-planning stakeholders.
  # ============================================================================

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 7: Cost attribution by user
  # Reports total cost and token usage per user for the current month.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-cost-by-user
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            count() as requestCount
          by userId
        | sort by totalCost desc
        | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 8: Cost attribution by model
  # Reports total cost and token usage per AI model (e.g., Claude Sonnet,
  # Claude Haiku) for the current month.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-cost-by-model
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | parse @message /"model":"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            count() as requestCount
          by model
        | sort by totalCost desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 9: Cost attribution by organization
  # Reports total cost and token usage per organization or team for the
  # current month.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-cost-by-organization
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | parse @message /"organization":"(?<organization>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            count() as requestCount
          by organization
        | sort by totalCost desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ============================================================================
  # GROUP 4: ADDITIONAL DEBUGGING AND ANALYSIS
  # A collection of specialised queries for model efficiency, caching
  # behaviour, peak usage windows, deep-dive lookups, field discovery, and
  # daily summaries.
  # ============================================================================

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 10: Model efficiency analysis
  # Computes input-to-output token ratios per model to evaluate efficiency.
  # A high output/input ratio may indicate verbose responses.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-model-efficiency
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"model":"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"inputTokens":(?<inputTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"outputTokens":(?<outputTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(inputTokens) as totalInputTokens,
            sum(outputTokens) as totalOutputTokens,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            avg(outputTokens) as avgOutputTokens,
            max(outputTokens) as maxOutputTokens
          by model
        | sort by totalTokens desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 11: Cache hit/miss rate (overall)
  # Provides the aggregate cache-hit and cache-miss ratio across all requests
  # for the last 7 days.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-cache-hit-miss-overall
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"cacheHit":(?<cacheHit>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"cacheMiss":(?<cacheMiss>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success" and (ispresent(cacheHit) or ispresent(cacheMiss))
        | stats
            count() as totalRequests,
            sum(cacheHit) as totalCacheHits,
            sum(cacheMiss) as totalCacheMisses,
            sum(cacheHit) * 100.0 / count() as cacheHitPercent,
            sum(cacheMiss) * 100.0 / count() as cacheMissPercent
        | limit 1
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 12: Cache hit/miss rate over time
  # Charts cache performance in 1-hour bins over the last 7 days to spot
  # regressions or improvements.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-cache-hit-miss-over-time
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"cacheHit":(?<cacheHit>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"cacheMiss":(?<cacheMiss>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success" and (ispresent(cacheHit) or ispresent(cacheMiss))
        | stats
            count() as totalRequests,
            sum(cacheHit) as totalCacheHits,
            sum(cacheMiss) as totalCacheMisses,
            sum(cacheHit) * 100.0 / count() as cacheHitPercent,
            sum(cacheMiss) * 100.0 / count() as cacheMissPercent
          by bin(1h)
        | sort by bin(1h) asc
        | limit 200
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 13: Cache hit/miss rate by session
  # Identifies sessions with the best and worst cache utilisation to help
  # developers optimise caching strategies.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryCacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-cache-hit-miss-by-session
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"sessionId":"(?<sessionId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"cacheHit":(?<cacheHit>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"cacheMiss":(?<cacheMiss>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success" and (ispresent(cacheHit) or ispresent(cacheMiss))
        | stats
            count() as totalRequests,
            sum(cacheHit) as totalCacheHits,
            sum(cacheMiss) as totalCacheMisses,
            sum(cacheHit) * 100.0 / count() as cacheHitPercent
          by sessionId
        | sort by cacheHitPercent desc
        | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 14: Peak usage windows
  # Finds the 1-hour windows with the highest request and token volume over
  # the last 7 days, useful for capacity planning.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-peak-usage-windows
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens
          by bin(1h)
        | sort by requestCount desc
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 15: Deep-dive session lookup
  # Returns every event belonging to a specific session. The user must replace
  # the placeholder session ID before running.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryDeepDiveSessionLookup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-deep-dive-session-lookup
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"sessionId":"(?<sessionId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"model":"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"operation":"(?<operation>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"inputTokens":(?<inputTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"outputTokens":(?<outputTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"latencyMs":(?<latencyMs>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | filter sessionId = "REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID"
        | sort by @timestamp asc
        | limit 10000
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 16: Field explorer
  # Discovers which JSON keys are present in recent log events so end users
  # can understand available metric attributes before writing custom queries.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-field-explorer
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(1h)
        | parse @message /^\{(?<jsonBody>.*)\}$/
        | limit 20
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 17: Daily usage summary
  # Aggregates key daily metrics (requests, tokens, cost, unique users, unique
  # sessions) for the last 30 days.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-daily-usage-summary
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"sessionId":"(?<sessionId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            approx_distinct_count(userId) as uniqueUsers,
            approx_distinct_count(sessionId) as uniqueSessions
          by bin(1d)
        | sort by bin(1d) asc
        | limit 31
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 18: Latency and performance percentiles
  # Calculates p50, p90, p99, and max latency in milliseconds per model for
  # the last 7 days, useful for SLO tracking.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryLatencyPercentiles:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-latency-percentiles
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | parse @message /"model":"(?<model>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"latencyMs":(?<latencyMs>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success" and ispresent(latencyMs)
        | stats
            count() as requestCount,
            avg(latencyMs) as avgLatencyMs,
            min(latencyMs) as minLatencyMs,
            max(latencyMs) as maxLatencyMs,
            percentile(latencyMs, 50) as p50LatencyMs,
            percentile(latencyMs, 90) as p90LatencyMs,
            percentile(latencyMs, 99) as p99LatencyMs
          by model
        | sort by avgLatencyMs desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Query 19: Top-N users by token consumption
  # Lists the heaviest users by total token consumption over the last 30 days
  # to identify power users and outliers.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QueryTopUsersByTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: claude-code-debug-top-users-by-tokens
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | filter @logGroup = "${MetricsLogGroupName}"
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | parse @message /"userId":"(?<userId>[^"]+)"/
        | parse @message /"totalTokens":(?<totalTokens>\d+)/
        | parse @message /"cost":(?<cost>[^,}]+)/
        | parse @message /"status":"(?<status>[^"]+)"/
        | filter status = "success"
        | stats
            sum(totalTokens) as totalTokens,
            sum(cost) as totalCost,
            count() as requestCount,
            approx_distinct_count(sessionId) as sessionCount
          by userId
        | sort by totalTokens desc
        | limit 50
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref MetricsLogGroupName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB table, multiple data sources, and IAM authentication"

Resources:
  #############################################################################
  # DynamoDB Table with on-demand billing and string id primary key
  #############################################################################
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  #############################################################################
  # AppSync GraphQL API: SuperCoolAPI with IAM auth and full CloudWatch logging
  #############################################################################
  AppSyncApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  #############################################################################
  # IAM Role for AppSync CloudWatch Logs
  #############################################################################
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs

  #############################################################################
  # IAM Role for AppSync DynamoDB access
  #############################################################################
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  #############################################################################
  # IAM Policy granting full read-write access to the DynamoDB table
  # and all its secondary indexes (GSIs and LSIs)
  #############################################################################
  AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref AppSyncDynamoDBRole
      PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
              - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"

  #############################################################################
  # GraphQL Schema (Todo type, getTodo query, create/update/delete mutations)
  #############################################################################
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: String!
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: String!): Todo
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(id: String!, description: String): Todo
          updateTodo(id: String!, description: String): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: String!): Todo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  #############################################################################
  # Data Source 1 – uses !Ref for table name and !Ref for region
  #############################################################################
  DataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBRef
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"

  #############################################################################
  # Data Source 2 – extracts table name and region from the DynamoDB ARN
  # using Fn::Select / Fn::Split (a different referencing approach)
  #############################################################################
  DataSourceSelect:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBSelect
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        # Extract table name from ARN: arn:aws:dynamodb:region:account:table/TableName
        TableName: !Select
          - 1
          - !Split
            - "table/"
            - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
        # Extract region from ARN: arn:aws:dynamodb:REGION:account:table/TableName
        AwsRegion: !Select
          - 3
          - !Split
            - ":"
            - !GetAtt Table1.Arn

  #############################################################################
  # Data Source 3 – uses Fn::Sub for both table name and region
  #############################################################################
  DataSourceSub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBSub
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Sub "${Table1}"
        AwsRegion: !Sub "${AWS::Region}"

  #############################################################################
  # Resolvers – each uses a different data source to demonstrate all three
  #############################################################################
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: "$util.toJson($ctx.result)"

  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceSelect.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: "$util.toJson($ctx.result)"

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "UpdateItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "update": {
            "expression": "SET description = :description",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: "$util.toJson($ctx.result)"

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt AppSyncApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceSub.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "DeleteItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: "$util.toJson($ctx.result)"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM roles and policies for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap with EKS managed node groups and Fargate"

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Instance Profiles (one per EC2-assumable role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlaneRole

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

  CAPANodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPANodesRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2-assumable roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CAPAControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPAControlPlaneRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # Customer managed policies attached via Roles property on each ManagedPolicy

  CAPAControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPAControllersRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  CAPANodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPANodesRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS service roles

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

        Version: "2012-10-17"

  EKSManagedNodeGroupRole:

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup

              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey

              - kms:GenerateDataKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn Shuffle Service"

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet (AZ1)

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet (AZ2)

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (AZ1)

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (AZ2)

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First Availability Zone

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::AvailabilityZone::Name
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second Availability Zone

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-VPC

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-NATGW1-EIP

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-NATGW2-EIP

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per Availability Zone)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-NATGW-AZ1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-NATGW-AZ2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Public-Subnet-AZ1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Public-Subnet-AZ2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Private-Subnet-AZ1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Private-Subnet-AZ2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table and Routes
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Public-RT

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Route Table for AZ1
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Private-RT-AZ1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Route Table for AZ2
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-Private-RT-AZ2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Gateway Endpoint (reachable from all route tables)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Group for Interface VPC Endpoints
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1024
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-VPCEndpoints-SG

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  STSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EMREndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.emr-containers"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-Managed KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: key-policy-flowlogs
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-FlowLogs-KMSKey

  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/EMRonEKS-Celeborn-FlowLogs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKMSKey

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs Group for Flow Logs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs/emroneks-celeborn
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs Delivery
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPC-Flow-Logs-Publish
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-FlowLogs-Role

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (all traffic, encrypted)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: EMRonEKS-Celeborn-FlowLogs

Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VPCCIDR:
    Description: VPC CIDR block
    Value: !Ref VpcCIDR

  PublicSubnet1ID:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2ID:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID (AZ2)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1ID:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2ID:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID (AZ2)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM identities and permissions for Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA)
  bootstrap and operation.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS Control Plane Role – assumed by the EKS service itself.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-EKSControlPlane-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Path: /

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Control Plane Role – assumed by EC2 instances that host the Kubernetes
  # control plane.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-ControlPlane-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        # EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling, ECR, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        # Broader permissions for EC2 networking, EKS cluster/nodegroup
        # management, and service-linked role creation
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
      Path: /

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: CAPA-ControlPlane-InstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Worker Node Role – assumed by EC2 instances that act as Kubernetes
  # worker nodes.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-WorkerNode-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        # EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling, ECR, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
      Path: /

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: CAPA-WorkerNode-InstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Controllers Role – assumed by EC2 instances running the Cluster API
  # controllers, and also by EKS Pods (via Pod Identity).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CAPA-Controllers-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Sid: EC2
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
            Sid: EKSPodIdentity
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        # Broader permissions covering EC2 networking, load balancing, auto
        # scaling, EKS cluster/nodegroup management, and service-linked role
        # creation.
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
      Path: /

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: CAPA-Controllers-InstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bootstrapper Group – grants the same controller-level managed policies.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: CAPA-Bootstrapper-Group
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
      Path: /

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bootstrapper User – used for cluster lifecycle operations.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: CAPA-Bootstrapper-User
      Path: /

  BootstrapperUserToGroupAddition:

    Properties:
