AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience.
  Deployable in both regions with configurable environment name,
  private/public subnets across 3 AZs, optional NAT Gateway setup,
  and VPC Flow Logs with 7-day CloudWatch Logs retention.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Name of the environment (e.g., production, staging)
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Description: >
      NAT Gateway deployment mode. 'Single' creates one NAT Gateway in the first
      public subnet (cost-effective). 'PerAZ' creates one NAT Gateway per
      Availability Zone for high availability.

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, Single]
  IsPerAzNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, PerAZ]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets (10.0.101.0/24, 10.0.102.0/24, 10.0.103.0/24)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets (10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.3.0/24)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # NAT Gateway 1 (always created)
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # NAT Gateway 2 (PerAZ only)
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # NAT Gateway 3 (PerAZ only)
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Route Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Private routes to NAT Gateway 1 (single mode) or per-AZ NAT
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsSingleNat, !Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway1]

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsSingleNat, !Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2]

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If [IsSingleNat, !Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway3]

  # Private subnet associations
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs (7-day retention, CloudWatch Logs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Completely isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application.
  The VPC spans three Availability Zones with three private subnets and has no
  internet gateway or NAT gateway, so there is no direct internet access.
  Interface VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) are provided for Amazon Bedrock
  (runtime inference), Amazon ECR (api and dkr for container image retrieval),
  CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch Monitoring, DynamoDB, the RDS Data API, Secrets
  Manager, SSM Parameter Store, KMS, S3 and X-Ray. VPC Flow Logs capture ALL
  traffic and are encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key that has automatic
  key rotation enabled. Dedicated security groups are created for the Agent
  Runtime, MCP Runtime and Lambda function components; each allows HTTPS-only
  (443/TCP) egress to the VPC endpoints, and the components that require it are
  additionally permitted to reach DynamoDB directly.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC and private subnets (no internet gateway / no NAT gateway)
  ##########################################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support
        - Key: Connectivity
          Value: isolated-private

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Connectivity
          Value: isolated-private

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB

  PrivateSubnetCRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC

  ##########################################################################
  # Customer-managed KMS key (automatic rotation) and CloudWatch Logs group
  # used to encrypt and store VPC Flow Logs
  ##########################################################################

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption (${AWS::StackName})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-key'
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-role'
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to deliver flow records to the encrypted CloudWatch Logs group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlogs-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Application
          Value: ai-customer-support

  ##########################################################################
  # Security groups
  #  - EndpointSecurityGroup: ingress on 443 from each application component
  #    (shared by all interface endpoints except DynamoDB)
  #  - DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup: ingress on 443 only from the components
  #    that need direct DynamoDB access (Agent Runtime and Lambda)
  #  - One egress-only security group per application component (Agent Runtime,
  #    MCP Runtime, Lambda) with HTTPS-only (443/TCP) outbound rules
  ##########################################################################

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} interface VPC endpoint HTTPS access'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
          Description: Deny all outbound traffic; interface endpoint ENIs do not initiate connections
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB endpoint HTTPS access for components needing direct access'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
          Description: Deny all outbound traffic; interface endpoint ENIs do not initiate connections
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-endpoint-sg'

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} Agent Runtime HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS directly to the DynamoDB VPC endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-agent-runtime-sg'
        - Key: Component
          Value: agent-runtime

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} MCP Runtime HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-runtime-sg'
        - Key: Component
          Value: mcp-runtime

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} Lambda functions HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow HTTPS directly to the DynamoDB VPC endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-sg'
        - Key: Component
          Value: lambda

  # Ingress rules are separate resources so that the component security groups
  # can reference the endpoint security groups for egress without creating a
  # circular dependency between the security group resources.

  EndpointIngressFromAgentRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the Agent Runtime component

  EndpointIngressFromMcpRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt McpRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the MCP Runtime component

  EndpointIngressFromLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress

      GroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the Lambda function component

  DynamoDbIngressFromAgentRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow direct HTTPS from the Agent Runtime component to DynamoDB

  DynamoDbIngressFromLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt LambdaSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: Allow direct HTTPS from the Lambda function component to DynamoDB

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  VPC infrastructure for Amazon EKS spanning three Availability Zones with
  public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, and security groups for the EKS control
  plane and application ingress.

Parameters:
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-cluster-vpc
    Description: Name tag applied to all VPC resources

  PublicSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1

  PublicSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2

  PublicSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 3

  PrivateSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1

  PrivateSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.5.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2

  PrivateSubnetCidr3:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.6.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 3

Conditions:
  IsUsEast1: !Equals [!Ref "AWS::Region", "us-east-1"]

Mappings:
  AzMap:
    us-east-1:
      Az1: us-east-1a
      Az2: us-east-1b
      Az3: us-east-1c
    us-east-2:
      Az1: us-east-2a
      Az2: us-east-2b
      Az3: us-east-2c
    us-west-1:
      Az1: us-west-1a
      Az2: us-west-1b
      Az3: us-west-1c
    us-west-2:
      Az1: us-west-2a
      Az2: us-west-2b
      Az3: us-west-2c
    eu-west-1:
      Az1: eu-west-1a
      Az2: eu-west-1b
      Az3: eu-west-1c
    eu-west-2:
      Az1: eu-west-2a
      Az2: eu-west-2b
      Az3: eu-west-2c
    eu-west-3:
      Az1: eu-west-3a
      Az2: eu-west-3b

Resources:
  # VPC
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-igw"

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-eip-1"

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-eip-2"

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-eip-3"

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az1]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az2]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az3]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-public-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az1]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az2]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr3
      AvailabilityZone: !If
        - IsUsEast1
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
        - !FindInMap [AzMap, !Ref "AWS::Region", Az3]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/eks-cluster
          Value: shared
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  # Public Subnet Route Table Associations
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateways (one per public subnet)
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-2"

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-nat-gw-3"

  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-2"

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-private-rt-3"

  # Private routes to NAT Gateways (per AZ)
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  # Private Subnet Route Table Associations (per AZ)
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # EKS Control Plane Security Group
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS control plane communication with worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-eks-control-plane-sg"

  EksControlPlaneIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the internet to the EKS control plane

  EksControlPlaneSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: "-1"
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow all traffic within the control plane security group

  EksControlPlaneEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: "-1"
      CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      Description: Allow all outbound traffic from the control plane to the VPC CIDR

  # Application Security Group (exposes HTTP, HTTPS, and custom TCP ports to the internet)
  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for application ingress ports (HTTP, HTTPS, and custom service mesh / ingress gateway ports)
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${VpcName}-app-sg"

  # HTTP ingress from internet
  AppHttpIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow HTTP from the internet

  # HTTPS ingress from internet
  AppHttpsIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow HTTPS from the internet

  # Custom TCP ports (ingress / service mesh gateway ports)
  AppCustomTcpPort8443Ingress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8443
      ToPort: 8443
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow custom TCP 8443 (e.g., Istio ingress gateway)

  AppCustomTcpPort15021Ingress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 15021
      ToPort: 15021
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow custom TCP 15021 (e.g., Istio health check)

  AppCustomTcpPort15020Ingress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 15020
      ToPort: 15020
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Description: Allow custom TCP 15020 (e.g., Istio envoy admin)

  AppEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: "-1"
      CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidrBlock
      Description: Allow all outbound traffic from application instances to the VPC CIDR

  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

    Description: Security group ID for the EKS control plane

    Export:

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:

    Export:

    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3, !Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'SageMaker HyperPod IAM Execution Role with EKS Integration'

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Resource name prefix used to name the execution role
    Default: MyHyperPod
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster for pod identity access
    Default: my-eks-cluster
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: VPC ID for scoping ENI management actions
    Default: ''
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: List of security group IDs for scoped permissions
    Default: ''
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: List of private subnet IDs for scoped permissions
    Default: ''
  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name for lifecycle scripts
    Default: my-lifecycle-scripts-bucket
  RigInputBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG input (optional)
    Default: ''
  RigOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name for RIG output (optional)
    Default: ''
  CreateRigResources:

  EnableGatedAccess:

    AllowedValues:

  EnableGatedAccess: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  CreateRigPolicy: !And

Resources:
  SageMakerHyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub '${Prefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: HyperPodManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !If

                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}'
                    - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              - Effect: Allow

                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow

                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow

              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${Prefix}RigPolicy'

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - EnableGatedAccess
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::*sagemaker*'

              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface

            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/*'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates three private subnets across three AZs with dedicated route tables, NAT gateways, network ACL associations, an S3 VPC Endpoint, and dynamic exports."

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Default: "10.24.0.0/16"

  SubnetCIDRA:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet A"
    Default: "10.24.24.0/24"

  SubnetCIDRB:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet B"
    Default: "10.24.25.0/24"

  SubnetCIDRC:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet C"
    Default: "10.24.26.0/24"

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway (required for NAT Gateways)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets (for NAT Gateways)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: "10.24.0.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: "10.24.1.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PublicSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: "10.24.2.0/24"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Route Table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rtb"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssocA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssocB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssocC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network ACL
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  NetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nacl"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # Allow inbound HTTP, HTTPS, and ephemeral ports
  NetworkAclEntryInbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  NetworkAclEntryInboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  NetworkAclEntryInboundEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # Allow outbound HTTP, HTTPS, and ephemeral ports
  NetworkAclEntryOutboundHTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  NetworkAclEntryOutboundHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  NetworkAclEntryOutboundEphemeral:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDRA
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDRB
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PrivateSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDRC
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables (Private)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  PrivateRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Default Routes via NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet-to-Route-Table Associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  SubnetRouteTableAssocA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  SubnetRouteTableAssocB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  SubnetRouteTableAssocC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet-to-Network-ACL Associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  SubnetNetworkAclAssocA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl

  SubnetNetworkAclAssocB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl

  SubnetNetworkAclAssocC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetC
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAcl

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 VPC Endpoint (Gateway Endpoint)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-vpc-endpoint"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-vpc-id"

  NatGatewayIdAZA:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1a"
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-a"

  NatGatewayIdAZB:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1b"
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-b"

  NatGatewayIdAZC:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1c"
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw-c"

  NetworkAclId:
    Description: "ID of the network ACL"
    Value: !Ref NetworkAcl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-nacl-id"

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-ids"

  RouteTableIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of route table IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-route-table-ids"

  SubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: "CIDR block encompassing the subnet group"
    Value: "10.24.24.0/21"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-subnet-group-cidr"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for common operational personas.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MANAGED POLICIES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # System Administrator: near-full access outside of IAM itself.
  SystemAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: persona-system-administrator
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccessExceptIam
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction: "iam:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: "false"
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsTamper
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceAlias: "*log*"

  # IAM Administrator: full IAM access.
  IamAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: persona-iam-administrator
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: IamFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: "iam:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: "false"
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsTamper
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceAlias: "*log*"

  # Instance Operations: EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling; denied VPC modification.
  InstanceOperationsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: persona-instance-operations
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: InstanceServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: "false"
          - Sid: DenyVpcNetworkingModification
            Effect: Deny
            Resource: "*"
            Action:
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachVpnGateway
              - ec2:CreateCarrierGateway
              - ec2:CreateCustomerGateway
              - ec2:CreateDefaultSubnet
              - ec2:CreateDefaultVpc
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTransitGateway
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnConnection
              - ec2:CreateVpnConnectionRoute
              - ec2:CreateVpnGateway
              - ec2:DeleteCustomerGateway
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGateway
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpnConnectionRoute
              - ec2:DeleteVpnGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachVpnGateway
              - ec2:DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateTransitGatewayRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions
              - ec2:ModifyVpcTenancy
              - ec2:RejectTransitGatewayPeeringAttachment
              - ec2:RejectTransitGatewayVpcAttachment
              - ec2:RejectVpcEndpointConnections
              - ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress
              - ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsTamper
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceAlias: "*log*"

  # Read-only Administrator: broad read-only access across core services.
  ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: persona-readonly-administrator
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:GetMetric*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - rds:Describe*
              - lambda:Get*
              - lambda:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:Get*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - sqs:Get*
              - sqs:List*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Get*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - logs:List*
              - cloudtrail:Describe*
              - cloudtrail:Get*
              - cloudtrail:List*
              - config:Describe*
              - config:Get*
              - config:List*
              - ssm:Describe*
              - ssm:Get*
              - ssm:List*
              - sts:GetCallerIdentity
              - sts:GetSessionToken
              - sts:DecodeAuthorizationMessage
              - acm:Describe*
              - acm:Get*
              - acm:List*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: RequireMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: "false"
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: DenyLoggingKmsTamper
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:ResourceAlias: "*log*"

  # Read-only Billing: limited to viewing billing information.
  ReadOnlyBillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: persona-readonly-billing
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyBillingAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:ViewBilling
              - aws-portal:ViewUsage
              - ce:Describe*
              - ce:Get*
              - ce:List*
              - cur:Describe*
              - cur:Get*
            Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GROUPS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SystemAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: persona-system-administrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  IamAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: persona-iam-administrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorPolicy

  InstanceOperationsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: persona-instance-operations
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: persona-readonly-administrator
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: persona-readonly-billing
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyBillingPolicy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROLES & INSTANCE PROFILES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SystemAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: persona-system-administrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorPolicy

  SystemAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: persona-system-administrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdministratorRole

  IamAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: persona-iam-administrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorPolicy

  IamAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: persona-iam-administrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref IamAdministratorRole

  InstanceOperationsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: persona-instance-operations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsPolicy

  InstanceOperationsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: persona-instance-operations
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOperationsRole

  ReadOnlyAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: persona-readonly-administrator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: persona-readonly-administrator
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorRole

Outputs:
  SystemAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: ID of the system administrator group
    Value: !Ref SystemAdministratorGroup
  IamAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: ID of the IAM administrator group
    Value: !Ref IamAdministratorGroup
  InstanceOperationsGroupId:
    Description: ID of the instance operations group
    Value: !Ref InstanceOperationsGroup
  ReadOnlyAdministratorGroupId:
    Description: ID of the read-only administrator group
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdministratorGroup
  ReadOnlyBillingGroupId:
    Description: ID of the read-only billing group
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyBillingGroup

Description: "VPC with three-tier architecture (Web, Application, Database) across three Availability Zones"

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierIGW

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ── Web Tier Subnets (public, one per AZ) ───────────────────────────────────
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet3

  # ── Application Tier Subnets (private, one per AZ) ──────────────────────────
  AppSubnet1:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:

      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.13.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet3

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.21.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet1
