    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.22.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.23.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet3

  # ── Web Tier Route Table (shared across all web subnets) ────────────────────
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebRouteTable

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: AttachGateway

  WebSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # ── Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways (one per AZ) ──────────────────────────────
  NatEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEip3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # ── NAT Gateways (one in each web-tier subnet) ─────────────────────────────
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGatewayAZ1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGatewayAZ2

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGatewayAZ3

  # ── Application Tier Route Tables (one per AZ, each routed through its AZ's NAT) ──
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTableAZ1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTableAZ2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTableAZ3

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # ── Database Tier Route Tables (one per AZ, each routed through its AZ's NAT) ──
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTableAZ1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTableAZ2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTableAZ3

  DbDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "The ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of the three Availability Zones used"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]

  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of web-tier subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
        - !Ref WebSubnet3

  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of application-tier subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref AppSubnet1
        - !Ref AppSubnet2
        - !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of database-tier subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref DbSubnet1
        - !Ref DbSubnet2
        - !Ref DbSubnet3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM Roles and Instance Profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start (IAM-ROLES)"

Parameters:
  SSMPath:
    Type: String
    Default: "/quickstart/amazon-eks"
    Description: "SSM parameter store path for storing role ARNs"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 1. EKS CONTROL PLANE ROLE
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-control-plane-extra-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: "*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 2. FARGATE EXECUTION ROLE
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 3. MANAGED NODE INSTANCE ROLE
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  ManagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeInstanceRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 4. UNMANAGED NODE INSTANCE ROLE
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-cfn-signal
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeInstanceRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 5. LAMBDA EXECUTION ROLES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

  # 5a. Lambda role for copying zip artifacts from S3
  LambdaCopyZipRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-copy-zip-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-copy-zip-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: "*"

  # 5b. Lambda role for reading resource information (read-only + basic execution)
  LambdaReadResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-read-resource-info-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  # 5c. Lambda role for creating the VPC role
  LambdaCreateVPCRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-create-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-create-vpc-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVpc
                  - ec2:CreateSubnet
                  - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRouteTable
                  - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:AssociateAddress
                  - ec2:CreateNatGateway
                Resource: "*"

  # 5d. Lambda role for deleting bucket contents
  LambdaDeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-delete-bucket-contents-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-delete-bucket-contents-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: "*"

  # 5e. Lambda role for cleaning up load balancers
  LambdaCleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-cleanup-load-balancers-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-cleanup-load-balancers-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"

  # 5f. Lambda role for cleaning up security group dependencies
  LambdaCleanupSGRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-cleanup-sg-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-cleanup-sg-permissions

    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for web subnet in AZ2"

  AppSubnetCidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for app subnet in AZ1"

  AppSubnetCidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.4.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for app subnet in AZ2"

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1a"
    Description: "First Availability Zone"

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1b"
    Description: "Second Availability Zone"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  LabVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVpc

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets - Web Tier
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Web

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets - Application Tier
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCidr1
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: App

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCidr2
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: App

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Route Table
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SharedRouteTable

  # Route table associations - Web subnets
  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  # Route table associations - App subnets
  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref SharedRouteTable

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Group - Web Tier
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR"
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref SharedRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - "s3:GetObject"
              - "s3:ListBucket"
              - "s3:PutObject"
              - "s3:DeleteObject"
            Resource: "*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoint for Kinesis Data Firehose
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "The ID of the Lab VPC"
    Value: !Ref LabVpc
    Export:
      Name: LabVpcId

  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: "ID of web subnet 1"
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: WebSubnet1Id

  WebSubnet2Id:

      Name: WebSubnet2Id

  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: "ID of application subnet 1"
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: AppSubnet1Id

  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: "ID of application subnet 2"
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: AppSubnet2Id

  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "ID of the web tier security group"
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: WebSecurityGroupId

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Shared EKS prerequisites: IAM roles and instance profiles for multi-cluster deployments'

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-shared
    Description: Common name prefix for all resources created by this template

Resources:

  # ======================================================================
  # 1. LAMBDA EXECUTION ROLES FOR CUSTOM RESOURCE HANDLERS
  # ======================================================================

  # 1a. Copy deployment assets between S3 buckets
  S3CopyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-s3-copy
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3CopyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for copying deployment assets between S3 buckets

  # 1b. Read arbitrary AWS resources
  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-resource-reader
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResourceReadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:Get*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - lambda:Get*
                  - lambda:List*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - kms:Describe*
                  - kms:List*
                  - ssm:Get*
                  - ssm:List*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for reading arbitrary AWS resources

  # 1c. Create a VPC-related IAM role
  VpcRoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-vpc-role-creator
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcRoleCreationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for creating a VPC-related IAM role

  # 1d. Delete contents of S3 buckets
  S3BucketCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-s3-cleaner
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3CleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for deleting the contents of S3 buckets

  # 1e. Clean up orphaned load balancers and dependent SGs/NICs
  LoadBalancerCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-lb-cleaner
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LoadBalancerCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up orphaned load balancers, security groups, and network interfaces

  # 1f. Clean up leftover Lambda functions
  LambdaCleanerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-lambda-cleaner
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:ListEventSourceMappings
                  - lambda:ListLayerVersions
                  - lambda:DeleteLayerVersion
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for cleaning up leftover Lambda functions

  # 1g. Look up the calling identity
  CallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-caller-identity
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for looking up the calling identity

  # 1h. Register CloudFormation resource provider types and associated custom resources
  ResourceTypeRegistrarRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-type-registrar
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ResourceTypeRegistrationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                  - cloudformation:CreateResource
                  - cloudformation:UpdateResource
                  - cloudformation:DeleteResource
                  - cloudformation:ListResources
                  - cloudformation:GetResource
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for registering CloudFormation resource provider types and custom resources

  # 1i. Resolve Systems Manager parameters under a common configuration path
  SsmParameterResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-ssm-resolver
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmParameterResolutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${Prefix}/*
      Description: Lambda execution role for resolving Systems Manager parameters under the common configuration path

  # 1j. Create the IAM role that CloudFormation assumes when provisioning cluster VPC resources
  ClusterVpcRoleCreatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-lambda-cluster-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ClusterVpcRoleCreationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
                  - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                Resource: '*'
      Description: Lambda execution role for creating the IAM role that CloudFormation assumes when provisioning cluster VPC resources

  # ======================================================================
  # 2. EKS CONTROL PLANE ROLE
  # ======================================================================

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-eks-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Description: IAM role for the EKS control plane

  # ======================================================================
  # 3. FARGATE PROFILE ROLE
  # ======================================================================

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-fargate-profile
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
      Description: IAM role that Fargate profiles assume

  # ======================================================================
  # 4. MANAGED NODE GROUP ROLE & INSTANCE PROFILE
  # ======================================================================

  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-managed-node
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'
      Description: IAM role for managed EC2 worker nodes

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${Prefix}-managed-node
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ======================================================================
  # 5. UNMANAGED (SELF-MANAGED) NODE GROUP ROLE & INSTANCE PROFILE
  # ======================================================================

  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${Prefix}-unmanaged-node
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'
      Description: IAM role for unmanaged (self-managed) EC2 worker nodes

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${Prefix}-unmanaged-node
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained IAM user/group config with an automatically generated Secrets Manager secret for testing."

Parameters:
  ID:
    Type: String
    Default: "999hadvhgchjesr"
    Description: "Identifier suffix used when naming the IAM group."

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager secret containing a JSON template with a fixed
  # username and a generated 15-character password.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  MinesweeperSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Description: "Minesweeper user secret"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"minesweeper-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 15
        RequireEachIncludedType: true
        ExcludeCharacters: "|;,.\"<>%`"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda-backed custom resource that reads the username/password keys
  # dynamically from the generated secret at deploy time.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecretReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecretReaderPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref MinesweeperSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  SecretReaderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt SecretReaderRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return

                  secret_arn = event["ResourceProperties"]["SecretArn"]
                  secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
                  response = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                  data = json.loads(response["SecretString"])

                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                      {
                          "Username": data["username"],
                          "Password": data["password"],
                          "Arn": response["ARN"],
                      },
                  )
              except Exception as error:
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event,
                      context,
                      cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {"Error": str(error)},
                  )

  SecretReader:
    Type: Custom::MinesweeperSecretReader
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretReaderFunction.Arn
      SecretArn: !Ref MinesweeperSecret

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM group with an inline policy granting full ec2, cloudformation,
  # and secretmanager access.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  MinesweeperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "minesweeper-${ID}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MinesweeperFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - secretmanager:*
                Resource: "*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM user whose username and console login password resolve from the
  # username/password keys of the created secret, assigned to the group.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  MinesweeperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !GetAtt SecretReader.Username
      Groups:
        - !Ref MinesweeperGroup
      LoginProfile:
        Password: !GetAtt SecretReader.Password
        PasswordResetRequired: false

Outputs:
  UserArn:
    Description: "ARN of the minesweeper IAM user"
    Value: !GetAtt MinesweeperUser.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Multi-account Transit Gateway network hub and Resource Access Manager share
  infrastructure for enterprise network transit. Creates an EC2 Transit Gateway
  together with a RAM Resource Share when deployed in the primary transit account,
  or a custom-resource reference resolver when deployed in a secondary spoke account.

Parameters:
  ReferenceFunctionsStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: ReferenceFunctions
    Description: Name of the stack exposing the TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn export.
  CompanyName:
    Type: String
    Default: Camelz
    Description: Company name used for identification and tagging.
  SystemName:
    Type: String
    Default: Prototype
    Description: System name used for identification and tagging.
  AccountName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Account name used for identification and tagging.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core
    Description: Environment name used for identification and tagging.
  TransitGatewayAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      Account ID where the Transit Gateway is owned. When left empty or set to the
      current account, this stack provisions the Transit Gateway and RAM share.
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]*$
  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: BGP ASN for the Transit Gateway.
  AutoAcceptSharedAttachments:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether to automatically accept shared attachment requests.
  DnsSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether DNS support is enabled for the Transit Gateway.
  VpnEcmpSupport:
    Type: String
    Default: enable
    AllowedValues:
      - enable
      - disable
    Description: Whether VPN Equal Cost Multipath routing support is enabled.
  TransitGatewayResourceShareName:
    Type: String
    Default: Core-TransitGatewayResourceShare
    Description: Name of the Resource Access Manager resource share.
  Organization:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS Organizations ID to share the Transit Gateway with.
  AllowExternalPrincipals:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether external principals may be associated with the share.
  OrganizationAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the organization account.
  JumpstartAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the jumpstart account.
  ManagementAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the management account.
  LogAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the log account.
  RecoveryAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the recovery account.
  BuildAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the build account.
  CoreAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the core account.
  ProductionAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the production account.
  StagingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the staging account.
  UATAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the UAT account.
  QAAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the QA account.
  TestingAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the testing account.
  DevelopmentAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: AWS account ID of the development account.

Conditions:
  # Transit account determination
  IsTransitAccountEmpty:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      - ""
  IsTransitAccountThisAccount:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref TransitGatewayAccount
      - !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  IsPrimaryTransitAccount:
    Fn::Or:
      - !Condition IsTransitAccountEmpty
      - !Condition IsTransitAccountThisAccount
  IsSpokeAccount:
    Fn::Not:
      - !Condition IsPrimaryTransitAccount

  # Organization / account-sharing configuration detection
  IsOrganizationConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref Organization, ""]
  IsOrganizationAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref OrganizationAccount, ""]
  IsJumpstartAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref JumpstartAccount, ""]
  IsManagementAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref ManagementAccount, ""]
  IsLogAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref LogAccount, ""]
  IsRecoveryAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref RecoveryAccount, ""]
  IsBuildAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref BuildAccount, ""]
  IsCoreAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref CoreAccount, ""]
  IsProductionAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref ProductionAccount, ""]
  IsStagingAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref StagingAccount, ""]
  IsUATAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref UATAccount, ""]
  IsQAAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref QAAccount, ""]
  IsTestingAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref TestingAccount, ""]
  IsDevelopmentAccountConfigured:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals: [!Ref DevelopmentAccount, ""]
  HasConfiguredAccounts:
    Fn::Or:
      - Fn::Or:
          - !Condition IsOrganizationAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsJumpstartAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsManagementAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsLogAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsRecoveryAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsBuildAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsCoreAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsProductionAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsStagingAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsUATAccountConfigured
      - Fn::Or:
          - !Condition IsQAAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsTestingAccountConfigured
          - !Condition IsDevelopmentAccountConfigured
  AutoAllowExternalPrincipals:
    Fn::And:
      - !Condition HasConfiguredAccounts
      - Fn::Not:
          - !Condition IsOrganizationConfigured

Resources:
  # Transit Gateway created in the primary transit account.
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: !Ref AutoAcceptSharedAttachments
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
      DnsSupport: !Ref DnsSupport
      VpnEcmpSupport: !Ref VpnEcmpSupport
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGateway"
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: AccountName
          Value: !Ref AccountName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # RAM Resource Share sharing the Transit Gateway with configured principals.
  TransitGatewayResourceShare:
    Type: AWS::RAM::ResourceShare
    Condition: IsPrimaryTransitAccount
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
      AllowExternalPrincipals:
        Fn::If:
          - AutoAllowExternalPrincipals
          - "true"
          - !Ref AllowExternalPrincipals
      Principals:
        - !If [IsOrganizationConfigured, !Ref Organization, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsOrganizationAccountConfigured, !Ref OrganizationAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsJumpstartAccountConfigured, !Ref JumpstartAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsManagementAccountConfigured, !Ref ManagementAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsLogAccountConfigured, !Ref LogAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsRecoveryAccountConfigured, !Ref RecoveryAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsBuildAccountConfigured, !Ref BuildAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsCoreAccountConfigured, !Ref CoreAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsProductionAccountConfigured, !Ref ProductionAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsStagingAccountConfigured, !Ref StagingAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsUATAccountConfigured, !Ref UATAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsQAAccountConfigured, !Ref QAAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsTestingAccountConfigured, !Ref TestingAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
        - !If [IsDevelopmentAccountConfigured, !Ref DevelopmentAccount, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      ResourceArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway/${TransitGateway}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TransitGatewayResourceShareName
        - Key: CompanyName
          Value: !Ref CompanyName
        - Key: SystemName
          Value: !Ref SystemName
        - Key: EnvironmentName
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Custom resource used in a secondary spoke account to resolve the shared
  # Transit Gateway reference across account boundaries.
  TransitGatewayReference:
    Type: Custom::TransitGatewayReference
    Condition: IsSpokeAccount
    Properties:
      ServiceToken:
        Fn::ImportValue:
          !Sub "${ReferenceFunctionsStackName}-TransitGatewayReferenceFunctionArn"

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import base64
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def convert_secret_key_to_smtp_password(secret_key, region):
              """Convert an IAM secret access key to an SES SMTP password using the AWS algorithm."""
              # The AWS SES SMTP credential algorithm:
              # 1. Create a HMAC-SHA256 of the AWS4 request (the string "SendRawEmail")
              #    using the secret key as the key.
              # 2. Sign the date (YYYYMMDD) with the result of step 1.
              # 3. Sign the AWS region with the result of step 2.
              # 4. Sign "ses" service with the result of step 3.
              # 5. Sign the AWS4 request "aws4_request" with the result of step 4.
              # 6. The final HMAC is the SMTP password (base64 encoded).

              date = "11111111"  # AWS uses this fixed date value
              service = "ses"
              region_str = region
              terminal = "aws4_request"
              message = "SendRawEmail"

              # Step 1: kDate = HMAC-SHA256("AWS4" + secretKey, date)
              k_date = hmac.new(
                  ("AWS4" + secret_key).encode('utf-8'),
                  date.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).digest()

              # Step 2: kRegion = HMAC-SHA256(kDate, region)
              k_region = hmac.new(
                  k_date,
                  region_str.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).digest()

              # Step 3: kService = HMAC-SHA256(kRegion, service)
              k_service = hmac.new(
                  k_region,
                  service.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).digest()

              # Step 4: kTerminal = HMAC-SHA256(kService, terminal)
              k_terminal = hmac.new(
                  k_service,
                  terminal.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).digest()

              # Step 5: SMTP password = HMAC-SHA256(kTerminal, message) -> base64
              smtp_password = hmac.new(
                  k_terminal,
                  message.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).digest()

              return base64.b64encode(smtp_password).decode('utf-8')

          def handler(event, context):
              """Lambda handler called by CloudFormation custom resource."""
              request_type = event.get('RequestType')
              resource_properties = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})

              # Physical resource ID is the IAM user name
              physical_resource_id = resource_properties.get('IAMUserName', 'SMTPUser')
              aws_region = resource_properties.get('AWSRegion', 'us-east-1')

              # Build parameter names consistently
              smtp_username_param = f"/{physical_resource_id}-SMTP/Username"
              smtp_password_param = f"/{physical_resource_id}-SMTP/Password"
              version_param = f"/{physical_resource_id}-SMTP/Version"

              try:
                  ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      # The SecretAccessKey is passed from CloudFormation via
                      # Fn::GetAtt on the IAM AccessKey resource, which resolves
                      # at deployment time.
                      if 'SecretAccessKey' not in resource_properties:
                          raise Exception(
                              "SecretAccessKey is not available. Ensure the custom resource "
                              "passes the resolved SecretAccessKey from the AccessKey resource."
                          )

                      secret_access_key = resource_properties['SecretAccessKey']
                      rotation_version = resource_properties.get('AccessKeyRotationVersion', '1')

                      # Convert to SMTP password
                      smtp_password = convert_secret_key_to_smtp_password(
                          secret_access_key, aws_region
                      )

                      # SMTP username is the access key ID (e.g. AKIA...)
                      smtp_username = resource_properties.get('AccessKeyId', '')

                      # Store SMTP username in Parameter Store
                      username_put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': smtp_username_param,
                          'Value': smtp_username,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                      }
                      # Store SMTP password in Parameter Store
                      password_put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': smtp_password_param,
                          'Value': smtp_password,
                          'Type': 'SecureString',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                      }
                      # Store version (String, not sensitive)
                      version_put_kwargs = {
                          'Name': version_param,
                          'Value': rotation_version,
                          'Type': 'String',
                          'Overwrite': True,
                      }

                      kms_key_arn = resource_properties.get('KmsKeyArn', '')
                      if kms_key_arn:
                          username_put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn
                          password_put_kwargs['KeyId'] = kms_key_arn

                      ssm.put_parameter(**username_put_kwargs)
                      ssm.put_parameter(**password_put_kwargs)
                      ssm.put_parameter(**version_put_kwargs)

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      # Clean up SSM parameters on stack deletion
                      for param_name in [smtp_username_param, smtp_password_param, version_param]:
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=param_name)
                          except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                              pass

                  # Send success response
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {
                      'SMTPUsername': smtp_username_param,
                      'SMTPPassword': smtp_password_param,
                  }, physical_resource_id)

              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {
                      'Error': str(e)
                  }, physical_resource_id)
                  raise

Description: >-
  WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) backed by a single Python Lambda function that
  handles the connect, disconnect, default and custom message routes, uses a
  DynamoDB table to track connections, and pushes live status updates about
  grant-processing jobs to connected clients. Environment variables are
  encrypted with a dedicated customer-managed KMS key and API Gateway
  account-level CloudWatch logging is enabled using a separate customer-managed
  KMS key.

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway deployment stage.
  CustomRouteKey:
    Type: String
    Default: sendMessage
    Description: Route key for the custom message route.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # KMS key used to encrypt the Lambda function environment variables
  ############################################################################

  EnvironmentEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the WebSocket Lambda function environment variables.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # KMS key used to encrypt the API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log group
  ############################################################################

  LogsEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log group.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  ############################################################################
  # DynamoDB table used to track WebSocket connections
  ############################################################################

      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId

      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ############################################################################
  # IAM execution role for the Lambda function
  ############################################################################

  WebSocketHandlerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-handler-role'
      Description: Execution role for the WebSocket grant-processing status Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSocketHandlerScopedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowConnectionsTableReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
              - Sid: AllowDecryptOfEnvironmentKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EnvironmentEncryptionKey.Arn

  ############################################################################
  # Lambda function that handles every WebSocket route
  ############################################################################

  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-handler'
      Description: Handles the connect, disconnect, default and custom message routes for the WebSocket API.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 15
      Architectures:

      Role: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerExecutionRole.Arn

        ZipFile: |

          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          connections_table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['CONNECTIONS_TABLE_NAME'])
          management_client = boto3.client(
              'apigatewaymanagementapi',
              endpoint_url=os.environ['MANAGEMENT_ENDPOINT'],
          )


          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get('requestContext', {})
              route_key = request_context.get('routeKey')
              connection_id = request_context.get('connectionId')

              if route_key == '$connect':

                  return {'statusCode': 200}

                  connections_table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200}

                      {'type': 'statusUpdate', 'message': message}

                      ProjectionExpression='connectionId'

                              Data=payload,
                          )

        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:*
                Resource: '*'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: EC2CodeDeployDemoInstanceProfile

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: CodeDeployServiceRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codedeploy.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
                - codedeploy.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow

                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs

                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
                  - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
                  - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity

                  - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancers
                  - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancerTargetGroups

                  - codedeploy:ListDeployments
                  - codedeploy:ListDeploymentConfigs
