final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Multi-tenant SaaS operations Cognito identity bootstrap. Creates a pooled
  tenant user pool / app client / hosted domain, a pooled identity pool with
  an authenticated IAM role granting tag-scoped DynamoDB access, a siloed
  tenant role, and a separate operations users pool with its own identity pool
  and OIDC registrations.

Parameters:
  TenantAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Default: app.tenant.example.com
    Description: Callback host for the tenant application (used by the pooled pool).
  AdminAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Default: app.admin.example.com
    Description: Callback host for the admin application (used by the operations pool).
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Description: IAM role name for the siloed tenant role.
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled tenant user pool, app client, hosted domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: !Sub >-
            Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.
            Sign in at https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the tenant application
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      EmailVerificationMessage: Your verification code is {####}.
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your email

  PooledClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledUserPool
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}/oauth2/idpresponse"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}/logout"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  PooledUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pooled identity pool + OIDC identity provider registration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PooledOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      ClientIdList:
        - !Ref PooledClient
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1
      Url: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledUserPool}"

  PooledIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PooledUserPool}"
          ClientId: !Ref PooledClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      OpenIdConnectProviderARNs:
        - !Ref PooledOIDCProvider

  PooledIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PooledIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthPooledRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Authenticated IAM role for pooled tenants / operations admins with
  # tag-scoped DynamoDB access.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthPooledRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by authenticated pooled tenants and operations admins to
        access DynamoDB scoped by the tenantId and userRole principal tags.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OpsIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TagScopedDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantPrefixedItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys: "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}:*"
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Siloed tenant role (tenant-suffixed Product/Order table names)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SiloedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      Description: >-
        Siloed tenant role granting tag-scoped DynamoDB access where the
        Product and Order table names are suffixed with the caller's tenant ID.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
              - sts:TagSession
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud:
                  - !Ref PooledIdentityPool
                  - !Ref OpsIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TagScopedDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantPrefixedItemAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-${!aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys: "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}:*"
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:*
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:index/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations users pool, app client, hosted domain, user group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OpsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: !Sub >-
            Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.
            Sign in at https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}
          EmailSubject: Welcome to the admin application
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      EmailVerificationMessage: Your verification code is {####}.
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your email

  OpsClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OpsUserPool
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}/oauth2/idpresponse"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}/logout"
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
        - custom:apiKey
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

  OpsUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref OpsUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "operationsusers-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}"

  SystemAdminsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdmins
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref OpsUserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Operations identity pool + OIDC identity provider registration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OpsOIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      ClientIdList:
        - !Ref OpsClient
      ThumbprintList:
        - 6938fd4d98bab03faadb97b34396831e3780aea1
      Url: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OpsUserPool}"

  OpsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: OperationsUser-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !Sub "cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${OpsUserPool}"
          ClientId: !Ref OpsClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      OpenIdConnectProviderARNs:
        - !Ref OpsOIDCProvider

  OpsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref OpsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthPooledRole.Arn

Outputs:
  PooledUserPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant user pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledUserPool
  PooledIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Pooled tenant identity pool ID
    Value: !Ref PooledIdentityPool
  PooledClientId:
    Description: Pooled tenant application client ID
    Value: !Ref PooledClient

    Description: Operations users user pool ID

  OperationsIdentityPoolId:

    Value: !Ref OpsIdentityPool
  OperationsClientId:
    Description: Operations users application client ID
    Value: !Ref OpsClient
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Description: Siloed tenant role name
    Value: !Ref SiloedRole
  SiloedTenantRoleArn:
    Description: Siloed tenant role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt SiloedRole.Arn
  OperationsUserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Operations users user pool provider URL (issuer)
    Value: !GetAtt OpsUserPool.ProviderURL

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Reusable DynamoDB table stack with provisioned/on-demand billing, autoscaling, backup, encryption, TTL, streams, and optional alarms."

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute (required).
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of the partition key (S=string, N=number, B=binary).
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name for the table. If empty, AWS generates a name.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty to omit.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of the sort key (defaults to numeric).
  ExtraAttribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional first extra attribute (defines GSI1 hash key).
  ExtraAttribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of the first extra attribute.
  ExtraAttribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional second extra attribute (defines GSI2 hash key).
  ExtraAttribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of the second extra attribute.
  ExtraAttribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional third extra attribute definition.
  ExtraAttribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
    Description: Data type of the third extra attribute.
  TTLAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the Time to Live attribute. Leave empty to disable TTL.
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: DISABLED
    AllowedValues: [NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES, KEYS_ONLY, DISABLED]
    Description: Stream view type. DISABLED disables streams.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
    Description: PROVISIONED uses autoscaling; PAY_PER_REQUEST uses on-demand and skips capacity/scaling resources.
  ReadMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum read capacity units.
  ReadMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Maximum read capacity units.
  WriteMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Minimum write capacity units.
  WriteMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Maximum write capacity units.
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Target utilization percentage for autoscaling.
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery (enabled by default).
  EnableSSE:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with the AWS managed KMS key (off by default).
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Retention in days for backups. Set to 0 to disable backup entirely.
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN to receive alerts. Empty disables alarms and backup vault notifications.

Conditions:
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasExtra1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute1Name, ""]]
  HasExtra2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute2Name, ""]]
  HasExtra3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, ""]]
  EnableStreams: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, DISABLED]]
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSE, "true"]
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, "true"]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TTLAttributeName, ""]]
  EnableBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  EnableAlerts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, ""]]

Resources:
  MyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtra1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtra2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtra3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasExtra1
          - IndexName: !Sub "${ExtraAttribute1Name}-index"
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtra2
          - IndexName: !Sub "${ExtraAttribute2Name}-index"
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - EnableStreams
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - EnablePITR
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TTLAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoscaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalableTargets
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                  - application-autoscaling:DescribeScalingPolicies
                  - application-autoscaling:PutScalingPolicy
                  - application-autoscaling:DeleteScalingPolicy
                  - application-autoscaling:RegisterScalableTarget
                  - application-autoscaling:DeregisterScalableTarget
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: "*"

  ReadScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${MyTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  WriteScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${MyTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling-policy"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling-policy"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:ListBackups
                  - dynamodb:UpdateContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:RestoreTableFromBackup
                Resource: !GetAtt MyTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: "*"

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backup-vault"

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backup-plan"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackup
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 5 * * ? *)"
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-backup-selection"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt MyTable.Arn

  # Lambda-backed custom resource to configure backup vault notifications when SNS topic integration is enabled.
  BackupNotificationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BackupNotificationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - backup:PutBackupVaultNotifications
                  - backup:DeleteBackupVaultNotifications
                Resource: !GetAtt BackupVault.BackupVaultArn

  BackupNotificationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt BackupNotificationFunctionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              backup = boto3.client('backup')
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              vault_arn = props.get('BackupVaultArn')
              sns_topic = props.get('TopicArn')
              events = ['BACKUP_JOB_STARTED', 'BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED', 'BACKUP_JOB_FAILED']

              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      backup.put_backup_vault_notifications(
                          BackupVaultName=vault_arn,
                          SNSTopicArn=sns_topic,
                          BackupVaultEvents=events
                      )
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      backup.delete_backup_vault_notifications(
                          BackupVaultName=vault_arn
                      )
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  BackupNotifications:
    Type: Custom::BackupNotifications
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt BackupNotificationFunction.Arn
      BackupVaultArn: !GetAtt BackupVault.BackupVaultArn
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-read-throttle-events"
      AlarmDescription: "Read throttle events for the DynamoDB table"
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn]
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref MyTable

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-write-throttle-events"
      AlarmDescription: "Write throttle events for the DynamoDB table"
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn]
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref MyTable

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-throttled-requests"
      AlarmDescription: "Throttled requests for the DynamoDB table"
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn]
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref MyTable

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-user-errors"
      AlarmDescription: "User errors for the DynamoDB table"
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn]
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref MyTable

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-system-errors"
      AlarmDescription: "System errors for the DynamoDB table"
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn]
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref MyTable

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table"
    Value: !Ref MyTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  DynamoDB tables for an AWS account-vending automation tool. A required stage
  parameter is appended to every table name. Includes Application Auto Scaling
  for the accountInfo and taskStatus tables and their indexes.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    MinLength: '1'
    MaxLength: '20'
    Default: dev
    Description: Stage value appended to every table name (e.g. dev, prod).
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dedicated IAM role for Application Auto Scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling: accountInfo table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling: accountInfo GSI gsiRequestId
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoRequestIdIndexReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoRequestIdIndexReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoRequestIdIndexReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoRequestIdIndexWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoRequestIdIndexWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoRequestIdIndexWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling: accountInfo GSI gsiAccountId
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  AccountInfoAccountIdIndexReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoAccountIdIndexReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiAccountId-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoAccountIdIndexReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  AccountInfoAccountIdIndexWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiAccountId'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  AccountInfoAccountIdIndexWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiAccountId-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoAccountIdIndexWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Application Auto Scaling: taskStatus table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TaskStatusTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

  TaskStatusTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  TaskStatusTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60

Outputs:
  CbInfoTableName:
    Value: !Ref CbInfoTable
  AccountInfoTableName:
    Value: !Ref AccountInfoTable
  TaskStatusTableName:
    Value: !Ref TaskStatusTable
  NipapCfnTableName:
    Value: !Ref NipapCfnTable
  OpsTableName:
    Value: !Ref OpsTable
  DxInterfaceTableName:
    Value: !Ref DxInterfaceTable
  ClaStatusTableName:
    Value: !Ref ClaStatusTable
  ConfigRulesComplianceTableName:
    Value: !Ref ConfigRulesComplianceTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >

  application: VPC, public/private subnets across AZs, NAT gateways per AZ,
  VPC Flow Logs, and an ECS cluster with Container Insights.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetOneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet.
  PublicSubnetTwoCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet.
  PrivateSubnetOneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnetTwoCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetOne:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetOneCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:

  PublicSubnetTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DefaultPublicRoute:

    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:

  PublicSubnetOneRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetOne
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetTwoRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

  EIPNatOne:

  PrivateRouteTableOne:

    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-1"

  PrivateRouteOne:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableOne
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayOne

  PrivateSubnetOneRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetOne
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableOne

  EIPNatTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPNatTwo.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetTwo

  PrivateRouteTableTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-2"

  PrivateRouteTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableTwo
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayTwo

  PrivateSubnetTwoRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetTwo
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableTwo

  FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "vpc-flow-log-delivery"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogCloudWatchLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cluster"
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Test environment used to validate a set of Service Catalog preventive controls.
  Provisions a VPC (172.16.0.0/16), two subnets, test security group, a customer
  managed KMS key, DMS replication subnet group and service role, ElastiCache
  subnet/cache security groups, a SageMaker execution role, and per-product-type
  Service Catalog launch roles. The KMS key policy grants those roles use of the key.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: sc-prev-controls-test
    Description: Environment / naming prefix for the test resources.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-subnet-a"

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-subnet-b"

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the Service Catalog test resources
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-test-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Key used by the Service Catalog preventive controls test environment
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: "kms-key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow full administration by the account"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow service catalog launch roles and service roles to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt DMSServiceRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ALBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EBSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EFSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FSxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SNSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SQSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: "*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS service role and replication subnet group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DMSServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dms-vpc-role

  DMSReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DMSServiceRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: Replication subnet group spanning the test subnets
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-dms-repl-subnet-group"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group spanning the test subnets
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetA
        - !Ref SubnetB
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-elasticache-subnet-group"

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Cache security group for the ElastiCache test resources

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-sagemaker-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-sagemaker-execution-role"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service Catalog launch roles (one per product type)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ALBLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-launch-alb"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ALBLaunchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-launch-alb"

  AutoScalingLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-launch-autoscaling"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutoScalingLaunchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-launch-autoscaling"

  DMSLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-launch-dms"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Serverless AI Campaign Orchestration Platform. Turns a plain-language marketing
  instruction into a delivered multi-channel customer campaign. Provides a
  customer-managed KMS key, DynamoDB data stores, S3 campaign assets bucket, a
  Step Functions state machine driving a pipeline of Python Lambda functions,
  generative steps backed by Amazon Bedrock, an HTTP API (ApiGateway V2)
  protected by a Cognito user pool, a delivery-status callback function, optional
  OpenSearch Serverless semantic search (off by default), and operational
  monitoring (state machine log group + SNS topic + CloudWatch alarm).

Parameters:
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-v2:1
    Description: The Amazon Bedrock model ID invoked by the generative Lambda steps.
  NotificationEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    Description: >-
      The sender/notification email address used for campaign messages and the
      alarm SNS subscription. Placeholder default requires no external config.
  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-messaging-phone-id
    Description: >-
      Identifier of the messaging (SMS) phone number used as the sender identity.
      Placeholder default requires no external configuration.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: >-
      When true, provisions an OpenSearch Serverless vector collection with its
      own encryption, network and data access policies for semantic search.
      Switched off (not provisioned) by default.
  ProvisionedThroughput:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Provisioned read/write capacity for each DynamoDB table.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, "true"]

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt data stores
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key encrypting campaign platform data stores
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/campaign-orchestration-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB data stores
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-customer-profiles
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-channel-rate-limits
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channelKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channelKey
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey

  MessageDeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: campaign-message-delivery-tracking
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
        WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref ProvisionedThroughput
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref CampaignKMSKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 bucket for campaign assets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CampaignKMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CampaignPlatformAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/campaign-customer-profiles
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/campaign-channel-rate-limits
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/campaign-message-delivery-tracking
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${CampaignAssetsBucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${CampaignAssetsBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignKMSKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-segment-customers
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              payload = dict(event)
              table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(
                  "campaign-customer-profiles")
              customers = []
              scan = table.scan(Limit=1000)

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-predict-channel
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              payload = dict(event)
              model_id = os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"]
              client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
              prompt = (
                  "You are a channel prediction model. For the following campaign "
                  "instruction and customer segments, recommend the best delivery "
                  "channel (email, sms, push) per customer segment. Respond as JSON.\n"
                  + json.dumps({ "instruction": event.get("instruction"),
                                 "segments": event.get("segments", []) })
              )
              body = json.dumps({
                  "prompt": prompt,
                  "max_tokens_to_sample": 256,
                  "temperature": 0.2
              })
              resp = client.invoke_model(
                  modelId=model_id,
                  contentType="application/json",
                  accept="application/json",
                  body=body
              ).get("body")
              result = json.loads(result.read() if hasattr(result, "read") else result)
              payload["channel_plan"] = result
              payload["step"] = "predict_channel"
              return payload

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda functions — API (launch, status) and delivery callback
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-launcher
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, uuid
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              sf = boto3.client("stepfunctions")
              body = event.get("body") or "{}"
              if isinstance(body, str):
                  body = json.loads(body)
              exec_name = "campaign-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
              resp = sf.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"],
                  name=exec_name,
                  input=json.dumps({
                      "instruction": body.get("instruction", ""),
                      "campaign_name": body.get("campaign_name", ""),
                      "audience_filter": body.get("audience_filter", {}),
                      "channels": body.get("channels", ["email", "sms"]),
                  })
              )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "executionArn": resp["executionArn"],
                      "executionName": exec_name,
                  })
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine

  CampaignStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-status
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, urllib.parse
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              sf = boto3.client("stepfunctions")
              params = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
              execution_name = params.get("executionName")
              arn = os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"]
              execution_arn = (
                  arn.rsplit(":", 1)[0] + ":" + execution_name
                  if execution_name else None
              )
              if not execution_arn:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 400,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": "executionName required"})
                  }
              resp = sf.describe_execution(executionArn=execution_arn)
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "status": resp.get("status"),
                      "startDate": resp.get("startDate"),
                      "stopDate": resp.get("stopDate"),
                  })
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine

  DeliveryStatusCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: campaign-delivery-callback
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os
          import boto3
          import datetime

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get("body") or "{}"
              if isinstance(body, str):
                  body = json.loads(body)
              message_id = body.get("messageId")
              status = body.get("status", "UNKNOWN")
              table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(
                  "campaign-message-delivery-tracking")
              if message_id:
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={ "messageId": message_id },
                      UpdateExpression="SET #st = :st, #ts = :ts",
                      ExpressionAttributeNames={ "#st": "status", "#ts": "callbackTs" },
                      ExpressionAttributeValues={
                          ":st": status,
                          ":ts": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                      }
                  )
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                  "body": json.dumps({"ok": True})
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref MessageDeliveryTrackingTable

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions state machine (orchestration)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vendedlogs/states/campaign-orchestrator
      RetentionInDays: 30

  CampaignStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: campaign-orchestrator
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${StateMachineLogGroup}:*
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |-
          {
            "Comment": "AI campaign orchestration pipeline",
            "StartAt": "ParseInstruction",
            "States": {
              "ParseInstruction": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${ParseInstructionArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "SegmentCustomers"
              },
              "SegmentCustomers": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${SegmentCustomersArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "PredictChannel"
              },
              "PredictChannel": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${PredictChannelArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "SafetyCheck"
              },
              "SafetyCheck": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${SafetyCheckArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "AdaptContent"
              },
              "AdaptContent": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${AdaptContentArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "DeliverMessages"
              },
              "DeliverMessages": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${DeliverMessagesArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "Next": "RecordResults"
              },
              "RecordResults": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${RecordResultsArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - ParseInstructionArn: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
          SegmentCustomersArn: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
          PredictChannelArn: !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
          SafetyCheckArn: !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
          AdaptContentArn: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
          DeliverMessagesArn: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
          RecordResultsArn: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
