AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless URL shortener backed by DynamoDB and Python Lambda functions exposed through API Gateway.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing short identifiers.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix used for the Lambda function names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.14
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.13
      - python3.14
    Description: Python runtime for the Lambda functions.
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://short.example.com
    Description: Configurable application URL used to build shortened links.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform
    Description: Owner tag value.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]
Resources:
  ### DynamoDB ###
  UrlShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: shortId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [IsProd, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ### IAM roles ###
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dynamodb-url-shortener
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt UrlShortenerTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${UrlShortenerTable.Arn}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: apigateway-cloudwatch-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  ### Lambda functions ###
  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          APP_URL: !Ref AppUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import random
          import string

          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          APP_URL = os.environ["APP_URL"]
          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(TABLE_NAME)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body", "{}"))
              except (TypeError, ValueError):
                  body = {}

              long_url = body.get("longUrl") or body.get("url")
              if not long_url:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 400,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": "longUrl is required"}),
                  }

              identifier = "".join(
                  random.choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits)
                  for _ in range(random.randint(12, 16))
              )

              TABLE.put_item(Item={"shortId": identifier, "longUrl": long_url})

              shortened = APP_URL.rstrip("/") + "/" + identifier
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"shortUrl": shortened}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os

          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["TABLE_NAME"]
          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(TABLE_NAME)


          def handler(event, context):
              path_params = event.get("pathParameters") or {}
              identifier = path_params.get("shortId")

              if not identifier:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 400,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": "missing shortId",
                  }

              result = TABLE.get_item(Key={"shortId": identifier})
              item = result.get("Item")

              if not item:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 404,
                      "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": "short link not found",
                  }

              return {
                  "statusCode": 302,
                  "headers": {"Location": item["longUrl"]},
                  "body": "",
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ### API Gateway ###
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-api'
      Description: Regional REST API for the serverless URL shortener.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: create

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{shortId}'

  CreateMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        Uri: !Sub
          - arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FnArn}/invocations
          - FnArn: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn

  RetrieveMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.shortId: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        Uri: !Sub
          - arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FnArn}/invocations
          - FnArn: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMethod
      - RetrieveMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: test

  ### Lambda invocation permissions for API Gateway ###
  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiId}/test/*/create
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi

  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiId}/test/*/{shortId}
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Base URL of the deployed URL shortener REST API.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test'
  TableNameOutput:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref UrlShortenerTable
  CreateFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the create Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn
  RetrieveFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the retrieve Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple to-do list GraphQL API on AWS AppSync backed by a DynamoDB table using JavaScript resolvers.

Parameters:
  TodosTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleTodosTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table that stores to-dos.

Resources:
  ############################################################
  # DynamoDB table
  ############################################################
  TodosTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TodosTableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: TodosByOwner
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  ############################################################
  # IAM role AppSync assumes to read/write the table
  ############################################################
  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodosTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TodosTable.Arn}/index/*'

  ############################################################
  # AppSync GraphQL API
  ############################################################
  SimpleTodoAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SimpleTodoAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: true

  AppSyncApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId

  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |-
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String!
          done: Boolean!
          owner: String!
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          title: String!
          done: Boolean!
          owner: String!
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          done: Boolean
          owner: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos: [Todo]
          todosByOwner(owner: String!): [Todo]
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  ############################################################
  # Data source
  ############################################################
  TodosDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      Name: TodosDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        TableName: !Ref TodosTable

  ############################################################
  # JavaScript (JS) resolvers
  ############################################################
  ## Mutations
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const item = {
            id: util.autoId(),
            title: input.title,
            done: input.done,
            owner: input.owner,
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB({ id: item.id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(item),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const values = util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(input);
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB({ id: input.id }),
            update: {
              expression: 'SET title = :title, done = :done, owner = :owner',
              expressionValues: {
                ':title': values.title,
                ':done': values.done,
                ':owner': values.owner,
              },
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ## Queries
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        export function request(ctx) {
          return { operation: 'Scan' };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

  TodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: todosByOwner
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodosDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |-
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB({ ':owner': ctx.args.owner }),
            },
            index: 'TodosByOwner',
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: GraphQL API endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt SimpleTodoAPI.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Description: API key used to authenticate against the API.
    Value: !GetAtt AppSyncApiKey.ApiKey
  TodosTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table backing the API.
    Value: !Ref TodosTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: >-
  AWS Config conformance pack with operational best practices for Amazon CloudWatch.
  It comprises five AWS managed Config rules covering CloudWatch alarm actions,
  configured actions, metric/resource alarm existence, metric alarm settings, and
  encryption of CloudWatch log groups. The first four rules are scoped to CloudWatch
  alarm resources. Rule inputs are exposed as parameters so the pack can be tuned
  without editing the template, defaulting to requiring alarm actions and
  insufficient-data actions but not OK actions, and to checking the CPUUtilization
  metric on EC2 instances. Each input is only passed through to its rule when the
  parameter is left non-empty.

Parameters:
  AlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false", ""]
    Description: >-
      Indicates whether CloudWatch alarm actions are required. Passed through to
      CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK and CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK only when
      left non-empty.
  InsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false", ""]
    Description: >-
      Indicates whether CloudWatch alarm insufficient-data actions are required. Passed
      through to CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK only when left non-empty.
  OkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false", ""]
    Description: >-
      Indicates whether CloudWatch alarm OK actions are required. Passed through to
      CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK only when left non-empty.
  MetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: >-
      The CloudWatch metric name to check in CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK and
      CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK. Passed through only when non-empty.
  ResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
    Description: >-
      The resource type to check in CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK. Passed through only
      when non-empty.

Conditions:
  HasAlarmAction: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmActionRequired, ""]]
  HasInsufficientDataAction: !Not [!Equals [!Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired, ""]]
  HasOkAction: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OkActionRequired, ""]]
  HasMetricName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MetricName, ""]]
  HasResourceType: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceType, ""]]

Resources:
  ConfigBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS customer managed key for Config delivery S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowConfigAndS3Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - config.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  ConfigBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'config-delivery-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigBucketKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ConfigRecorderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigS3Delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ConfigBucket.Arn}/*'

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    Properties:
      Name: default
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: false
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRecorderRole.Arn

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigBucket
    Properties:
      Name: default
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigBucket

  CloudWatchOperationalBestPracticesConformancePack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: CloudWatchOperationalBestPracticesConformancePack
      ConformancePackInputParameters:
        - ParameterName: AlarmActionCheckInput
          ParameterValue: !Join
            - ""
            - - "{"
              - !If
                - HasAlarmAction
                - !Join
                  - ""
                  - - '"alarmActionRequired":"'
                    - !Ref AlarmActionRequired
                    - '"'
                - ""
              - !If
                - HasInsufficientDataAction
                - !Join
                  - ""
                  - - !If [HasAlarmAction, ",", ""]
                    - '"insufficientDataActionRequired":"'
                    - !Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired
                    - '"'
                - ""
              - !If
                - HasOkAction
                - !Join
                  - ""

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Encryption-at-rest foundation for a restaurant assistant application,
  centred on a customer managed KMS key with automatic rotation enabled.
  Provisions an encrypted sessions, market prices, reminders, and rate limits
  DynamoDB table, plus an image S3 bucket and a dedicated bucket for its
  access logs.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Friendly project name used to derive resource names and the KMS alias.
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    ConstraintDescription: ProjectName must be between 1 and 40 characters.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment used to derive resource names and the KMS alias.
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be between 1 and 20 characters.

Resources:
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt all data stores.
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed KMS key for ${ProjectName} ${Environment} data at rest'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key-policy'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # Sessions table: keyed on session id, data type as sort key, with a TTL.
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: dataType
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: dataType
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # Market prices table: keyed on ingredient and market, with a GSI over
  # last-updated time for looking up an ingredient.
  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: market
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: lastUpdated
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: market
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IngredientByLastUpdated
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: lastUpdated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: reminderId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: rateLimitId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # Image bucket, encrypted with the shared KMS key.
  ImageBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: false
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LoggingBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images/'

  # Dedicated bucket that receives the image bucket's access logs.
  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-image-logs'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: false

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt ImageBucket.Arn

Outputs:
  EncryptionKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKey
  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref EncryptionKeyAlias
  SessionsTableName:
    Description: Name of the sessions table.
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
  MarketPricesTableName:
    Description: Name of the market prices table.
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable
  RemindersTableName:
    Description: Name of the reminders table.
    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
  RateLimitsTableName:
    Description: Name of the rate limits table.
    Value: !Ref RateLimitsTable
  ImageBucketName:
    Description: Name of the image bucket.
    Value: !Ref ImageBucket
  LoggingBucketName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared identity and state layer for a stateful agent demo built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
  Provisions Cognito identity (user pool, hosted domain, resource server, app clients, seeded
  test user), a DynamoDB finance-tracking state table, IAM execution roles for the MCP server
  and agent runtimes, and publishes discovery values into SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Description: Project name used to derive the SSM parameter prefix path and resource names.
    Default: stateful-agent-demo
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address for the seeded Cognito test user.
    Default: agent-test@example.com
  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Description: Password for the seeded Cognito test user.
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ReplaceMe!123

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project Identity Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
      - Label:
          default: Seeded Test User
        Parameters:
          - TestUserEmail
          - TestUserPassword

Conditions:
  HasTestUserEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestUserEmail, '']]
  HasTestUserPassword: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TestUserPassword, '']]
  ShouldCreateTestUser: !And
    - Condition: HasTestUserEmail
    - Condition: HasTestUserPassword

Resources:
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito identity layer
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MaxLength: '2048'
            MinLength: '3'
        - Name: preferred_username
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-auth'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  FinancialApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Sub 'https://finance.${ProjectName}.example.com'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-api'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: finance.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the agent's finance tracking records
        - ScopeName: finance.write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to the agent's finance tracking records

  UserPoolClientM2M:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - FinancialApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'https://finance.${ProjectName}.example.com/finance.read'
        - !Sub 'https://finance.${ProjectName}.example.com/finance.write'
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  UserPoolClientWeb:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:8080/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - 'http://localhost:8080/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  SeededTestUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser
    Condition: ShouldCreateTestUser
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      DesiredDeliveryMediums:
        - EMAIL
      ForceAliasCreation: true
      UserAttributes:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail
        - Name: email_verified
          Value: 'true'
      ValidationData:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB finance tracking state table
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FinanceStateTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-state'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: userId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: sessionId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: userId
          KeyType: RANGE
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution roles
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpServerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-server-exec-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - bedrock.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FinanceStateDynamoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceStateTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Highly available two-tier network for hosting an application. Builds a VPC
  with configurable CIDR, two public subnets and two private subnets spread
  across availability zones. One shared public route table backed by an Internet
  Gateway, one NAT gateway per public subnet with a dedicated Elastic IP, and a
  dedicated route table per private subnet routing outbound traffic to the NAT
  gateway in its own zone.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR
      PublicSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 1 CIDR
      PublicSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Public Subnet 2 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 1 CIDR
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
        default: Private Subnet 2 CIDR

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 (Availability Zone A).
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 (Availability Zone B).
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 (Availability Zone A).
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 (Availability Zone B).
    AllowedPattern: ^((\d{1,3})\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$

Resources:
  # ---- VPC ----
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  # ---- Internet Gateway ----
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---- Public Subnets ----
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2"

  # ---- Private Subnets ----
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"

  # ---- Shared Public Route Table ----
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-route-table"

  PublicRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---- Elastic IPs ----
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1-eip"

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2-eip"

  # ---- NAT Gateways (one per public subnet) ----
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: PublicRouteToIGW
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: PublicRouteToIGW
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2"

  # ---- Private Route Tables (one per private subnet, pinned to own NAT GW) ----
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-1"

  PrivateRoute1ToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-2"

  PrivateRoute2ToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id"

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"
